example1_ja: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。
example2_en: In hospital wards, staff should speak softly at night to help patients rest and recover.
example2_ja: 在医院病房里，工作人员夜间应轻声说话，帮助患者休息和康复。
collocations: speak softly｜轻声说话 ; whisper softly｜低声耳语 ; softly lit｜光线柔和的
tip_ja: softly强调轻柔或低声；不等于缓慢地。
meanings_zh: adv. 轻声地 | adv. 轻柔地；柔和地
example1_zh: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。
example2_zh: 在医院病房里，工作人员夜间应轻声说话，帮助患者休息和康复。

meanings_ja: adj. 永久的；长期不变的 | adj. 长期雇用的；正式的
definition_en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time. | Employed without a fixed end date.
example1_en: The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
example1_ja: 滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。
example2_en: Investment in flood prevention can reduce the risk of permanent damage to homes and public infrastructure.
example2_ja: 投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。
collocations: permanent damage｜永久性损害 ; permanent resident｜永久居民 ; permanent job｜长期工作 ; permanent address｜固定住址
tip_ja: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。
meanings_zh: adj. 永久的；长期不变的 | adj. 长期雇用的；正式的
example1_zh: 滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。
example2_zh: 投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。

meanings_ja: n. 比赛；竞争 | v. 质疑；对……提出异议 | v. 争夺；参加竞选
definition_en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win | to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result | to compete for a position, prize, or political seat
example1_en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
example1_ja: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。
example2_en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
example2_ja: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。
collocations: enter a contest｜参加比赛 ; a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛 ; contest a decision｜对决定提出异议 ; contest an election｜参加竞选
tip_ja: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。
meanings_zh: n. 比赛；竞争 | v. 质疑；对……提出异议 | v. 争夺；参加竞选
example1_zh: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。
example2_zh: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。

meanings_ja: n. 主人；主持人 | v. 主办；主持；招待 | n. 大量；许多
definition_en: someone who welcomes guests or presents a programme or event | to organise an event, present a programme, or receive guests | a large number of people or things
example1_en: Our host welcomed us with warm bread and tea.
example1_ja: 主人用热面包和茶欢迎我们。
example2_en: Cities that host international sporting events often invest heavily in transport infrastructure and visitor accommodation.
example2_ja: 举办国际体育赛事的城市往往在交通基础设施和游客住宿方面投入大量资金。
collocations: host country｜东道国 ; host an event｜举办活动 ; a host of problems｜一大堆问题 ; television host｜电视节目主持人
tip_ja: a host of后接复数名词，表示“大量”。
meanings_zh: n. 主人；主持人 | v. 主办；主持；招待 | n. 大量；许多
example1_zh: 主人用热面包和茶欢迎我们。
example2_zh: 举办国际体育赛事的城市往往在交通基础设施和游客住宿方面投入大量资金。

meanings_ja: adj. 商定的；达成一致的
definition_en: accepted or decided by everyone involved
example1_en: We met outside the station at the agreed time.
example1_ja: 我们在商定的时间于车站外见了面。
example2_en: All participating countries should follow the agreed targets to ensure that collective efforts reduce carbon emissions.
example2_ja: 所有参与国都应遵循商定的目标，确保共同努力能够减少碳排放。
collocations: agreed time｜商定的时间 ; agreed terms｜商定的条款 ; agreed price｜议定价格 ; be agreed on｜就……达成一致
tip_ja: the agreed price指议定价格；Agreed!可表示赞同。
meanings_zh: adj. 商定的；达成一致的
example1_zh: 我们在商定的时间于车站外见了面。
example2_zh: 所有参与国都应遵循商定的目标，确保共同努力能够减少碳排放。

meanings_ja: adj. 备用的；空闲的 | v. 抽出；分出 | v. 使免遭；饶恕
definition_en: extra and available to use when needed | to give time or resources that you can make available | to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty
example1_en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
example1_ja: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。
example2_en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
example2_ja: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。
collocations: spare time｜空闲时间 ; spare key｜备用钥匙 ; spare parts｜备件 ; spare a moment｜抽出一点时间
tip_ja: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。
meanings_zh: adj. 备用的；空闲的 | v. 抽出；分出 | v. 使免遭；饶恕
example1_zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。
example2_zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

meanings_ja: n. 示意图；图解 | v. 用图解表示
definition_en: a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged | to explain or represent something using a simple drawing
example1_en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
example1_ja: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。
example2_en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
example2_ja: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。
collocations: draw a diagram｜画示意图 ; a labelled diagram｜带标注的示意图 ; a flow diagram｜流程图
tip_ja: 侧重结构或原理的图解，不等同于数据图表。
meanings_zh: n. 示意图；图解 | v. 用图解表示
example1_zh: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。
example2_zh: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。

meanings_ja: n. 防晒霜
definition_en: A cream or lotion that protects skin from sunlight.
example1_en: Put some sunblock on your shoulders before swimming.
example1_ja: 游泳前在肩膀上涂些防晒霜。
example2_en: Using sunblock alongside protective clothing can reduce skin damage during prolonged exposure to sunlight.
example2_ja: 长时间暴露在阳光下时，涂抹防晒霜并穿戴防护衣物可以减少皮肤损伤。
collocations: apply sunblock｜涂防晒霜 ; wear sunblock｜涂着防晒霜 ; water-resistant sunblock｜防水防晒霜
tip_ja: 通常不可数；名称不意味着能完全阻挡紫外线。
meanings_zh: n. 防晒霜
example1_zh: 游泳前在肩膀上涂些防晒霜。
example2_zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下时，涂抹防晒霜并穿戴防护衣物可以减少皮肤损伤。

meanings_ja: n. 皮艇 | v. 划皮艇
definition_en: A narrow boat moved with a paddle having two blades. | To travel across water in a kayak.
example1_en: She paddled her kayak gently across the quiet lake.
example1_ja: 她轻轻划着皮艇穿过平静的湖面。
example2_en: Exploring coastal areas by kayak allows tourists to enjoy natural scenery without producing engine noise.
example2_ja: 乘皮艇探索沿海地区，让游客能在不产生发动机噪声的情况下欣赏自然风光。
collocations: a sea kayak｜海上皮艇 ; paddle a kayak｜划皮艇 ; go kayaking｜去划皮艇
tip_ja: kayak通常用双叶桨；canoe通常用单叶桨。
meanings_zh: n. 皮艇 | v. 划皮艇
example1_zh: 她轻轻划着皮艇穿过平静的湖面。
example2_zh: 乘皮艇探索沿海地区，让游客能在不产生发动机噪声的情况下欣赏自然风光。

meanings_ja: n. 全套服装 | v. 装备；配备 | n. 团队；公司
definition_en: A set of clothes worn together for a particular occasion. | To provide someone or something with necessary equipment or clothes. | A group or organization working together, used informally.
example1_en: She chose a bright outfit for her birthday party.
example1_ja: 她为自己的生日聚会挑了一套鲜艳的衣服。
example2_en: Schools should outfit science laboratories with modern equipment so that students can develop practical research skills.
example2_ja: 学校应为科学实验室配备现代设备，让学生能够培养实际研究技能。
collocations: casual outfit｜休闲装 ; matching outfit｜搭配协调的全套服装 ; outfit something with equipment｜为某物配备设备
tip_ja: 一套衣服可说an outfit；动词常接with。
meanings_zh: n. 全套服装 | v. 装备；配备 | n. 团队；公司
example1_zh: 她为自己的生日聚会挑了一套鲜艳的衣服。
example2_zh: 学校应为科学实验室配备现代设备，让学生能够培养实际研究技能。

meanings_ja: n. 壁橱；储藏间 | adj. 隐藏身份或兴趣的
definition_en: A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings | Keeping a particular identity, belief, or interest secret
example1_en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
example1_ja: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。
example2_en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
example2_ja: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。
collocations: built-in closet｜嵌入式壁橱 ; walk-in closet｜步入式衣帽间 ; closet space｜壁橱空间
tip_ja: 衣物收纳义多见于美式英语；英式常用wardrobe。
meanings_zh: n. 壁橱；储藏间 | adj. 隐藏身份或兴趣的
example1_zh: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。
example2_zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。

meanings_ja: n. 标题；小标题 | n. 航向
definition_en: words introducing the subject of a document or section | the direction in which a ship or aircraft travels
example1_en: Write a clear heading at the top of your page.
example1_ja: 在页面顶部写一个清晰的标题。
example2_en: Clear headings help readers locate relevant information quickly, making lengthy academic reports easier to navigate and understand.
example2_ja: 清晰的小标题帮助读者快速找到相关信息，让长篇学术报告更便于查阅和理解。
collocations: a section heading｜章节标题 ; a main heading｜主标题 ; under the heading｜在该标题下
tip_ja: heading常指章节标题；headline多指新闻标题。
meanings_zh: n. 标题；小标题 | n. 航向
example1_zh: 在页面顶部写一个清晰的标题。
example2_zh: 清晰的小标题帮助读者快速找到相关信息，让长篇学术报告更便于查阅和理解。

meanings_ja: n. 基础；依据 | n. 方式；频率
definition_en: The main facts or ideas supporting something. | The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.
example1_en: These fresh vegetables form the basis of our soup.
example1_ja: 这些新鲜蔬菜是我们这锅汤的主要食材。
example2_en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
example2_ja: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。
collocations: on a daily basis｜每天 ; on the basis of｜根据 ; form the basis of｜构成……的基础 ; a sound basis｜坚实的基础
tip_ja: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。
meanings_zh: n. 基础；依据 | n. 方式；频率
example1_zh: 这些新鲜蔬菜是我们这锅汤的主要食材。
example2_zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

meanings_ja: n. 生物学家
definition_en: A scientist who studies living things.
example1_en: The biologist carefully examined a frog beside the pond.
example1_ja: 那位生物学家在池塘边仔细观察一只青蛙。
example2_en: A marine biologist can help coastal communities understand how pollution affects local fish populations.
example2_ja: 海洋生物学家可以帮助沿海社区了解污染如何影响当地鱼类种群。
collocations: marine biologist｜海洋生物学家 ; wildlife biologist｜野生生物学家 ; evolutionary biologist｜进化生物学家
tip_ja: 研究海洋生物的专家称为marine biologist。
meanings_zh: n. 生物学家
example1_zh: 那位生物学家在池塘边仔细观察一只青蛙。
example2_zh: 海洋生物学家可以帮助沿海社区了解污染如何影响当地鱼类种群。

meanings_ja: v. 雇用 | v. 使用；采用
definition_en: Pay someone to work for you. | Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.
example1_en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
example1_ja: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。
example2_en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
example2_ja: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: employ staff｜雇用员工 ; employ someone as｜雇用某人担任 ; employ a strategy｜采用策略
tip_ja: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。
meanings_zh: v. 雇用 | v. 使用；采用
example1_zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。
example2_zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

meanings_ja: n. 笼子 | v. 把……关进笼子
definition_en: a container with bars or wire for keeping animals inside | to put or keep an animal in a cage
example1_en: The rabbit's cage has fresh hay and clean water.
example1_ja: 兔笼里有新鲜的干草和干净的水。
example2_en: Animal welfare groups argue that small cages prevent birds from flying freely and expressing natural behaviour.
example2_ja: 动物福利组织认为，小笼子使鸟类无法自由飞翔和表现自然行为。
collocations: bird cage｜鸟笼 ; wire cage｜铁丝笼 ; keep in a cage｜关在笼子里
tip_ja: in a cage表示在笼中；caged birds指笼养鸟。
meanings_zh: n. 笼子 | v. 把……关进笼子
example1_zh: 兔笼里有新鲜的干草和干净的水。
example2_zh: 动物福利组织认为，小笼子使鸟类无法自由飞翔和表现自然行为。

meanings_ja: n. 心情；情绪 | n. 气氛；氛围
definition_en: the way someone feels at a particular time | the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates
example1_en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
example1_ja: 散一小会儿步通常就能让我的心情好一些。
example2_en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
example2_ja: 能够享用绿地可以改善居民心情，促进城市社区内更积极的互动。
collocations: in a good mood｜心情好 ; in the mood for｜有心情做…… ; mood swings｜情绪波动 ; set the mood｜营造气氛
tip_ja: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。
meanings_zh: n. 心情；情绪 | n. 气氛；氛围
example1_zh: 散一小会儿步通常就能让我的心情好一些。
example2_zh: 能够享用绿地可以改善居民心情，促进城市社区内更积极的互动。

meanings_ja: n. 视力；视觉 | n. 看见；视野 | n. 景象；名胜
definition_en: The ability to see. | The act of seeing or the area that can be seen. | Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.
example1_en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
example1_ja: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。
example2_en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
example2_ja: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。
collocations: lose one's sight｜失明 ; out of sight｜在视野之外 ; at first sight｜乍一看 ; the sights｜名胜景点
tip_ja: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。
meanings_zh: n. 视力；视觉 | n. 看见；视野 | n. 景象；名胜
example1_zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。
example2_zh: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。

meanings_ja: v. 安装；设置 | v. 正式任命；使就职
definition_en: to put equipment or software in place for use | to formally place someone in an important position
example1_en: We hired an electrician to install the new ceiling fan.
example1_ja: 我们请了一位电工来安装新吊扇。
example2_en: Schools need sufficient funding to install reliable internet connections and maintain essential digital equipment.
example2_ja: 学校需要充足的资金来安装可靠的网络连接，并维护必要的数字设备。
collocations: install software｜安装软件 ; install solar panels｜安装太阳能板 ; install an alarm｜安装警报器
tip_ja: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。
meanings_zh: v. 安装；设置 | v. 正式任命；使就职
example1_zh: 我们请了一位电工来安装新吊扇。
example2_zh: 学校需要充足的资金来安装可靠的网络连接，并维护必要的数字设备。

meanings_ja: n. 历史学家；史学研究者
definition_en: Someone who studies or writes about the past.
example1_en: The historian examined an old map under a lamp.
example1_ja: 这位历史学家在灯下仔细查看一张旧地图。
example2_en: Historians use a range of sources to explain how industrialisation transformed everyday life in urban communities.
example2_ja: 历史学家利用多种资料解释工业化如何改变城市社区的日常生活。
collocations: a leading historian｜杰出的历史学家 ; a social historian｜社会史学家 ; a historian of science｜科学史学家
tip_ja: historian指研究者；historical表示与历史有关。
meanings_zh: n. 历史学家；史学研究者
example1_zh: 这位历史学家在灯下仔细查看一张旧地图。
example2_zh: 历史学家利用多种资料解释工业化如何改变城市社区的日常生活。

meanings_ja: v. 使恼怒；使烦躁
definition_en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.
example1_en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
example1_ja: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。
example2_en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
example2_ja: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。
collocations: annoy someone｜惹某人生气 ; annoyed with someone｜生某人的气 ; annoying habit｜烦人的习惯
tip_ja: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。
meanings_zh: v. 使恼怒；使烦躁
example1_zh: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。
example2_zh: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。

meanings_ja: adv. 进一步；更远地 | adj. 更多的；进一步的 | v. 促进；推进
definition_en: to a greater degree or a more distant place | additional or more advanced | to help something develop or succeed
example1_en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
example1_ja: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。
example2_en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
example2_ja: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。
collocations: further information｜更多信息 ; further research｜进一步研究 ; discuss further｜进一步讨论 ; further your career｜促进职业发展
tip_ja: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。
meanings_zh: adv. 进一步；更远地 | adj. 更多的；进一步的 | v. 促进；推进
example1_zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。
example2_zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。

meanings_ja: n. 体检；健康检查
definition_en: a medical examination to assess your general health
example1_en: I booked a check-up because I felt unusually tired.
example1_ja: 我因为感到异常疲倦，预约了一次体检。
example2_en: Regular check-ups can help doctors detect health problems before they require more expensive treatment.
example2_ja: 定期体检有助于医生在健康问题需要更昂贵的治疗之前发现它们。
collocations: annual check-up｜年度体检 ; dental check-up｜牙齿检查 ; routine check-up｜常规体检
tip_ja: check-up是名词；check up on意为查看或核查。
meanings_zh: n. 体检；健康检查
example1_zh: 我因为感到异常疲倦，预约了一次体检。
example2_zh: 定期体检有助于医生在健康问题需要更昂贵的治疗之前发现它们。

meanings_ja: adj. 焦虑的；压力大的 | adj. 重读的 | adj. 受应力的
definition_en: Feeling worried and unable to relax | Pronounced with greater emphasis than surrounding sounds | Experiencing physical force that may cause strain or damage
example1_en: I felt stressed before my first driving lesson.
example1_ja: 第一次上驾驶课之前，我感到很紧张。
example2_en: Students who feel stressed during examinations may benefit from regular exercise and adequate sleep.
example2_ja: 在考试期间感到焦虑的学生，可能会从规律运动和充足睡眠中受益。
collocations: feel stressed｜感到有压力 ; stressed about exams｜为考试焦虑 ; a stressed syllable｜重读音节 ; highly stressed components｜承受高应力的部件
tip_ja: 也可作stress的过去式或过去分词，表示“强调”。
meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；压力大的 | adj. 重读的 | adj. 受应力的
example1_zh: 第一次上驾驶课之前，我感到很紧张。
example2_zh: 在考试期间感到焦虑的学生，可能会从规律运动和充足睡眠中受益。

meanings_ja: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
definition_en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy
example1_en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
example1_ja: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。
example2_en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
example2_ja: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。
collocations: enjoyable experience｜愉快的经历 ; enjoyable activity｜有趣的活动 ; highly enjoyable｜非常令人愉快的 ; an enjoyable evening｜愉快的夜晚
tip_ja: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。
meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
example1_zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。
example2_zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

meanings_ja: n. 一系列；连续的一组 | n. 系列节目；丛书
definition_en: several related things or events following one another | a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject
example1_en: A series of small delays made us miss lunch.
example1_ja: 接连几次小耽搁让我们错过了午饭。
example2_en: The university introduced a series of workshops to help students evaluate information found on social media.
example2_ja: 这所大学推出了一系列研讨课，帮助学生评估社交媒体上的信息。
collocations: a series of events｜一连串事件 ; a television series｜电视系列节目 ; a lecture series｜系列讲座
tip_ja: 单复数同形：a series；two series。
meanings_zh: n. 一系列；连续的一组 | n. 系列节目；丛书
example1_zh: 接连几次小耽搁让我们错过了午饭。
example2_zh: 这所大学推出了一系列研讨课，帮助学生评估社交媒体上的信息。

meanings_ja: n. 汗；汗水 | v. 出汗
definition_en: Liquid produced by your skin when hot or nervous. | To produce liquid through your skin.
example1_en: Sweat ran down my face during the steep climb.
example1_ja: 爬那段陡坡时，汗水顺着我的脸流下来。
example2_en: People who exercise in hot weather lose water through sweat and should drink regularly.
example2_ja: 在炎热天气里锻炼的人会因出汗而流失水分，应定时饮水。
collocations: break into a sweat｜突然出汗 ; wipe away sweat｜擦去汗水 ; sweat heavily｜大量出汗
tip_ja: 汗水通常不可数；出一身汗可说a sweat。
meanings_zh: n. 汗；汗水 | v. 出汗
example1_zh: 爬那段陡坡时，汗水顺着我的脸流下来。
example2_zh: 在炎热天气里锻炼的人会因出汗而流失水分，应定时饮水。

meanings_ja: adj. 特定的；某一的 | adj. 特别的；格外的 | adj. 讲究的；挑剔的
definition_en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation | greater or more noticeable than usual | having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy
example1_en: Are you looking for any particular book today?
example1_ja: 你今天是在找某一本特定的书吗？
example2_en: Schools should pay particular attention to students who lack access to digital resources at home.
example2_ja: 学校应特别关注那些在家中无法获得数字资源的学生。
collocations: a particular reason｜某个特定原因 ; particular attention｜特别关注 ; in particular｜尤其；特别 ; particular about｜对……很讲究
tip_ja: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。
meanings_zh: adj. 特定的；某一的 | adj. 特别的；格外的 | adj. 讲究的；挑剔的
example1_zh: 你今天是在找某一本特定的书吗？
example2_zh: 学校应特别关注那些在家中无法获得数字资源的学生。

meanings_ja: v. 狩猎；猎捕 | v. 搜寻；寻找 | n. 搜寻；狩猎
definition_en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them | to search carefully for someone or something | an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals
example1_en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
example1_ja: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。
example2_en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
example2_ja: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。
collocations: hunt for food｜觅食 ; hunt for a job｜找工作 ; a treasure hunt｜寻宝活动 ; hunt wild animals｜猎捕野生动物
tip_ja: 猎捕动物可直接接宾语；寻找物品常用hunt for。
meanings_zh: v. 狩猎；猎捕 | v. 搜寻；寻找 | n. 搜寻；狩猎
example1_zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。
example2_zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。

meanings_ja: v. 導く、案内する、〜につながる | v. 先頭に立つ、リードする | n. 首位、リード、優位 | n. 主役、主演 | n. 鉛
definition_en: to guide people, or to cause something to happen | to be ahead of others in a race or competition | the position of being ahead of others | the main part in a play or film, or the person who plays it | a soft, heavy, grey metal that can be poisonous
example1_en: Our guide led us safely through the forest.
example1_ja: ガイドは私たちを無事に森の中へ案内してくれた。
example2_en: Poor access to public transport can lead to greater dependence on private cars.
example2_ja: 公共交通機関の便が悪いと、自家用車への依存が高まるおそれがある。
collocations: lead to｜〜につながる、〜を引き起こす ; lead a team｜チームを率いる ; take the lead｜主導権を握る、リードする ; lead poisoning｜鉛中毒
tip_ja: 名詞「鉛」は /led/、動詞は /liːd/。過去形・過去分詞 led は /led/。
forms: 三人称単数現在: leads | 現在分詞: leading | 過去形: led | 過去分詞: led
grammar_note: 動詞は /liːd/、不規則変化の led は /led/ で、名詞「鉛」と同じ発音になります。
meanings_zh: v. 带领；引导；导致
example1_zh: 向导带着我们安全地穿过了森林。
example2_zh: 公共交通不便可能导致人们更加依赖私家车。
collocations_zh: 导致 ; 带领团队 ; 取得领先 ; 铅中毒
tip_zh: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。

meanings_ja: v. 忽视；不理睬
definition_en: Pay no attention to someone or something
example1_en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
example1_ja: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。
example2_en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
example2_ja: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。
collocations: ignore a warning｜无视警告 ; ignore the evidence｜无视证据 ; completely ignore｜完全不理会
tip_ja: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。
meanings_zh: v. 忽视；不理睬
example1_zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。
example2_zh: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。

meanings_ja: adv. 经常；定期地 | adv. 均匀地；有规律地
definition_en: often or at repeated intervals | with equal spaces or a consistent pattern
example1_en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
example1_ja: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。
example2_en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
example2_ja: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。
collocations: exercise regularly｜经常锻炼 ; check regularly｜定期检查 ; regularly updated｜定期更新的 ; regularly spaced｜间距均匀的
tip_ja: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。
meanings_zh: adv. 经常；定期地 | adv. 均匀地；有规律地
example1_zh: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。
example2_zh: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。

meanings_ja: n. 临时照看孩子的人
definition_en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away.
example1_en: The babysitter read a story while the children ate.
example1_ja: 孩子们吃东西时，临时保姆给他们读了一个故事。
example2_en: Finding a reliable babysitter can help parents balance occasional evening commitments with their childcare responsibilities.
example2_ja: 找到可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间事务和照顾孩子的责任。
collocations: hire a babysitter｜雇用临时保姆 ; reliable babysitter｜可靠的临时保姆 ; find a babysitter｜找人临时照看孩子
tip_ja: 通常指临时照看孩子的人，不只照顾婴儿。
meanings_zh: n. 临时照看孩子的人
example1_zh: 孩子们吃东西时，临时保姆给他们读了一个故事。
example2_zh: 找到可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间事务和照顾孩子的责任。

meanings_ja: adj. 紧急的；急迫的
definition_en: Needing immediate attention or action
example1_en: The plumber came quickly because the leak was urgent.
example1_ja: 漏水急需处理，所以水管工很快就赶来了。
example2_en: There is an urgent need for affordable housing as urban populations continue to grow.
example2_ja: 随着城市人口持续增长，人们迫切需要负担得起的住房。
collocations: urgent action｜紧急行动 ; an urgent need｜迫切的需要 ; urgent medical attention｜紧急医疗救治
tip_ja: urgent强调必须立即处理，不仅是重要。
meanings_zh: adj. 紧急的；急迫的
example1_zh: 漏水急需处理，所以水管工很快就赶来了。
example2_zh: 随着城市人口持续增长，人们迫切需要负担得起的住房。

meanings_ja: v. 扣紧；系牢；固定
definition_en: to close or attach something securely
example1_en: Please fasten your seat belt before we leave.
example1_ja: 出发前请系好安全带。
example2_en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts during takeoff and landing to reduce the risk of injury.
example2_ja: 乘客在飞机起飞和降落时必须系好安全带，以降低受伤风险。
collocations: fasten a seat belt｜系好安全带 ; fasten a button｜扣好纽扣 ; fasten securely｜牢牢固定
tip_ja: t不发音；反义词unfasten表示解开。
meanings_zh: v. 扣紧；系牢；固定
example1_zh: 出发前请系好安全带。
example2_zh: 乘客在飞机起飞和降落时必须系好安全带，以降低受伤风险。

meanings_ja: n. 作用；职责 | n. 角色
definition_en: The function or responsibility someone or something has. | A character played by an actor in a performance.
example1_en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
example1_ja: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。
example2_en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
example2_ja: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用 ; a key role｜关键作用 ; take on a role｜承担职责 ; a leading role｜主角
tip_ja: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。
meanings_zh: n. 作用；职责 | n. 角色
example1_zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。
example2_zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

meanings_ja: v. 幸存；存活 | v. 继续存在；挺过 | v. 比…活得长
definition_en: stay alive despite danger, illness, or hardship | continue to exist after difficulties or changes | live longer than another person
example1_en: Our little cactus survived three weeks without water.
example1_ja: 我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。
example2_en: Small businesses are more likely to survive economic downturns when they maintain strong relationships with local customers.
example2_ja: 小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。
collocations: survive an accident｜在事故中幸存 ; survive on｜靠…维生 ; survive a crisis｜挺过危机
tip_ja: 表示从事故中幸存，直接说survive an accident。
meanings_zh: v. 幸存；存活 | v. 继续存在；挺过 | v. 比…活得长
example1_zh: 我们的小仙人掌三个星期没浇水也活下来了。
example2_zh: 小企业若与本地顾客保持牢固联系，就更有可能挺过经济低迷期。

meanings_ja: n. 平衡；均衡 | v. 保持平衡；兼顾 | n. 账户余额；结欠款
definition_en: A steady position or a suitable mixture of different things | To keep something steady or give competing needs suitable attention | The money remaining in an account or still owed
example1_en: She lost her balance while stepping off the bus.
example1_ja: 她下公交车时失去了平衡。
example2_en: Governments must balance the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect green spaces.
example2_ja: 政府必须兼顾人们对可负担住房的需求和保护绿地的需要。
collocations: keep your balance｜保持平衡 ; strike a balance｜取得平衡 ; work-life balance｜工作与生活的平衡 ; bank balance｜银行账户余额
tip_ja: 兼顾两者用balance A with B；均衡饮食用balanced。
meanings_zh: n. 平衡；均衡 | v. 保持平衡；兼顾 | n. 账户余额；结欠款
example1_zh: 她下公交车时失去了平衡。
example2_zh: 政府必须兼顾人们对可负担住房的需求和保护绿地的需要。

meanings_ja: v. 作弊 | v. 欺骗；骗取 | n. 作弊者；骗子
definition_en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage. | To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly. | A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.
example1_en: My cousin cheated by hiding cards under the table.
example1_ja: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。
example2_en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
example2_ja: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。
collocations: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊 ; cheat at cards｜打牌作弊 ; cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip_ja: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。
meanings_zh: v. 作弊 | v. 欺骗；骗取 | n. 作弊者；骗子
example1_zh: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。
example2_zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。

meanings_ja: n. 蜥蜴
definition_en: a reptile with a long tail, usually with four legs
example1_en: A tiny lizard rested on the warm garden wall.
example1_ja: 一只小蜥蜴趴在花园里温暖的墙上。
example2_en: Protecting rocky habitats helps preserve lizard populations, which play an important role in controlling insects.
example2_ja: 保护岩石栖息地有助于维持蜥蜴种群，它们在控制昆虫数量方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: small lizard｜小蜥蜴 ; lizard species｜蜥蜴物种 ; lizard habitat｜蜥蜴栖息地
tip_ja: lizard是可数名词，复数为lizards。
meanings_zh: n. 蜥蜴
example1_zh: 一只小蜥蜴趴在花园里温暖的墙上。
example2_zh: 保护岩石栖息地有助于维持蜥蜴种群，它们在控制昆虫数量方面发挥着重要作用。

meanings_ja: n. 离开；出发 | n. 背离；改变
definition_en: The act of leaving a place. | A change from what is usual or expected.
example1_en: We packed our bags the night before departure.
example1_ja: 我们在出发前一晚收拾好了行李。
example2_en: The new housing policy represents a significant departure from previous approaches to urban development.
example2_ja: 这项新的住房政策与以往的城市发展思路有了显著不同。
collocations: departure time｜出发时间 ; departure lounge｜候机厅 ; a departure from tradition｜对传统的突破
tip_ja: departure from可指“从……出发”或“背离……”。
meanings_zh: n. 离开；出发 | n. 背离；改变
example1_zh: 我们在出发前一晚收拾好了行李。
example2_zh: 这项新的住房政策与以往的城市发展思路有了显著不同。

meanings_ja: n. 经济；经济体 | n. 节约；节省
definition_en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services | careful use of money, time, or resources to avoid waste
example1_en: Tourists support the local economy by shopping here.
example1_ja: 游客在这里购物，为当地经济提供支持。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can strengthen the economy while reducing dependence on imported fuels.
example2_ja: 投资可再生能源可以增强经济实力，同时减少对进口燃料的依赖。
collocations: local economy｜地方经济 ; global economy｜全球经济 ; boost the economy｜提振经济 ; fuel economy｜燃油经济性
tip_ja: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。
meanings_zh: n. 经济；经济体 | n. 节约；节省
example1_zh: 游客在这里购物，为当地经济提供支持。
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以增强经济实力，同时减少对进口燃料的依赖。

meanings_ja: n. 安全；安全保障 | n. 安保人员；保安工作 | n. 稳定；保障
definition_en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access | People or activities responsible for protecting a place | Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support
example1_en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
example1_ja: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。
example2_en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
example2_ja: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。
collocations: security measures｜安全措施 ; data security｜数据安全 ; job security｜工作保障 ; security guard｜保安
tip_ja: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。
meanings_zh: n. 安全；安全保障 | n. 安保人员；保安工作 | n. 稳定；保障
example1_zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。
example2_zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。

meanings_ja: n. 文化；习俗 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
example1_ja: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。
example2_en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
example2_ja: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_ja: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。
meanings_zh: n. 文化；习俗 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
example1_zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。
example2_zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

meanings_ja: n. 个性；性格 | n. 个人魅力 | n. 名人
definition_en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves | lively or appealing qualities that make someone interesting | a well-known person, especially in entertainment or broadcasting
example1_en: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
example1_ja: 她开朗的性格让每位来吃饭的人都感到受欢迎。
example2_en: Schools should recognise that differences in personality can influence how students participate in group activities.
example2_ja: 学校应认识到，性格差异会影响学生参与集体活动的方式。
collocations: outgoing personality｜外向的性格 ; personality traits｜性格特征 ; strong personality｜鲜明的个性 ; television personality｜电视名人
tip_ja: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。
meanings_zh: n. 个性；性格 | n. 个人魅力 | n. 名人
example1_zh: 她开朗的性格让每位来吃饭的人都感到受欢迎。
example2_zh: 学校应认识到，性格差异会影响学生参与集体活动的方式。

meanings_ja: v. 击败；战胜 | n. 失败；失利 | v. 挫败；使落空
definition_en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict | an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict | to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding
example1_en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
example1_ja: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。
example2_en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
example2_ja: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。
collocations: defeat an opponent｜击败对手 ; suffer a defeat｜遭遇失败 ; admit defeat｜承认失败 ; defeat the purpose｜使目的落空
tip_ja: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。
meanings_zh: v. 击败；战胜 | n. 失败；失利 | v. 挫败；使落空
example1_zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。
example2_zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。

meanings_ja: n. 射击；射门；投篮 | n. 照片；镜头 | n. 尝试
definition_en: an act of firing a weapon or sending a ball | a photograph or a continuous piece of filmed action | an attempt to achieve or do something
example1_en: Her final shot sent the ball into the net.
example1_ja: 她最后一脚射门把球踢进了球网。
example2_en: A carefully chosen shot can communicate the effects of environmental damage more powerfully than statistics.
example2_ja: 一张精心挑选的照片，比统计数据更能有力地传达环境破坏的影响。
collocations: take a shot｜射门；拍照 ; a close-up shot｜特写镜头 ; give it a shot｜试一试 ; a shot at success｜成功的机会
tip_ja: give it a shot表示试一试；shot也是shoot的过去式。
meanings_zh: n. 射击；射门；投篮 | n. 照片；镜头 | n. 尝试
example1_zh: 她最后一脚射门把球踢进了球网。
example2_zh: 一张精心挑选的照片，比统计数据更能有力地传达环境破坏的影响。

meanings_ja: adj. 职位较低的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
definition_en: Having a lower rank or less experience in an organisation | Intended for younger people or involving them | A younger person, or a student below the final year
example1_en: Our junior chef prepares vegetables before the restaurant opens.
example1_ja: 我们餐厅的初级厨师在开门营业前准备蔬菜。
example2_en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
example2_ja: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。
collocations: junior staff｜初级员工 ; junior position｜初级职位 ; junior championship｜青少年锦标赛
tip_ja: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。
meanings_zh: adj. 职位较低的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
example1_zh: 我们餐厅的初级厨师在开门营业前准备蔬菜。
example2_zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

meanings_ja: adj. 全球的；世界性的 | adj. 整体的；全面的
definition_en: Involving or affecting the whole world. | Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.
example1_en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
example1_ja: 老师给我们看了一张全球气温分布图。
example2_en: Global cooperation is essential for tackling climate change because environmental damage rarely respects national borders.
example2_ja: 全球合作对于应对气候变化至关重要，因为环境破坏很少受国界限制。
collocations: global warming｜全球变暖 ; global economy｜全球经济 ; global cooperation｜全球合作 ; global perspective｜全球视角
tip_ja: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。
meanings_zh: adj. 全球的；世界性的 | adj. 整体的；全面的
example1_zh: 老师给我们看了一张全球气温分布图。
example2_zh: 全球合作对于应对气候变化至关重要，因为环境破坏很少受国界限制。

meanings_ja: n. 抱怨；投诉 | n. 疾病；不适
definition_en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory | an illness or physical problem
example1_en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
example1_ja: 她投诉汤是凉的。
example2_en: Local authorities should investigate residents' complaints about noise before approving new entertainment venues in residential areas.
example2_ja: 地方政府在批准住宅区内的新娱乐场所前，应调查居民关于噪声的投诉。
collocations: make a complaint｜提出投诉 ; a formal complaint｜正式投诉 ; handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip_ja: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。
meanings_zh: n. 抱怨；投诉 | n. 疾病；不适
example1_zh: 她投诉汤是凉的。
example2_zh: 地方政府在批准住宅区内的新娱乐场所前，应调查居民关于噪声的投诉。

meanings_ja: adj. 不断增加的；日益增长的
definition_en: becoming greater in amount, size, number, or degree
example1_en: The increasing noise outside made it hard to sleep.
example1_ja: 外面越来越大的噪声让人难以入睡。
example2_en: Increasing demand for clean energy is encouraging governments to invest more heavily in renewable technologies and infrastructure.
example2_ja: 对清洁能源日益增长的需求正促使各国政府加大对可再生能源技术和基础设施的投资。
collocations: increasing demand｜日益增长的需求 ; increasing pressure｜越来越大的压力 ; an increasing number of｜越来越多的 ; increasing concern｜日益加深的担忧
tip_ja: increasing修饰名词；increasingly修饰形容词等。
meanings_zh: adj. 不断增加的；日益增长的
example1_zh: 外面越来越大的噪声让人难以入睡。
example2_zh: 对清洁能源日益增长的需求正促使各国政府加大对可再生能源技术和基础设施的投资。

meanings_ja: v. 挖；掘 | v. 探究；深入搜寻 | n. 考古发掘
definition_en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something | Search carefully for hidden information | An organized activity to uncover ancient objects in the ground
example1_en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
example1_ja: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。
example2_en: Researchers dig into historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of rapid environmental change.
example2_ja: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。
collocations: dig a hole｜挖坑 ; dig up｜挖出 ; dig into｜深入探究 ; an archaeological dig｜考古发掘
tip_ja: 过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。
meanings_zh: v. 挖；掘 | v. 探究；深入搜寻 | n. 考古发掘
example1_zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。
example2_zh: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。

meanings_ja: n. 生产；制造 | n. 制作；演出作品
definition_en: the process of making or growing things for use | the making of a film or play, or the resulting work
example1_en: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
example1_ja: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。
example2_en: Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
example2_ja: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。
collocations: mass production｜大规模生产 ; food production｜食品生产 ; production costs｜生产成本 ; film production｜电影制作
tip_ja: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。
meanings_zh: n. 生产；制造 | n. 制作；演出作品
example1_zh: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。
example2_zh: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。

meanings_ja: n. 位置；姿势 | n. 职位；地位；立场 | v. 放置；安置
definition_en: where something is or how a body is arranged | a job, social rank, or opinion on an issue | to put someone or something in a particular place
example1_en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
example1_ja: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
example2_en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
example2_ja: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。
collocations: sitting position｜坐姿 ; apply for a position｜申请职位 ; take a position on｜对……表明立场 ; position carefully｜小心放置
tip_ja: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。
meanings_zh: n. 位置；姿势 | n. 职位；地位；立场 | v. 放置；安置
example1_zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
example2_zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。

meanings_ja: n. 自助餐厅；食堂
definition_en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.
example1_en: We carried our lunch trays to the cafeteria window.
example1_ja: 我们端着午餐托盘走到食堂窗边。
example2_en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating habits by offering affordable meals with fresh vegetables and fruit.
example2_ja: 学校食堂可以提供价格实惠、含新鲜蔬菜水果的餐食，促进更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: a school cafeteria｜学校食堂 ; a hospital cafeteria｜医院食堂 ; a cafeteria tray｜食堂托盘
tip_ja: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。
meanings_zh: n. 自助餐厅；食堂
example1_zh: 我们端着午餐托盘走到食堂窗边。
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供价格实惠、含新鲜蔬菜水果的餐食，促进更健康的饮食习惯。

meanings_ja: n. 蘑菇 | v. 迅速增长；迅速涌现
definition_en: A fungus often shaped like an umbrella; some are edible. | Grow or increase very quickly.
example1_en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
example1_ja: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。
example2_en: Online learning platforms have mushroomed as demand for flexible and affordable education has increased worldwide.
example2_ja: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。
collocations: mushroom soup｜蘑菇汤 ; wild mushrooms｜野生蘑菇 ; mushroom into a large business｜迅速发展成大企业
tip_ja: 作动词表示迅速增长，不接直接宾语。
meanings_zh: n. 蘑菇 | v. 迅速增长；迅速涌现
example1_zh: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。
example2_zh: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。

meanings_ja: n. 模式；规律 | n. 图案；花纹
definition_en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done. | An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.
example1_en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
example1_ja: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。
example2_en: Researchers analyse patterns of energy consumption to identify opportunities for reducing waste in households.
example2_ja: 研究人员分析能源消耗模式，以寻找减少家庭能源浪费的机会。
collocations: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式 ; sleep patterns｜睡眠规律 ; a floral pattern｜花卉图案 ; follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip_ja: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。
meanings_zh: n. 模式；规律 | n. 图案；花纹
example1_zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。
example2_zh: 研究人员分析能源消耗模式，以寻找减少家庭能源浪费的机会。

meanings_ja: n. 仆人；佣人
definition_en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home
example1_en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
example1_ja: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。
example2_en: In wealthy households of the past, servants often worked long hours with little legal protection.
example2_ja: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。
collocations: domestic servant｜家佣 ; civil servant｜公务员 ; public servant｜公职人员
tip_ja: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。
meanings_zh: n. 仆人；佣人
example1_zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。
example2_zh: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。

meanings_ja: n. 液体 | adj. 液态的 | adj. 易变现的；流动的
definition_en: A substance that flows and takes the shape of its container. | In a form that flows freely rather than remaining solid. | Available as cash or easily converted into cash.
example1_en: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
example1_ja: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。
example2_en: Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
example2_ja: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。
collocations: clear liquid｜透明液体 ; liquid water｜液态水 ; liquid soap｜洗手液 ; liquid assets｜流动资产
tip_ja: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。
meanings_zh: n. 液体 | adj. 液态的 | adj. 易变现的；流动的
example1_zh: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。
example2_zh: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。

meanings_ja: n. 曲调；旋律 | v. 为乐器调音 | v. 调节；调谐
definition_en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern | to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes | to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly
example1_en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
example1_ja: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。
example2_en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
example2_ja: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。
collocations: catchy tune｜朗朗上口的曲调 ; in tune｜音调准确 ; out of tune｜走调 ; tune a piano｜给钢琴调音
tip_ja: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。
meanings_zh: n. 曲调；旋律 | v. 为乐器调音 | v. 调节；调谐
example1_zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。
example2_zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。

meanings_ja: n. 肉贩；肉类分割工 | v. 屠宰；分割肉类 | v. 把……弄糟
definition_en: someone who prepares and sells meat | to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat | to do something very badly, spoiling the result
example1_en: The butcher wrapped our chicken and suggested a simple recipe.
example1_ja: 肉贩把我们的鸡肉包好，还推荐了一个简单的做法。
example2_en: A local butcher can help customers reduce food waste by recommending suitable cuts and portion sizes.
example2_ja: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。
collocations: local butcher｜当地肉贩 ; butcher's shop｜肉店 ; butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip_ja: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。
meanings_zh: n. 肉贩；肉类分割工 | v. 屠宰；分割肉类 | v. 把……弄糟
example1_zh: 肉贩把我们的鸡肉包好，还推荐了一个简单的做法。
example2_zh: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。

meanings_ja: n. 种子 | v. 播种
definition_en: A small part of a plant that can grow into another. | Put seeds into soil so that plants will grow.
example1_en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
example1_ja: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。
example2_en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
example2_ja: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。
collocations: sow seeds｜播种 ; plant a seed｜种下一粒种子 ; sunflower seeds｜葵花籽 ; seed bank｜种子库
tip_ja: sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。
meanings_zh: n. 种子 | v. 播种
example1_zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。
example2_zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。

meanings_ja: n. 周年纪念日
definition_en: A date marking another year since an important event.
example1_en: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
example1_ja: 我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。
example2_en: The museum celebrated its anniversary by offering free admission to encourage more residents to explore local history.
example2_ja: 博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。
collocations: wedding anniversary｜结婚纪念日 ; celebrate an anniversary｜庆祝周年纪念日 ; mark an anniversary｜纪念周年
tip_ja: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。
meanings_zh: n. 周年纪念日
example1_zh: 我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。
example2_zh: 博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。

meanings_ja: adj. 向后的；倒退的 | adv. 向后；倒着 | adj. 发展落后的
definition_en: Directed towards the back or away from progress. | Towards the back or in the reverse direction. | Less developed or advanced than expected.
example1_en: He took a backward step to avoid the puddle.
example1_ja: 他向后退了一步，以避开水坑。
example2_en: Reducing investment in public transport would be a backward step for cities seeking to cut emissions.
example2_ja: 对于力求减排的城市而言，减少公共交通投资将是一种倒退。
collocations: a backward step｜倒退的一步 ; a backward glance｜回头一瞥 ; move backward｜向后移动
tip_ja: 英式副词常用 backwards；用来形容人落后可能冒犯。
meanings_zh: adj. 向后的；倒退的 | adv. 向后；倒着 | adj. 发展落后的
example1_zh: 他向后退了一步，以避开水坑。
example2_zh: 对于力求减排的城市而言，减少公共交通投资将是一种倒退。

meanings_ja: n. 典礼；仪式 | n. 礼节；客套
definition_en: A formal event marking an important occasion. | Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.
example1_en: We attended a small wedding ceremony by the lake.
example1_ja: 我们参加了湖边一场小型婚礼。
example2_en: A graduation ceremony allows students and families to celebrate educational achievements together as a community.
example2_ja: 毕业典礼让学生和家人齐聚一堂，共同庆祝学业成就。
collocations: opening ceremony｜开幕式 ; graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; without ceremony｜不拘礼节地
tip_ja: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。
meanings_zh: n. 典礼；仪式 | n. 礼节；客套
example1_zh: 我们参加了湖边一场小型婚礼。
example2_zh: 毕业典礼让学生和家人齐聚一堂，共同庆祝学业成就。

meanings_ja: n. 呼吸
definition_en: the process of taking air into and out of the lungs
example1_en: After the steep climb, my breathing slowly returned to normal.
example1_ja: 爬完陡坡后，我的呼吸慢慢恢复了正常。
example2_en: Regular breathing exercises may help students manage stress and improve their concentration during demanding periods of study.
example2_ja: 定期进行呼吸练习可能有助于学生缓解压力，并在学习紧张时期提高专注力。
collocations: deep breathing｜深呼吸 ; breathing exercises｜呼吸练习 ; breathing difficulties｜呼吸困难 ; heavy breathing｜粗重的呼吸
tip_ja: breathing可作名词，也是breathe的现在分词。
meanings_zh: n. 呼吸
example1_zh: 爬完陡坡后，我的呼吸慢慢恢复了正常。
example2_zh: 定期进行呼吸练习可能有助于学生缓解压力，并在学习紧张时期提高专注力。

meanings_ja: n. 名人；明星 | n. 名望；名气
definition_en: A person who is widely known by the public. | The state of being famous.
example1_en: A celebrity stopped outside the theatre to greet fans.
example1_ja: 一位明星在剧院外停下脚步，与粉丝打招呼。
example2_en: Celebrity endorsements can influence young consumers, so advertisements should clearly distinguish personal opinions from paid promotion.
example2_ja: 名人代言可能影响年轻消费者，因此广告应明确区分个人观点与付费推广。
collocations: celebrity endorsement｜名人代言 ; celebrity culture｜名人文化 ; achieve celebrity｜成名
tip_ja: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。
meanings_zh: n. 名人；明星 | n. 名望；名气
example1_zh: 一位明星在剧院外停下脚步，与粉丝打招呼。
example2_zh: 名人代言可能影响年轻消费者，因此广告应明确区分个人观点与付费推广。

meanings_ja: adj. 相关的；有联系的 | adj. 有亲属关系的
definition_en: connected with something in some way | belonging to the same family
example1_en: These two problems are related to the same broken pipe.
example1_ja: 这两个问题都与同一根破裂的管道有关。
example2_en: Many health problems are closely related to poor housing conditions and limited access to nutritious food.
example2_ja: 许多健康问题与恶劣的住房条件及难以获取营养食物密切相关。
collocations: related to｜与……有关 ; closely related｜密切相关的 ; related issues｜相关问题 ; related by marriage｜有姻亲关系的
tip_ja: 常用be related to；to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
meanings_zh: adj. 相关的；有联系的 | adj. 有亲属关系的
example1_zh: 这两个问题都与同一根破裂的管道有关。
example2_zh: 许多健康问题与恶劣的住房条件及难以获取营养食物密切相关。

meanings_ja: adj. 无用的；无效的
definition_en: Not useful or unable to achieve the intended result
example1_en: This broken umbrella is useless in heavy rain.
example1_ja: 这把坏伞在大雨中根本不管用。
example2_en: Collecting environmental data is useless unless governments use the findings to guide effective policies.
example2_ja: 收集环境数据毫无用处，除非政府利用研究结果来指导制定有效政策。
collocations: completely useless｜完全无用的 ; useless at｜不擅长 ; render something useless｜使某物失去作用
tip_ja: useless at后接名词或动名词，表示不擅长。
meanings_zh: adj. 无用的；无效的
example1_zh: 这把坏伞在大雨中根本不管用。
example2_zh: 收集环境数据毫无用处，除非政府利用研究结果来指导制定有效政策。

meanings_ja: n. 狂欢节；嘉年华 | n. 游乐会
definition_en: A public celebration with music, costumes, and street entertainment. | An outdoor event with rides, games, and entertainment.
example1_en: We wore colourful masks and danced at the carnival.
example1_ja: 我们戴着彩色面具，在嘉年华上跳舞。
example2_en: An annual carnival can strengthen community ties while attracting visitors who support local shops and restaurants.
example2_ja: 一年一度的嘉年华可以加强社区联系，同时吸引游客光顾当地商店和餐馆。
collocations: a carnival parade｜嘉年华游行 ; a carnival atmosphere｜狂欢气氛 ; an annual carnival｜年度嘉年华
tip_ja: 美式英语中也可指有游戏和游乐设施的游乐会。
meanings_zh: n. 狂欢节；嘉年华 | n. 游乐会
example1_zh: 我们戴着彩色面具，在嘉年华上跳舞。
example2_zh: 一年一度的嘉年华可以加强社区联系，同时吸引游客光顾当地商店和餐馆。

meanings_ja: adj. 平均的；普通的 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional. | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
example1_ja: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。
example2_en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
example2_ja: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_ja: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。
meanings_zh: adj. 平均的；普通的 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
example1_zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。
example2_zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

meanings_ja: adj. 上下颠倒的；倒置的
definition_en: Positioned with the usual top at the bottom
example1_en: An upside-down bowl covered the last slice of cake.
example1_ja: 一个倒扣的碗盖住了最后一块蛋糕。
example2_en: In a classroom experiment, students used an upside-down glass of water to explore the effects of air pressure.
example2_ja: 在一次课堂实验中，学生用一杯倒置的水来探究气压的作用。
collocations: an upside-down image｜上下颠倒的图像 ; an upside-down bowl｜倒扣的碗 ; turn something upside down｜把某物倒置
tip_ja: 名词前常加连字符；表语或副词通常写upside down。
meanings_zh: adj. 上下颠倒的；倒置的
example1_zh: 一个倒扣的碗盖住了最后一块蛋糕。
example2_zh: 在一次课堂实验中，学生用一杯倒置的水来探究气压的作用。

meanings_ja: n. 图书馆员
definition_en: A person who manages library resources and helps library users.
example1_en: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
example1_ja: 图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。
example2_en: School librarians support independent learning by teaching students how to locate reliable sources and evaluate information.
example2_ja: 学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。
collocations: school librarian｜学校图书馆员 ; chief librarian｜图书馆馆长 ; ask a librarian｜咨询图书馆员
tip_ja: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。
meanings_zh: n. 图书馆员
example1_zh: 图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。
example2_zh: 学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。

meanings_ja: n. 汽油
definition_en: A liquid fuel used in cars and other engines.
example1_en: We stopped to buy gasoline before crossing the desert.
example1_ja: 穿越沙漠之前，我们停车加了汽油。
example2_en: Higher gasoline prices may encourage commuters to share cars or switch to public transport.
example2_ja: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者拼车或改乘公共交通。
collocations: gasoline prices｜汽油价格 ; gasoline engine｜汽油发动机 ; unleaded gasoline｜无铅汽油
tip_ja: 美式英语用gasoline，口语常说gas；英式通常用petrol。
meanings_zh: n. 汽油
example1_zh: 穿越沙漠之前，我们停车加了汽油。
example2_zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者拼车或改乘公共交通。

meanings_ja: n. 动物；生物 | n. 虚构生物；怪物
definition_en: a living being, especially an animal | an imaginary being with unusual physical features
example1_en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
example1_ja: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。
example2_en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
example2_ja: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。
collocations: a sea creature｜海洋生物 ; a living creature｜活的生物 ; a mythical creature｜神话生物
tip_ja: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。
meanings_zh: n. 动物；生物 | n. 虚构生物；怪物
example1_zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。
example2_zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。

meanings_ja: v. 删除
definition_en: To remove written material or stored information.
example1_en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
example1_ja: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。
example2_en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
example2_ja: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。
collocations: delete a file｜删除文件 ; delete an account｜删除账户 ; permanently delete｜永久删除
tip_ja: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。
meanings_zh: v. 删除
example1_zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。
example2_zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。

meanings_ja: adj. 起始的；最初的 | n. 开始；启动
definition_en: Relating to the point where something begins | The act of beginning something or making it operate
example1_en: We gathered at the starting point before sunrise.
example1_ja: 日出前，我们在起点集合。
example2_en: A fair starting salary can help employers attract talented graduates and improve long-term staff retention.
example2_ja: 公平的起薪可以帮助雇主吸引优秀毕业生，并提高员工的长期留任率。
collocations: a starting point｜起点 ; a starting salary｜起薪 ; the starting line｜起跑线 ; a starting position｜起始位置
tip_ja: 常见于starting point；也可作start的分词。
meanings_zh: adj. 起始的；最初的 | n. 开始；启动
example1_zh: 日出前，我们在起点集合。
example2_zh: 公平的起薪可以帮助雇主吸引优秀毕业生，并提高员工的长期留任率。

meanings_ja: prep. 除……之外还 | adv. 而且；再说
definition_en: In addition to someone or something. | Used to add another fact or supporting reason.
example1_en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
example1_ja: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。
example2_en: Besides reducing air pollution, investment in public transport can make cities more accessible to older residents.
example2_ja: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。
collocations: besides that｜除此之外 ; besides being｜除了是……之外 ; besides the fact that｜除了……这一事实之外
tip_ja: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。
meanings_zh: prep. 除……之外还 | adv. 而且；再说
example1_zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。
example2_zh: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。

meanings_ja: n. 发明物 | n. 发明；创造 | n. 虚构的事；编造
definition_en: something new that someone has designed or created | the act of creating something that did not exist before | a story or explanation created rather than based on facts
example1_en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
example1_ja: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。
example2_en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
example2_ja: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。
collocations: a useful invention｜实用的发明 ; the invention of｜……的发明 ; a recent invention｜近期的发明
tip_ja: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。
meanings_zh: n. 发明物 | n. 发明；创造 | n. 虚构的事；编造
example1_zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。
example2_zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。

meanings_ja: v. 分开；劈开；分担 | n. 裂缝；分裂；分歧
definition_en: To divide something into parts, or separate into groups | A crack, division, or serious disagreement
example1_en: We split the cake and shared it with our neighbours.
example1_ja: 我们把蛋糕切开，分给了邻居。
example2_en: Schools sometimes split large classes into smaller groups to provide more individual attention and support.
example2_ja: 学校有时会把大班分成小组，以提供更多个别关注和支持。
collocations: split into groups｜分成小组 ; split the cost｜分摊费用 ; split in two｜分成两半 ; a deep split｜严重分歧
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为split；现在分词为splitting。
meanings_zh: v. 分开；劈开；分担 | n. 裂缝；分裂；分歧
example1_zh: 我们把蛋糕切开，分给了邻居。
example2_zh: 学校有时会把大班分成小组，以提供更多个别关注和支持。

meanings_ja: n. 金字塔；棱锥体 | n. 金字塔式体系
definition_en: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point | a system with fewer members at each successively higher level
example1_en: We built a small pyramid out of wooden blocks.
example1_ja: 我们用木块搭了一座小金字塔。
example2_en: The management pyramid in many organisations places a small group of executives above numerous employees.
example2_ja: 许多机构的金字塔式管理结构将少数高管置于众多员工之上。
collocations: ancient pyramid｜古代金字塔 ; square-based pyramid｜四棱锥 ; management pyramid｜管理金字塔
tip_ja: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。
meanings_zh: n. 金字塔；棱锥体 | n. 金字塔式体系
example1_zh: 我们用木块搭了一座小金字塔。
example2_zh: 许多机构的金字塔式管理结构将少数高管置于众多员工之上。

meanings_ja: n. 惊险小说；惊悚片
definition_en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.
example1_en: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
example1_ja: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。
example2_en: A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
example2_ja: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。
collocations: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品 ; a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品 ; a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip_ja: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。
meanings_zh: n. 惊险小说；惊悚片
example1_zh: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。
example2_zh: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。

meanings_ja: adj. 超重的
definition_en: heavier than is considered healthy, suitable, or officially allowed
example1_en: My suitcase was overweight, so I removed some books.
example1_ja: 我的行李箱超重了，所以我拿出了一些书。
example2_en: People who are overweight may benefit from accessible exercise facilities and practical advice on balanced diets.
example2_ja: 体重超标的人可能受益于便利的健身设施和有关均衡饮食的实用建议。
collocations: be slightly overweight｜略微超重 ; overweight luggage｜超重行李 ; become overweight｜变得超重
tip_ja: 常作形容词；obese指肥胖，程度更重。
meanings_zh: adj. 超重的
example1_zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以我拿出了一些书。
example2_zh: 体重超标的人可能受益于便利的健身设施和有关均衡饮食的实用建议。

meanings_ja: n. 奢华；奢侈的享受 | n. 奢侈品；非必需的享受 | adj. 奢华的；高档的
definition_en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions. | Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential. | Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.
example1_en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
example1_ja: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。
example2_en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
example2_ja: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。
collocations: live in luxury｜过奢华生活 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; luxury hotel｜豪华酒店 ; afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip_ja: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。
meanings_zh: n. 奢华；奢侈的享受 | n. 奢侈品；非必需的享受 | adj. 奢华的；高档的
example1_zh: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。
example2_zh: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。

meanings_ja: n. 稻草；麦秆 | n. 吸管
definition_en: Dried cereal stems used for animal bedding and other purposes. | A narrow tube used for drinking liquids.
example1_en: The farmer spread fresh straw across the barn floor.
example1_ja: 农民在谷仓地上铺了一层新鲜的麦秆。
example2_en: Replacing plastic straws with reusable alternatives can reduce waste, although wider changes in consumption remain necessary.
example2_ja: 用可重复使用的替代品取代塑料吸管能减少废物，但仍需更广泛地改变消费方式。
collocations: a bale of straw｜一捆稻草 ; a straw hat｜一顶草帽 ; a drinking straw｜一根饮用吸管 ; the last straw｜令人忍无可忍的最后一击
tip_ja: 作稻草时不可数，作吸管时可数；hay指干草饲料。
meanings_zh: n. 稻草；麦秆 | n. 吸管
example1_zh: 农民在谷仓地上铺了一层新鲜的麦秆。
example2_zh: 用可重复使用的替代品取代塑料吸管能减少废物，但仍需更广泛地改变消费方式。

meanings_ja: adj. 不能的；无法的
definition_en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.
example1_en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
example1_ja: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。
example2_en: Without affordable internet access, many students are unable to participate fully in online learning programmes.
example2_ja: 如果没有负担得起的网络服务，许多学生就无法充分参与在线学习课程。
collocations: be unable to attend｜无法出席 ; be unable to afford｜负担不起 ; be unable to cope｜无法应付
tip_ja: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。
meanings_zh: adj. 不能的；无法的
example1_zh: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。
example2_zh: 如果没有负担得起的网络服务，许多学生就无法充分参与在线学习课程。

meanings_ja: n. 祝贺；贺词
definition_en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.
example1_en: We sent our congratulations when she passed her driving test.

meanings_ja: n. 食欲；胃口 | n. 强烈欲望；渴求

meanings_zh: n. 新闻标题 | v. 成为头条新闻；领衔演出

meanings_ja: v. 考虑；仔细斟酌 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到

example2_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

meanings_ja: n. 赊购；信贷 | n. 赞扬；认可 | n. 学分

example2_en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
example2_ja: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: buy on credit｜赊购 ; give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳 ; earn credits｜修得学分 ; credit card｜信用卡

meanings_zh: n. 赊购；信贷 | n. 赞扬；认可 | n. 学分

meanings_ja: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩盖；掩饰

example2_en: Rapid economic growth can mask serious inequalities in access to education and healthcare.

meanings_zh: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩盖；掩饰

meanings_ja: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围

meanings_ja: adj. 身体不舒服的；不舒适的 | adj. 不自在的；不安的

definition_en: in a way that is easy to see or understand
example1_en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
example1_ja: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。
example2_en: Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.
example2_ja: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。
collocations: obviously pleased｜明显很高兴 ; obviously wrong｜显然错误 ; obviously important｜显然重要
tip_ja: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。
meanings_zh: adv. 显然；明显地
example1_zh: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。

meanings_ja: n. 燕麦粥；麦片粥
definition_en: A thick breakfast dish made by cooking oats in liquid.
example1_en: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
example1_ja: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。
example2_en: Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
example2_ja: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。
collocations: a bowl of porridge｜一碗燕麦粥 ; porridge oats｜煮粥用燕麦片 ; make porridge｜煮燕麦粥
tip_ja: 通常为不可数名词；一碗用a bowl of。
meanings_zh: n. 燕麦粥；麦片粥
example1_zh: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。
example2_zh: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。

meanings_ja: v. 冲浪 | v. 浏览互联网 | n. 拍岸浪花
definition_en: to ride ocean waves while standing or lying on a board | to browse websites, often without a specific purpose | waves and white foam breaking near the shore
example1_en: My cousin learned to surf during our beach holiday.
example1_ja: 我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。
example2_en: Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
example2_ja: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。
collocations: learn to surf｜学习冲浪 ; surf the internet｜浏览互联网 ; surf the waves｜踏浪冲浪
tip_ja: surf the internet指上网浏览，不一定有明确搜索目标。
meanings_zh: v. 冲浪 | v. 浏览互联网 | n. 拍岸浪花
example1_zh: 我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。
example2_zh: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。

meanings_ja: adv. 大约；粗略地 | adv. 粗暴地；粗糙地
definition_en: approximately, rather than exactly | in a forceful, careless, or uneven manner
example1_en: The walk to the lake takes roughly twenty minutes.
example1_ja: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。
example2_en: Roughly half of the residents surveyed supported replacing the old car park with a public garden.
example2_ja: 受访居民中约有一半支持将旧停车场改为公共花园。
collocations: roughly equal｜大致相等 ; roughly speaking｜大体而言 ; treat roughly｜粗暴对待
tip_ja: 表示“大约”时常放在数量前；也可指动作粗暴。
meanings_zh: adv. 大约；粗略地 | adv. 粗暴地；粗糙地
example1_zh: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。
example2_zh: 受访居民中约有一半支持将旧停车场改为公共花园。

meanings_ja: n. 聚会；联欢会
definition_en: an informal meeting of friends, relatives, or colleagues
example1_en: We're having a small get-together at our flat tonight.
example1_ja: 今晚我们要在公寓里办个小聚会。
example2_en: A regular neighbourhood get-together can strengthen social ties and help new residents feel more welcome.
example2_ja: 定期举办邻里聚会能加强社会联系，让新住户更有归属感。
collocations: family get-together｜家庭聚会 ; informal get-together｜非正式聚会 ; organise a get-together｜组织聚会
tip_ja: 名词带连字符；动词短语get together不带。
meanings_zh: n. 聚会；联欢会
example1_zh: 今晚我们要在公寓里办个小聚会。
example2_zh: 定期举办邻里聚会能加强社会联系，让新住户更有归属感。

meanings_ja: n. 磁盘；计算机存储盘 | n. 圆盘；盘状物
definition_en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface | a flat, thin, round object
example1_en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
example1_ja: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。
example2_en: Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.
example2_ja: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。
collocations: hard disk｜硬盘 ; disk space｜磁盘空间 ; disk drive｜磁盘驱动器 ; disk failure｜磁盘故障
tip_ja: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。
meanings_zh: n. 磁盘；计算机存储盘 | n. 圆盘；盘状物
example1_zh: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。
example2_zh: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。

meanings_ja: n. 托盘；浅盘
definition_en: A flat container with raised edges for carrying or holding things
example1_en: She carried two cups of tea on a wooden tray.
example1_ja: 她用木托盘端着两杯茶。
example2_en: Replacing disposable food trays with reusable alternatives can significantly reduce waste in school cafeterias.
example2_ja: 用可重复使用的餐盘替代一次性餐盘，可以显著减少学校食堂的垃圾。
collocations: a serving tray｜上菜托盘 ; a baking tray｜烤盘 ; an ice cube tray｜冰块模具 ; a tray of drinks｜一托盘饮料
tip_ja: tray 通常有浅边，可指端餐托盘或烤盘。
meanings_zh: n. 托盘；浅盘
example1_zh: 她用木托盘端着两杯茶。
example2_zh: 用可重复使用的餐盘替代一次性餐盘，可以显著减少学校食堂的垃圾。

meanings_ja: n. 蚊子
definition_en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.
example1_en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
example1_ja: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.
example2_ja: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。
collocations: mosquito bite｜蚊子叮咬 ; mosquito net｜蚊帐 ; mosquito repellent｜驱蚊剂
tip_ja: 复数可写mosquitoes或mosquitos。
meanings_zh: n. 蚊子
example1_zh: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。
example2_zh: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。

meanings_ja: adv. 其次；第二
definition_en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.
example1_en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
example1_ja: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。
example2_en: Secondly, expanding public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
example2_ja: 其次，扩大公共交通覆盖范围可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地获得就业机会。
collocations: firstly and secondly｜首先和其次 ; secondly, consider｜其次，考虑
tip_ja: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。
meanings_zh: adv. 其次；第二
example1_zh: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。
example2_zh: 其次，扩大公共交通覆盖范围可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

meanings_ja: n. 边；边缘 | n. 优势 | v. 缓慢移动
definition_en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface. | A quality that makes someone or something more competitive. | To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.
example1_en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
example1_ja: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。
example2_en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
example2_ja: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。
collocations: on the edge of｜在……边缘 ; a competitive edge｜竞争优势 ; have an edge over｜比……有优势 ; edge towards｜慢慢向……移动
tip_ja: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。
meanings_zh: n. 边；边缘 | n. 优势 | v. 缓慢移动
example1_zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。
example2_zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

meanings_ja: n. 运输；交通运输系统
definition_en: Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.
example1_en: We arranged transportation from the airport to our hotel.
example1_ja: 我们安排了从机场到酒店的接送。
example2_en: Reliable public transportation can reduce traffic congestion and make employment opportunities more accessible to people without cars.
example2_ja: 可靠的公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，让没有汽车的人更容易获得就业机会。
collocations: public transportation｜公共交通 ; transportation costs｜运输费用 ; transportation network｜交通运输网络 ; transportation of goods｜货物运输
tip_ja: 美式常用transportation，英式通常用transport。
meanings_zh: n. 运输；交通运输系统
example1_zh: 我们安排了从机场到酒店的接送。
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，让没有汽车的人更容易获得就业机会。

meanings_ja: prep. 经由；途经 | prep. 通过；借助
definition_en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere | using a particular method, system, or person
example1_en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
example1_ja: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。
example2_en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
example2_ja: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。
collocations: travel via｜途经 ; via email｜通过电子邮件 ; via satellite｜通过卫星
tip_ja: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。
meanings_zh: prep. 经由；途经 | prep. 通过；借助
example1_zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。
example2_zh: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。

meanings_ja: n. 改善；进步 | n. 改进之处
definition_en: The process or result of becoming better. | A change that makes something better.
example1_en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
example1_ja: 你最近这幅画的明暗处理确实有进步。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.
example2_ja: 投资公共交通能显著改善空气质量，并缩短城市居民的出行时间。
collocations: significant improvement｜显著改善 ; room for improvement｜改进空间 ; an improvement on｜比…更好的事物 ; make improvements｜作出改进
tip_ja: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。
meanings_zh: n. 改善；进步 | n. 改进之处
example1_zh: 你最近这幅画的明暗处理确实有进步。
example2_zh: 投资公共交通能显著改善空气质量，并缩短城市居民的出行时间。

meanings_ja: v. 给…下定义；解释含义 | v. 明确规定；界定 | v. 构成…的特征
definition_en: To state exactly what a word or idea means. | To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly. | To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.
example1_en: Can you define this word without using a dictionary?
example1_ja: 你能不用词典解释这个词的含义吗？
example2_en: Governments should clearly define their environmental objectives before introducing policies that affect businesses and local communities.
example2_ja: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。
collocations: define a term｜给术语下定义 ; clearly define｜明确界定 ; define the scope｜界定范围 ; define as｜将…定义为
tip_ja: define A as B表示“将A定义为B”。
meanings_zh: v. 给…下定义；解释含义 | v. 明确规定；界定 | v. 构成…的特征
example1_zh: 你能不用词典解释这个词的含义吗？
example2_zh: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。

meanings_ja: n. 铁轨；铁路运输 | n. 栏杆；扶手；横杆 | v. 愤怒抱怨；严厉指责
definition_en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train | a horizontal bar used for support or as a barrier | to complain angrily and strongly about something
example1_en: We travelled by rail through the snowy mountains.
example1_ja: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.
example2_ja: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。
collocations: travel by rail｜乘火车出行 ; rail network｜铁路网 ; hold onto the rail｜抓住扶手 ; rail against｜愤怒地指责
tip_ja: by rail表示乘火车，不加冠词；动词常接against。
meanings_zh: n. 铁轨；铁路运输 | n. 栏杆；扶手；横杆 | v. 愤怒抱怨；严厉指责
example1_zh: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_zh: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。

meanings_ja: n. 笨蛋；蠢人（骂人话）
definition_en: An insulting word for someone considered very foolish.
example1_en: I felt like an idiot after losing my keys again.
example1_ja: 再次弄丢钥匙后，我觉得自己真是个笨蛋。
example2_en: Calling a classmate an idiot can damage their confidence and undermine efforts to create a supportive learning environment.
example2_ja: 骂同学是笨蛋会打击其自信，也会破坏营造互助学习环境的努力。
collocations: feel like an idiot｜觉得自己很傻 ; a complete idiot｜十足的笨蛋
tip_ja: 带侮辱性，不是描述智力障碍的医学用语。
meanings_zh: n. 笨蛋；蠢人（骂人话）
example1_zh: 再次弄丢钥匙后，我觉得自己真是个笨蛋。
example2_zh: 骂同学是笨蛋会打击其自信，也会破坏营造互助学习环境的努力。

meanings_ja: n. 勇气；胆量
definition_en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
example1_en: It took courage to admit my mistake in class.
example1_ja: 在课堂上承认自己的错误需要勇气。
example2_en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
example2_ja: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_ja: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。
meanings_zh: n. 勇气；胆量
example1_zh: 在课堂上承认自己的错误需要勇气。
example2_zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

meanings_ja: n. 划独木舟运动
definition_en: the activity of travelling in a canoe using a paddle
example1_en: We went canoeing on the lake before lunch.
example1_ja: 午饭前，我们去湖上划了独木舟。
example2_en: Outdoor activities such as canoeing can improve physical fitness while encouraging young people to appreciate natural environments.
example2_ja: 划独木舟等户外活动可以增强体能，同时鼓励年轻人欣赏自然环境。
collocations: go canoeing｜去划独木舟 ; canoeing trip｜独木舟之旅 ; canoeing equipment｜划独木舟装备
tip_ja: 常用go canoeing；canoe加-ing时保留e。
meanings_zh: n. 划独木舟运动
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们去湖上划了独木舟。
example2_zh: 划独木舟等户外活动可以增强体能，同时鼓励年轻人欣赏自然环境。

meanings_ja: v. 处理；应付 | v. 拿；触摸；操纵 | n. 把手；柄
definition_en: To deal with a situation, task, or person. | To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands. | The part of an object used for holding or moving it.
example1_en: Can you handle dinner while I collect the children?
example1_ja: 我去接孩子，你能负责准备晚饭吗？
example2_en: Healthcare workers need effective training to handle stressful situations while maintaining a high standard of care.
example2_ja: 医护人员需要有效的培训，以便应对压力大的情况，同时保持高水平的护理质量。
collocations: handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; handle with care｜小心轻放 ; door handle｜门把手 ; handle pressure｜应对压力
tip_ja: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。
meanings_zh: v. 处理；应付 | v. 拿；触摸；操纵 | n. 把手；柄
example1_zh: 我去接孩子，你能负责准备晚饭吗？
example2_zh: 医护人员需要有效的培训，以便应对压力大的情况，同时保持高水平的护理质量。

meanings_ja: v. 交换；兑换 | n. 交换；交流 | n. 交易所
definition_en: to give something and receive something else in return | an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas | a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded
example1_en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
example1_ja: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？
example2_en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
example2_ja: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。
collocations: exchange ideas｜交流想法 ; exchange rate｜汇率 ; in exchange for｜作为……的交换 ; stock exchange｜证券交易所
tip_ja: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。
meanings_zh: v. 交换；兑换 | n. 交换；交流 | n. 交易所
example1_zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？
example2_zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。

meanings_ja: adj. 满意的；满足的 | adj. 确信的；信服的
definition_en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations. | Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.
example1_en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
example1_ja: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。
example2_en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
example2_ja: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。
collocations: satisfied with｜对……满意 ; fully satisfied｜完全满意 ; satisfied that｜确信……
tip_ja: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。
meanings_zh: adj. 满意的；满足的 | adj. 确信的；信服的
example1_zh: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。
example2_zh: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。

meanings_ja: adj. 有暴风雨的 | adj. 充满争吵的；激烈的
definition_en: Having strong winds and often heavy rain, thunder, or lightning. | Involving strong emotions, arguments, or disagreement.
example1_en: We stayed indoors because the weather was so stormy.
example1_ja: 因为外面风雨交加，我们待在了室内。
example2_en: Increasingly stormy conditions may disrupt shipping routes and threaten the livelihoods of people in coastal communities.
example2_ja: 日益频繁的暴风雨天气可能扰乱航运路线，并威胁沿海社区居民的生计。
