example1_en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
example1_ja: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。
example2_en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
example2_ja: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。
collocations: make a discovery｜有所发现 ; scientific discovery｜科学发现 ; major discovery｜重大发现 ; accidental discovery｜意外发现
tip_ja: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。
meanings_zh: n. 发现；被发现的事物
example1_zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。
example2_zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。

meanings_ja: n. 过程；程序 | v. 处理；加工
definition_en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result. | Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.
example1_en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
example1_ja: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。
example2_en: The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
example2_ja: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。
collocations: a gradual process｜渐进的过程 ; in the process of｜在……过程中 ; process data｜处理数据 ; processed food｜加工食品
tip_ja: in the process of后接名词或动名词。
meanings_zh: n. 过程；程序 | v. 处理；加工
example1_zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。
example2_zh: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。

meanings_ja: n. 娱乐；娱乐活动
definition_en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.
example1_en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
example1_ja: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。
example2_en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
example2_ja: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。
collocations: live entertainment｜现场娱乐表演 ; the entertainment industry｜娱乐业 ; family entertainment｜适合全家的娱乐 ; a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip_ja: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。
meanings_zh: n. 娱乐；娱乐活动
example1_zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。
example2_zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。

meanings_ja: v. 想知道；琢磨 | n. 惊叹；惊奇 | n. 奇观；奇迹
definition_en: to think about something you do not know | a feeling of surprise and admiration | something unusually impressive or surprising
example1_en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
example1_ja: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
example2_en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
example2_ja: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。
collocations: wonder whether｜想知道是否 ; wonder about｜对……感到好奇 ; in wonder｜惊叹地 ; natural wonders｜自然奇观
tip_ja: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。
meanings_zh: v. 想知道；琢磨 | n. 惊叹；惊奇 | n. 奇观；奇迹
example1_zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
example2_zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

meanings_ja: n. 添加；增加 | n. 加法 | n. 新增事物
definition_en: the act of putting something extra into something | the process of finding the total of quantities | something extra that joins an existing group or collection
example1_en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
example1_ja: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。
example2_en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
example2_ja: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。
collocations: in addition to｜除……之外还 ; the addition of｜……的添加 ; a welcome addition｜受欢迎的新事物 ; simple addition｜简单加法
tip_ja: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。
meanings_zh: n. 添加；增加 | n. 加法 | n. 新增事物
example1_zh: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。
example2_zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。

meanings_ja: v. 递送；送达 | v. 发表；讲授 | v. 兑现；实现
definition_en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination | to give a speech, lecture, or presentation | to produce the results or benefits that were promised
example1_en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
example1_ja: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。
example2_en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
example2_ja: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。
collocations: deliver a parcel｜递送包裹 ; deliver a speech｜发表演讲 ; deliver results｜取得成效 ; deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip_ja: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。
meanings_zh: v. 递送；送达 | v. 发表；讲授 | v. 兑现；实现
example1_zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。
example2_zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

meanings_ja: adj. 布满灰尘的；多尘的
definition_en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.
example1_en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
example1_ja: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。
example2_en: Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.
example2_ja: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: a dusty road｜尘土飞扬的道路 ; dusty shelves｜积满灰尘的架子 ; a dusty environment｜多尘的环境
tip_ja: dusty形容有灰尘；dust作动词可表示掸去灰尘。
meanings_zh: adj. 布满灰尘的；多尘的
example1_zh: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。
example2_zh: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

meanings_ja: adj. 结冰的；冻硬的 | adj. 冷冻保存的 | adj. 冻僵的；冷极了的
definition_en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold. | Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness. | Feeling extremely cold.
example1_en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
example1_ja: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。
example2_en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
example2_ja: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。
collocations: frozen lake｜结冰的湖 ; frozen food｜冷冻食品 ; frozen solid｜冻得硬邦邦的 ; frozen with fear｜吓得动弹不得
tip_ja: 也是freeze的过去分词；过去式为froze。
meanings_zh: adj. 结冰的；冻硬的 | adj. 冷冻保存的 | adj. 冻僵的；冷极了的
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。
example2_zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。

meanings_ja: v. 发生 | v. 存在；出现 | v. 被想到；浮现于脑海
definition_en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place. | Exist or be found in a particular place or situation. | Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.
example1_en: Power cuts often occur here during heavy winter storms.
example1_ja: 冬季强风暴来袭时，这里经常停电。
example2_en: Traffic accidents are more likely to occur when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
example2_ja: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，交通事故更容易发生。
collocations: occur naturally｜天然存在 ; occur frequently｜频繁发生 ; occur to someone｜被某人想到
tip_ja: 不用于被动语态；过去式occurred，分词occurring。
meanings_zh: v. 发生 | v. 存在；出现 | v. 被想到；浮现于脑海
example1_zh: 冬季强风暴来袭时，这里经常停电。
example2_zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，交通事故更容易发生。

meanings_ja: n. 漂流运动
definition_en: Travelling down a river on a raft for pleasure.
example1_en: We went rafting down a mountain river last weekend.
example1_ja: 上周末我们去一条山间河流漂流了。
example2_en: Rafting can support rural tourism, but operators must provide safety equipment and protect river habitats.
example2_ja: 漂流可以促进乡村旅游，但经营者必须提供安全装备并保护河流栖息地。
collocations: go rafting｜去漂流 ; white-water rafting｜激流漂流 ; rafting trip｜漂流之旅
tip_ja: 运动义常用go rafting；raft也指筏子。
meanings_zh: n. 漂流运动
example1_zh: 上周末我们去一条山间河流漂流了。
example2_zh: 漂流可以促进乡村旅游，但经营者必须提供安全装备并保护河流栖息地。

meanings_ja: adj. 欢乐的；愉快的
definition_en: Cheerful and full of enjoyment.
example1_en: Their merry laughter filled the kitchen as they baked.
example1_ja: 他们烘焙时，欢快的笑声充满了厨房。
example2_en: Community festivals create a merry atmosphere that encourages residents of different ages to interact and build friendships.
example2_ja: 社区节庆营造欢乐的氛围，鼓励不同年龄的居民交流并建立友谊。
collocations: merry laughter｜欢快的笑声 ; a merry crowd｜欢乐的人群 ; make merry｜欢庆作乐
tip_ja: 常形容欢庆气氛；make merry意为欢庆作乐。
meanings_zh: adj. 欢乐的；愉快的
example1_zh: 他们烘焙时，欢快的笑声充满了厨房。
example2_zh: 社区节庆营造欢乐的氛围，鼓励不同年龄的居民交流并建立友谊。

meanings_ja: v. 通知；告知 | v. 影响；为……提供依据
definition_en: To give someone facts or tell them about something. | To provide knowledge that shapes a decision, opinion, or approach.
example1_en: Please inform the receptionist if you lose your key.
example1_ja: 如果你弄丢了钥匙，请告知接待员。
example2_en: Reliable research should inform government decisions about how to allocate funding for public health services.
example2_ja: 政府决定如何分配公共卫生服务资金时，应以可靠的研究为依据。
collocations: inform someone of something｜告知某人某事 ; keep someone informed｜随时告知某人最新情况 ; inform policy｜为政策提供依据
tip_ja: 告知某人某事用inform sb of/about sth。
meanings_zh: v. 通知；告知 | v. 影响；为……提供依据
example1_zh: 如果你弄丢了钥匙，请告知接待员。
example2_zh: 政府决定如何分配公共卫生服务资金时，应以可靠的研究为依据。

meanings_ja: n. 眉毛
definition_en: The curved line of hair above each eye.
example1_en: He raised one eyebrow when he saw the enormous cake.
example1_ja: 看到那个巨大的蛋糕时，他挑起了一边眉毛。
example2_en: Facial movements, such as raising an eyebrow, can communicate surprise without relying on spoken language.
example2_ja: 挑眉等面部动作无需借助口头语言就能表达惊讶。
collocations: raise an eyebrow｜挑眉；表示惊讶 ; thick eyebrows｜浓眉 ; arched eyebrows｜弯弯的眉毛
tip_ja: eyebrow是眉毛；eyelash是睫毛。
meanings_zh: n. 眉毛
example1_zh: 看到那个巨大的蛋糕时，他挑起了一边眉毛。
example2_zh: 挑眉等面部动作无需借助口头语言就能表达惊讶。

meanings_ja: n. 折扣 | v. 打折出售 | v. 不予考虑；低估
definition_en: a reduction in the usual price | to sell something at a reduced price | to consider something unlikely or less important
example1_en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
example1_ja: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。
example2_en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_ja: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。
collocations: offer a discount｜提供折扣 ; at a discount｜以折扣价 ; discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip_ja: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。
meanings_zh: n. 折扣 | v. 打折出售 | v. 不予考虑；低估
example1_zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。
example2_zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。

meanings_ja: n. 鬼魂；幽灵 | n. 一丝；隐约的痕迹
definition_en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive. | A very slight trace of a feeling, expression, or quality.
example1_en: My little cousin dressed as a ghost for the party.
example1_ja: 我的小表弟打扮成幽灵去参加派对。
example2_en: Local ghost stories can attract tourists while revealing how communities interpret their history and cultural traditions.
example2_ja: 当地的鬼故事可以吸引游客，也能反映社区如何理解自身历史与文化传统。
collocations: a ghost story｜鬼故事 ; a ghost town｜废弃的城镇 ; a ghost of a smile｜一丝微笑 ; see a ghost｜看见鬼魂
tip_ja: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。
meanings_zh: n. 鬼魂；幽灵 | n. 一丝；隐约的痕迹
example1_zh: 我的小表弟打扮成幽灵去参加派对。
example2_zh: 当地的鬼故事可以吸引游客，也能反映社区如何理解自身历史与文化传统。

meanings_ja: v. 雇用 | v. 租用 | n. 租用；租借
definition_en: To pay someone to do a job. | To pay to use something for a limited time. | An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.
example1_en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
example1_ja: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。
example2_en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
example2_ja: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。
collocations: hire staff｜雇用员工 ; hire a car｜租车 ; for hire｜供出租 ; car hire｜汽车租赁
tip_ja: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。
meanings_zh: v. 雇用 | v. 租用 | n. 租用；租借
example1_zh: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。
example2_zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。

meanings_ja: adj. 失业的
definition_en: Without a paid job but available for work
example1_en: My neighbour has been unemployed since the factory closed.
example1_ja: 自从工厂关闭后，我的邻居就一直失业。
example2_en: Providing affordable training for unemployed adults can help them develop skills that match changing labour market demands.
example2_ja: 为失业成年人提供负担得起的培训，可以帮助他们掌握符合劳动力市场变化需求的技能。
collocations: become unemployed｜失业 ; unemployed workers｜失业工人 ; the long-term unemployed｜长期失业者
tip_ja: the unemployed指失业者群体，谓语用复数。
meanings_zh: adj. 失业的
example1_zh: 自从工厂关闭后，我的邻居就一直失业。
example2_zh: 为失业成年人提供负担得起的培训，可以帮助他们掌握符合劳动力市场变化需求的技能。

meanings_ja: adj. 积极乐观的；有益的 | adj. 确信的；肯定的 | adj. 阳性的；正数的
definition_en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect. | Completely certain that something is true. | Showing a condition is present, or mathematically greater than zero.
example1_en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
example1_ja: 即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。
example2_en: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.
example2_ja: 经常接触大自然可以对儿童的情绪发展和整体健康产生积极影响。
collocations: positive attitude｜积极的态度 ; positive impact｜积极影响 ; positive result｜阳性结果；良好结果
tip_ja: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。
meanings_zh: adj. 积极乐观的；有益的 | adj. 确信的；肯定的 | adj. 阳性的；正数的
example1_zh: 即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。
example2_zh: 经常接触大自然可以对儿童的情绪发展和整体健康产生积极影响。

meanings_ja: n. 鼓手
definition_en: A person who plays drums, especially in a musical group.
example1_en: The drummer tapped her sticks together before the song.
example1_ja: 歌曲开始前，女鼓手把两根鼓槌相互敲了几下。
example2_en: A skilled drummer helps musicians maintain a steady rhythm, which is essential for a coordinated live performance.
example2_ja: 熟练的鼓手帮助乐手保持稳定节奏，这对现场演出的协调至关重要。
collocations: a skilled drummer｜技艺娴熟的鼓手 ; a jazz drummer｜爵士乐鼓手 ; the band's drummer｜乐队的鼓手
tip_ja: drum加-er构成drummer，注意双写m。
meanings_zh: n. 鼓手
example1_zh: 歌曲开始前，女鼓手把两根鼓槌相互敲了几下。
example2_zh: 熟练的鼓手帮助乐手保持稳定节奏，这对现场演出的协调至关重要。

meanings_ja: v. 分开；分配 | v. 除；除以 | n. 分歧；差距
definition_en: to separate something into parts or share it among people | to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another | a major difference separating people or groups
example1_en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
example1_ja: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。
example2_en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
example2_ja: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。
collocations: divide into groups｜分成小组 ; divide equally｜平均分配 ; divide by｜除以 ; the digital divide｜数字鸿沟
tip_ja: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。
meanings_zh: v. 分开；分配 | v. 除；除以 | n. 分歧；差距
example1_zh: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。
example2_zh: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。

meanings_ja: v. 认出；辨认出 | v. 承认；意识到 | v. 正式认可；表彰
definition_en: to identify someone or something known from before | to accept or understand that something is true or important | to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements
example1_en: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
example1_ja: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。
example2_en: Schools increasingly recognise that regular physical activity can improve both students' health and academic performance.
example2_ja: 学校日益认识到，经常运动能够改善学生的健康状况和学习表现。
collocations: recognise a face｜认出一张脸 ; recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; officially recognise｜正式认可
tip_ja: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。
meanings_zh: v. 认出；辨认出 | v. 承认；意识到 | v. 正式认可；表彰
example1_zh: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。
example2_zh: 学校日益认识到，经常运动能够改善学生的健康状况和学习表现。

meanings_ja: adj. 上面的；上部的 | adj. 较高的；上层的
definition_en: Located above another part or nearer the top. | Higher in rank, level, or position within a range.
example1_en: Keep the spare blankets on the upper shelf.
example1_ja: 把备用毯子放在上层架子上。
example2_en: Residents on the upper floors of apartment buildings may face difficulties when lifts stop working.
example2_ja: 公寓楼高层住户在电梯停运时可能会遇到困难。

meanings_zh: adj. 锋利的；尖的 | adj. 急剧的；显著的 | adj. 敏锐的；机敏的

meanings_zh: adj. 不友善的；刻薄的

meanings_ja: adj. 可接受的；合格的

example2_zh: 便捷可及的医疗服务有助于孕妇在整个孕期获得定期检查和可靠的建议。

meanings_ja: n. 垫子；席子 | v. 使缠结成团
definition_en: A piece of material covering or protecting a surface. | To twist hair or fibres into a thick tangled mass.
example1_en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering.
example1_ja: 进门前请在垫子上擦擦鞋。
example2_en: Placing a rubber mat near each entrance can help prevent slips in busy public buildings.
example2_ja: 在每个入口附近放置橡胶垫，有助于防止人们在繁忙的公共建筑内滑倒。
collocations: a yoga mat｜瑜伽垫 ; a rubber mat｜橡胶垫 ; a bath mat｜浴室地垫 ; an exercise mat｜运动垫
tip_ja: mat通常是小块功能性垫子，不等同于carpet。
meanings_zh: n. 垫子；席子 | v. 使缠结成团
example1_zh: 进门前请在垫子上擦擦鞋。
example2_zh: 在每个入口附近放置橡胶垫，有助于防止人们在繁忙的公共建筑内滑倒。

meanings_ja: v. 按；压 | n. 新闻界；报刊 | v. 催促；敦促
definition_en: Push firmly against something. | Newspapers, magazines, and the journalists who produce them. | Try firmly to persuade someone to do something.
example1_en: Press this button to open the garage door.
example1_ja: 按这个按钮就能打开车库门。
example2_en: A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.
example2_ja: 自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。
collocations: press a button｜按按钮 ; freedom of the press｜新闻自由 ; press conference｜新闻发布会 ; press for change｜敦促改革
tip_ja: 表示新闻界通常用the press；按按钮不用push down。
meanings_zh: v. 按；压 | n. 新闻界；报刊 | v. 催促；敦促
example1_zh: 按这个按钮就能打开车库门。
example2_zh: 自由的新闻界帮助公民了解公共事务，并监督掌权者承担责任。

meanings_ja: v. 说服；劝服 | v. 使相信；使信服
definition_en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons | To make someone believe something is true
example1_en: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
example1_ja: 我说服弟弟加入了我们的步行小组。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can persuade people to adopt healthier habits by explaining the benefits in accessible language.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传可以用通俗语言解释益处，说服人们养成更健康的习惯。
collocations: persuade someone to do something｜说服某人做某事 ; persuade someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; hard to persuade｜难以说服
tip_ja: persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。
meanings_zh: v. 说服；劝服 | v. 使相信；使信服
example1_zh: 我说服弟弟加入了我们的步行小组。
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传可以用通俗语言解释益处，说服人们养成更健康的习惯。

meanings_ja: n. 竞速运动；赛马 | adj. 竞速比赛用的
definition_en: The sport of competing to move faster than others. | Designed or used for races.
example1_en: My cousin enjoys watching bicycle racing on weekend afternoons.
example1_ja: 我表亲喜欢在周末下午看自行车比赛。
example2_en: Professional motor racing encourages technological innovation, but its environmental impact remains a subject of debate.
example2_ja: 职业赛车运动推动技术创新，但其环境影响仍存在争议。
collocations: horse racing｜赛马 ; motor racing｜赛车运动 ; a racing car｜赛车 ; a racing bike｜竞赛自行车
tip_ja: 作运动名称通常不可数；一场比赛用a race。
meanings_zh: n. 竞速运动；赛马 | adj. 竞速比赛用的
example1_zh: 我表亲喜欢在周末下午看自行车比赛。
example2_zh: 职业赛车运动推动技术创新，但其环境影响仍存在争议。

meanings_ja: n. 厕所；洗手间
definition_en: A toilet or a room containing one.
example1_en: The lavatory is just beyond the waiting room.
example1_ja: 洗手间就在候车室另一边。
example2_en: Every passenger carriage should include a lavatory that travellers with limited mobility can access easily.
example2_ja: 每节客车车厢都应设有行动不便的旅客能够轻松使用的洗手间。
collocations: public lavatory｜公共厕所 ; lavatory door｜厕所门 ; lavatory facilities｜卫生间设施
tip_ja: 较正式，常见于英式英语；日常多用toilet。
meanings_zh: n. 厕所；洗手间
example1_zh: 洗手间就在候车室另一边。
example2_zh: 每节客车车厢都应设有行动不便的旅客能够轻松使用的洗手间。

meanings_ja: n. 炸弹 | v. 轰炸；投弹于
definition_en: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage. | To attack a place using bombs.
example1_en: The museum displayed an empty bomb casing behind glass.
example1_ja: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列了一个空炸弹壳。
example2_en: Construction projects may be delayed when workers discover an unexploded bomb left over from a past conflict.
example2_ja: 当工人发现过去冲突遗留的未爆炸弹时，建设项目可能会延期。
collocations: an unexploded bomb｜未爆炸弹 ; defuse a bomb｜拆除炸弹引信 ; a bomb disposal team｜拆弹小组
tip_ja: 词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。
meanings_zh: n. 炸弹 | v. 轰炸；投弹于
example1_zh: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列了一个空炸弹壳。
example2_zh: 当工人发现过去冲突遗留的未爆炸弹时，建设项目可能会延期。

meanings_ja: n. 兽医 | v. 审查；仔细检查
definition_en: a person trained to treat sick or injured animals | to check someone or something carefully before giving approval
example1_en: The vet gently checked our puppy's ears and paws.
example1_ja: 兽医轻柔地检查了我们小狗的耳朵和爪子。
example2_en: Organisations should vet potential employees carefully when recruiting people who will work with children or vulnerable adults.
example2_ja: 组织在招聘将与儿童或弱势成年人接触的人员时，应仔细审查应聘者。
collocations: take a pet to the vet｜带宠物看兽医 ; vet applicants｜审查申请人 ; vetting process｜审查流程
tip_ja: 动词过去式vetted，动名词vetting，均双写t。
meanings_zh: n. 兽医 | v. 审查；仔细检查
example1_zh: 兽医轻柔地检查了我们小狗的耳朵和爪子。
example2_zh: 组织在招聘将与儿童或弱势成年人接触的人员时，应仔细审查应聘者。

meanings_ja: n. 一代人；一代 | n. 产生；发电 | n. 产品的一代
definition_en: people born and living at roughly the same time | the process of producing something, especially electricity | a stage in the development of a product or technology
example1_en: Three generations of our family gathered for dinner yesterday.
example1_ja: 昨天我们家三代人聚在一起吃晚饭。
example2_en: Each generation faces different challenges as technological progress changes the skills required in the workplace.
example2_ja: 随着技术进步改变职场所需的技能，每一代人都面临不同的挑战。
collocations: future generations｜后代 ; generation gap｜代沟 ; electricity generation｜发电 ; younger generation｜年轻一代
tip_ja: 表示“一代人”时可数；表示“产生”时通常不可数。
meanings_zh: n. 一代人；一代 | n. 产生；发电 | n. 产品的一代
example1_zh: 昨天我们家三代人聚在一起吃晚饭。
example2_zh: 随着技术进步改变职场所需的技能，每一代人都面临不同的挑战。

meanings_ja: n. 诊所；门诊部
definition_en: A place providing medical advice or treatment without overnight stays.
example1_en: The clinic near our house opens early on weekdays.
example1_ja: 我们家附近的诊所工作日很早就开门。
example2_en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
example2_ja: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。
collocations: dental clinic｜牙科诊所 ; outpatient clinic｜门诊部 ; attend a clinic｜去门诊就诊
tip_ja: clinic指诊所或门诊部；“临床的”用clinical。
meanings_zh: n. 诊所；门诊部
example1_zh: 我们家附近的诊所工作日很早就开门。
example2_zh: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。

meanings_ja: v. 推迟；延期
definition_en: to arrange for something to happen later than originally planned
example1_en: We postponed our picnic because heavy rain was forecast.
example1_ja: 因为天气预报说有大雨，我们推迟了野餐。
example2_en: Local authorities decided to postpone construction until a full assessment of the environmental impact was completed.
example2_ja: 地方当局决定推迟施工，直到完成全面的环境影响评估。
collocations: postpone a meeting｜推迟会议 ; postpone a decision｜推迟决定 ; postpone until further notice｜延期至另行通知
tip_ja: 后接名词或动名词：postpone doing，不接to do。
meanings_zh: v. 推迟；延期
example1_zh: 因为天气预报说有大雨，我们推迟了野餐。
example2_zh: 地方当局决定推迟施工，直到完成全面的环境影响评估。

meanings_ja: n. 王冠；皇冠 | v. 为……加冕；授予冠军称号 | n. 顶部；头顶；树冠
definition_en: a ceremonial headpiece worn by a king or queen | to officially make someone a monarch or declare them champion | the highest part of a head, tree, or other object
example1_en: The queen wore a golden crown during the ceremony.
example1_ja: 女王在仪式上戴着一顶金色王冠。
example2_en: A royal crown displayed in a museum can reveal historical attitudes towards wealth, authority, and craftsmanship.
example2_ja: 博物馆里展出的王冠可以揭示历史上人们对财富、权威和工艺的态度。
collocations: wear a crown｜戴王冠 ; be crowned champion｜荣获冠军 ; the crown of the head｜头顶 ; the crown of a tree｜树冠
tip_ja: be crowned champion意为“被授予冠军称号”。
meanings_zh: n. 王冠；皇冠 | v. 为……加冕；授予冠军称号 | n. 顶部；头顶；树冠
example1_zh: 女王在仪式上戴着一顶金色王冠。
example2_zh: 博物馆里展出的王冠可以揭示历史上人们对财富、权威和工艺的态度。

meanings_ja: n. 犯罪；犯罪活动 | n. 罪行
definition_en: illegal activities considered as a whole | an action that breaks the law
example1_en: Better street lighting has helped reduce crime here.
example1_ja: 更好的街道照明帮助减少了这里的犯罪。
example2_en: Investment in education and employment opportunities may reduce crime more effectively than increasingly severe punishments.
example2_ja: 投资教育和增加就业机会，可能比不断加重惩罚更有效地减少犯罪。
collocations: commit a crime｜犯罪 ; prevent crime｜预防犯罪 ; crime rate｜犯罪率 ; violent crime｜暴力犯罪
tip_ja: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。
meanings_zh: n. 犯罪；犯罪活动 | n. 罪行
example1_zh: 更好的街道照明帮助减少了这里的犯罪。
example2_zh: 投资教育和增加就业机会，可能比不断加重惩罚更有效地减少犯罪。

meanings_ja: v. 逃跑；逃脱 | v. 避开；免遭 | n. 逃脱；解脱
definition_en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation | to avoid something unpleasant or harmful | the act of getting free from danger or unpleasant conditions
example1_en: Our rabbit escaped through a small gap in the fence.
example1_ja: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。
example2_en: Accessible parks offer urban residents an escape from crowded streets and opportunities to enjoy nature.
example2_ja: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。
collocations: escape from danger｜脱离危险 ; narrow escape｜侥幸脱险 ; escape injury｜幸免受伤 ; escape route｜逃生路线
tip_ja: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。
meanings_zh: v. 逃跑；逃脱 | v. 避开；免遭 | n. 逃脱；解脱
example1_zh: 我们的兔子从围栏的一处小缝隙逃走了。
example2_zh: 便利可达的公园让城市居民得以远离拥挤的街道，并有机会亲近自然。

meanings_ja: adj. 中级的；中间的 | n. 中级学习者
definition_en: Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages. | A learner whose skills are between beginner and advanced levels.
example1_en: This swimming class is suitable for intermediate learners.
example1_ja: 这门游泳课适合中级学员。
example2_en: Intermediate language courses should balance grammar instruction with opportunities for meaningful communication outside the classroom.
example2_ja: 中级语言课程应兼顾语法教学与课堂外有实际意义的交流机会。
collocations: intermediate level｜中级水平 ; an intermediate course｜中级课程 ; an intermediate stage｜中间阶段
tip_ja: 常指介于beginner与advanced之间的水平。
meanings_zh: adj. 中级的；中间的 | n. 中级学习者
example1_zh: 这门游泳课适合中级学员。
example2_zh: 中级语言课程应兼顾语法教学与课堂外有实际意义的交流机会。

meanings_ja: adj. 生的；未煮熟的 | adj. 未加工的；未经处理的 | adj. 擦痛的；红肿疼痛的
definition_en: not cooked | in its original state before processing or analysis | sore because the skin is damaged or irritated
example1_en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
example1_ja: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。
example2_en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
example2_ja: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。
collocations: raw vegetables｜生蔬菜 ; raw materials｜原材料 ; raw data｜原始数据 ; raw talent｜未经雕琢的天赋
tip_ja: raw强调未烹煮或未加工，不等于“新鲜的”fresh。
meanings_zh: adj. 生的；未煮熟的 | adj. 未加工的；未经处理的 | adj. 擦痛的；红肿疼痛的
example1_zh: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。
example2_zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。

meanings_ja: n. 兽毛；软毛 | n. 毛皮；裘皮
definition_en: the thick soft hair covering some animals | animal skin with hair attached, used for making clothing
example1_en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
example1_ja: 猫湿漉漉的毛在阳光下很快就干了。
example2_en: Thick fur helps many mammals survive in cold climates by trapping a layer of warm air.
example2_ja: 浓密的毛通过留住一层暖空气，帮助许多哺乳动物在寒冷气候中生存。
collocations: thick fur｜浓密的毛 ; soft fur｜柔软的毛 ; faux fur｜人造毛皮 ; fur coat｜裘皮大衣
tip_ja: 指动物身上的毛通常不可数；羽毛用feather。
meanings_zh: n. 兽毛；软毛 | n. 毛皮；裘皮
example1_zh: 猫湿漉漉的毛在阳光下很快就干了。
example2_zh: 浓密的毛通过留住一层暖空气，帮助许多哺乳动物在寒冷气候中生存。

meanings_ja: v. 允许；准许 | n. 许可证；通行证 | v. 使成为可能
definition_en: to officially allow someone to do something | an official document allowing a particular activity | to make an action or situation possible
example1_en: The museum permits visitors to take photos without flash.
example1_ja: 这家博物馆允许游客在不开闪光灯的情况下拍照。
example2_en: Local authorities should permit new housing developments only when adequate transport and healthcare services are available.
example2_ja: 地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。
collocations: permit someone to do something｜允许某人做某事 ; work permit｜工作许可 ; building permit｜建筑许可证 ; weather permitting｜天气允许的话
tip_ja: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。
meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许 | n. 许可证；通行证 | v. 使成为可能
example1_zh: 这家博物馆允许游客在不开闪光灯的情况下拍照。
example2_zh: 地方政府只有在交通和医疗服务充足时，才应批准新的住宅开发项目。

meanings_ja: v. 减去；扣除
definition_en: to take one number or amount away from another
example1_en: Subtract the delivery charge to find the original price.
example1_ja: 减去运费，就能算出原价。
example2_en: Researchers subtract production costs from total revenue to calculate the profit generated by each farming method.
example2_ja: 研究人员从总收入中减去生产成本，计算每种耕作方式带来的利润。
collocations: subtract from｜从……中减去 ; subtract the cost｜扣除费用
tip_ja: subtract A from B 表示用B减去A。
meanings_zh: v. 减去；扣除
example1_zh: 减去运费，就能算出原价。
example2_zh: 研究人员从总收入中减去生产成本，计算每种耕作方式带来的利润。

meanings_ja: adj. 合适的；适宜的
definition_en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation
example1_en: These walking shoes are suitable for muddy forest paths.
example1_ja: 这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。
example2_en: Cities should provide suitable housing for older residents, with easy access to healthcare and public transport.
example2_ja: 城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。
collocations: suitable for children｜适合儿童的 ; suitable accommodation｜合适的住处 ; a suitable candidate｜合适的候选人
tip_ja: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。
meanings_zh: adj. 合适的；适宜的
example1_zh: 这双步行鞋适合走泥泞的林间小路。
example2_zh: 城市应为老年居民提供合适的住房，方便他们就医和乘坐公共交通。

meanings_ja: n. 热带丛林 | n. 竞争残酷的环境
definition_en: A tropical forest with thick, closely growing plants and trees | A confusing or dangerous situation involving fierce competition
example1_en: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
example1_ja: 茂密的藤蔓垂在狭窄的丛林小路上方。
example2_en: Clearing jungle for agriculture destroys wildlife habitats and can reduce biodiversity across an entire region.
example2_ja: 清除热带丛林以开辟农田会破坏野生动物栖息地，并可能降低整个地区的生物多样性。
collocations: dense jungle｜茂密的丛林 ; jungle canopy｜丛林树冠层 ; urban jungle｜都市丛林
tip_ja: 通常指热带的茂密丛林；forest泛指森林。
meanings_zh: n. 热带丛林 | n. 竞争残酷的环境
example1_zh: 茂密的藤蔓垂在狭窄的丛林小路上方。
example2_zh: 清除热带丛林以开辟农田会破坏野生动物栖息地，并可能降低整个地区的生物多样性。

meanings_ja: v. 单脚跳；蹦跳 | n. 单脚跳；短距离跳跃 | v. 迅速登上或下车
definition_en: To jump on one foot or make small jumps. | A small jump, especially one made on one foot. | To get on or off a vehicle quickly and easily.
example1_en: The little bird hopped across the wet garden path.
example1_ja: 那只小鸟蹦跳着穿过湿漉漉的花园小径。
example2_en: Activities that encourage children to hop and balance can support physical development in early education.
example2_ja: 在早期教育中，鼓励儿童单脚跳和平衡身体的活动有助于身体发育。
collocations: hop on one foot｜单脚跳 ; hop on a bus｜迅速上公交车 ; hop off｜迅速下车 ; a short hop｜短途行程
tip_ja: 过去式hopped，进行式hopping，需双写p。
meanings_zh: v. 单脚跳；蹦跳 | n. 单脚跳；短距离跳跃 | v. 迅速登上或下车
example1_zh: 那只小鸟蹦跳着穿过湿漉漉的花园小径。
example2_zh: 在早期教育中，鼓励儿童单脚跳和平衡身体的活动有助于身体发育。

meanings_ja: n. 救护车
definition_en: A vehicle that transports sick or injured people for medical care.

definition_en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage. | Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.
example1_en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
example1_ja: 假期里，一位亲戚给我们带来了自制面包。
example2_en: The relative cost of public transport influences whether residents choose buses over private cars.
example2_ja: 公共交通的相对费用会影响居民是否选择公交车而非私家车。
collocations: a close relative｜近亲 ; a distant relative｜远亲 ; relative importance｜相对重要性 ; relative to｜相对于
tip_ja: 作名词指亲属；作形容词常与to连用表示比较。
meanings_zh: n. 亲戚；亲属 | adj. 相对的；比较而言的
example1_zh: 假期里，一位亲戚给我们带来了自制面包。
example2_zh: 公共交通的相对费用会影响居民是否选择公交车而非私家车。

meanings_ja: adv. 必然地；一定
definition_en: As an unavoidable result or something that must be true
example1_en: An expensive coat is not necessarily a warmer one.
example1_ja: 贵的大衣不一定更暖和。
example2_en: Economic growth does not necessarily improve living standards unless its benefits are shared widely across society.
example2_ja: 经济增长不一定能提高生活水平，除非其成果能由社会各界广泛共享。
collocations: not necessarily｜不一定 ; necessarily involve｜必然涉及 ; necessarily imply｜必然意味着
tip_ja: not necessarily 意为“不一定”，不是“一定不”。
meanings_zh: adv. 必然地；一定
example1_zh: 贵的大衣不一定更暖和。
example2_zh: 经济增长不一定能提高生活水平，除非其成果能由社会各界广泛共享。

meanings_ja: v. 流动；流通 | n. 流动；流量
definition_en: To move continuously, like water through a channel. | Continuous movement, or the amount moving through a place.
example1_en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
example1_ja: 雨水沿着小路流进了花园。
example2_en: Improved public transport can ease the flow of traffic and reduce air pollution in crowded cities.
example2_ja: 改善公共交通可以使交通更加顺畅，并减少拥挤城市的空气污染。
collocations: flow into｜流入 ; traffic flow｜交通流量 ; cash flow｜现金流 ; flow rate｜流量
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为flowed，不是flew。
meanings_zh: v. 流动；流通 | n. 流动；流量
example1_zh: 雨水沿着小路流进了花园。
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以使交通更加顺畅，并减少拥挤城市的空气污染。

meanings_ja: n. 受训人员；实习生
definition_en: Someone learning the skills needed for a particular job.
example1_en: The trainee watched carefully as the chef chopped vegetables.
example1_ja: 厨师切菜时，那名实习生在一旁仔细观察。
example2_en: Assigning an experienced mentor to each trainee can improve workplace learning and reduce costly mistakes.
example2_ja: 为每位受训人员安排一名经验丰富的导师，可以改善职场学习效果，减少代价高昂的错误。
collocations: trainee teacher｜实习教师 ; management trainee｜管理培训生 ; graduate trainee｜毕业生培训员工
tip_ja: trainee接受培训；trainer负责培训他人。
meanings_zh: n. 受训人员；实习生
example1_zh: 厨师切菜时，那名实习生在一旁仔细观察。
example2_zh: 为每位受训人员安排一名经验丰富的导师，可以改善职场学习效果，减少代价高昂的错误。

meanings_ja: v. 抓住；猛地拿取 | v. 匆忙吃喝或获取 | v. 吸引注意
definition_en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly | to get food, drink, or something else quickly | to attract someone's attention strongly
example1_en: She grabbed her umbrella and ran towards the bus.
example1_ja: 她抓起雨伞，朝公交车跑去。
example2_en: Public health campaigns often use striking images to grab attention and encourage people to change unhealthy habits.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传常用醒目的图片吸引注意，鼓励人们改变不健康的习惯。
collocations: grab someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意 ; grab a bite｜匆忙吃点东西 ; grab an opportunity｜抓住机会
tip_ja: grab较口语化；过去式grabbed，分词grabbing。
meanings_zh: v. 抓住；猛地拿取 | v. 匆忙吃喝或获取 | v. 吸引注意
example1_zh: 她抓起雨伞，朝公交车跑去。
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传常用醒目的图片吸引注意，鼓励人们改变不健康的习惯。

meanings_ja: adj. 有效的；起作用的 | adj. 生效的 | adj. 实际的；事实上的
definition_en: producing the intended or desired result | officially in force from a particular time | existing in practice, even if not officially recognised
example1_en: This simple stretch is effective at easing shoulder tension.
example1_ja: 这个简单的伸展动作能有效缓解肩部紧绷。
example2_en: Effective environmental policies should combine clear regulations with financial incentives that encourage businesses to reduce waste.
example2_ja: 有效的环境政策应将明确的法规与鼓励企业减少废弃物的经济激励相结合。
collocations: effective treatment｜有效的治疗 ; effective in doing something｜在做某事方面有效 ; highly effective｜非常有效 ; effective from｜自……起生效
tip_ja: effective强调达到效果；efficient强调省时省力。
meanings_zh: adj. 有效的；起作用的 | adj. 生效的 | adj. 实际的；事实上的
example1_zh: 这个简单的伸展动作能有效缓解肩部紧绷。
example2_zh: 有效的环境政策应将明确的法规与鼓励企业减少废弃物的经济激励相结合。

meanings_ja: adv. 经常；频繁地
definition_en: Often or many times
example1_en: Our neighbour frequently brings us vegetables from her garden.
example1_ja: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。
example2_en: People who frequently use public transport may spend less on travel than those who drive daily.
example2_ja: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。
collocations: frequently asked questions｜常见问题 ; occur frequently｜频繁发生 ; frequently used｜经常使用的
tip_ja: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。
meanings_zh: adv. 经常；频繁地
example1_zh: 邻居经常给我们送来她园子里种的蔬菜。
example2_zh: 经常使用公共交通的人，出行开支可能低于每天开车的人。

meanings_ja: v. 意识到；明白 | v. 实现愿望或潜力
definition_en: To become aware of something or understand it clearly | To make a hope happen or achieve possible success
example1_en: I realized I had left my keys at home.
example1_ja: 我意识到自己把钥匙落在家里了。
example2_en: Affordable training can help young people realize their potential and gain access to more rewarding careers.
example2_ja: 费用可负担的培训能帮助年轻人发挥潜力，获得更有发展前景的工作。
collocations: realize that｜意识到…… ; realize a dream｜实现梦想 ; realize your potential｜发挥你的潜力 ; fully realize｜充分认识到
tip_ja: 英式也拼作realise；意识到某事可接that从句。
meanings_zh: v. 意识到；明白 | v. 实现愿望或潜力
example1_zh: 我意识到自己把钥匙落在家里了。
example2_zh: 费用可负担的培训能帮助年轻人发挥潜力，获得更有发展前景的工作。

meanings_ja: v. 欢呼；喝彩 | n. 欢呼声；喝彩声 | v. 使振奋；使高兴
definition_en: shout happily to show approval or encouragement | a loud shout expressing happiness, approval, or encouragement | make someone feel happier or more hopeful
example1_en: We cheered as our neighbour crossed the finish line.
example1_ja: 邻居冲过终点线时，我们欢呼起来。
example2_en: When spectators cheer for every participant, community sporting events can foster a stronger sense of belonging.
example2_ja: 当观众为每位参与者喝彩时，社区体育活动能培养更强的归属感。
collocations: cheer someone on｜为某人加油 ; cheer someone up｜使某人振作 ; a loud cheer｜响亮的欢呼声 ; cheer for a team｜为球队喝彩
tip_ja: cheer on指加油助威；cheer up指振作或使高兴。
meanings_zh: v. 欢呼；喝彩 | n. 欢呼声；喝彩声 | v. 使振奋；使高兴
example1_zh: 邻居冲过终点线时，我们欢呼起来。
example2_zh: 当观众为每位参与者喝彩时，社区体育活动能培养更强的归属感。

meanings_ja: adv. 如今；现今
definition_en: At the present time, especially compared with the past.
example1_en: Nowadays, I usually pay for groceries with my phone.
example1_ja: 如今，我买食品杂货通常用手机付款。
example2_en: Nowadays, many employees expect flexible working arrangements that allow them to balance professional and family responsibilities.
example2_ja: 如今，许多员工希望有灵活的工作安排，以便兼顾工作和家庭责任。
collocations: nowadays, many people｜如今许多人 ; more common nowadays｜如今更常见 ; rarely used nowadays｜如今很少使用
tip_ja: 常与一般现在时连用，强调今昔对比；不用加介词。
meanings_zh: adv. 如今；现今
example1_zh: 如今，我买食品杂货通常用手机付款。
example2_zh: 如今，许多员工希望有灵活的工作安排，以便兼顾工作和家庭责任。

meanings_ja: n. 口香糖 | n. 牙龈 | n. 树胶；胶质
definition_en: A sweet substance chewed but not swallowed | The firm pink flesh surrounding the bases of teeth | A sticky substance from plants, often used for making glue
example1_en: She offered me a piece of mint gum.
example1_ja: 她给了我一片薄荷口香糖。
example2_en: Regular dental checkups can help detect gum disease before it causes serious damage.
example2_ja: 定期进行牙科检查有助于在牙龈疾病造成严重损害前发现问题。
collocations: chewing gum｜口香糖 ; a piece of gum｜一片口香糖 ; gum disease｜牙龈疾病 ; natural gum｜天然树胶
tip_ja: 口香糖不可数；牙龈通常用复数gums。
meanings_zh: n. 口香糖 | n. 牙龈 | n. 树胶；胶质
example1_zh: 她给了我一片薄荷口香糖。
example2_zh: 定期进行牙科检查有助于在牙龈疾病造成严重损害前发现问题。

meanings_ja: n. 人口；全体居民 | n. 种群
definition_en: all people living in an area, or their total number | all organisms of one species living in a particular area
example1_en: The village population grows when families move here.
example1_ja: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。
example2_en: An ageing population can place additional pressure on healthcare systems and increase demand for accessible public transport.
example2_ja: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。
collocations: population growth｜人口增长 ; ageing population｜老龄化人口 ; population density｜人口密度 ; bird population｜鸟类种群
tip_ja: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。
meanings_zh: n. 人口；全体居民 | n. 种群
example1_zh: 有家庭搬来时，村里的人口就会增加。
example2_zh: 人口老龄化会给医疗系统带来额外压力，并增加对无障碍公共交通的需求。

meanings_ja: n. 慈善机构 | n. 慈善；救济
definition_en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need | help, especially money, given to those in need
example1_en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
example1_ja: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善机构做志愿者。
example2_en: Local charities can provide essential support, but governments remain responsible for ensuring access to basic services.
example2_ja: 地方慈善机构可以提供重要支持，但政府仍有责任保障基本服务的可及性。
collocations: donate to charity｜向慈善事业捐款 ; raise money for charity｜为慈善事业筹款 ; charity event｜慈善活动
tip_ja: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。
meanings_zh: n. 慈善机构 | n. 慈善；救济
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善机构做志愿者。
example2_zh: 地方慈善机构可以提供重要支持，但政府仍有责任保障基本服务的可及性。

meanings_ja: n. 软垫；靠垫 | v. 缓冲；减轻冲击 | n. 缓冲物；保障
definition_en: A soft filled bag used for comfort or support. | To soften an impact or reduce a harmful effect. | Something that protects against difficulty, loss, or sudden change.
example1_en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
example1_ja: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。
example2_en: Emergency savings can cushion the financial impact of unemployment and help families maintain their living standards.
example2_ja: 应急储蓄可以减轻失业带来的经济冲击，帮助家庭维持生活水平。
collocations: soft cushion｜柔软的靠垫 ; cushion the impact｜减轻冲击 ; financial cushion｜经济保障
tip_ja: 动词常搭配impact或blow，表示减轻冲击。
meanings_zh: n. 软垫；靠垫 | v. 缓冲；减轻冲击 | n. 缓冲物；保障
example1_zh: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。
example2_zh: 应急储蓄可以减轻失业带来的经济冲击，帮助家庭维持生活水平。

meanings_ja: v. 移走；取下；脱去 | v. 清除；消除 | v. 免职；撤职
definition_en: to take something away from where it is | to get rid of something unwanted | to make someone leave a job or position
example1_en: Please remove your shoes before stepping onto the new carpet.
example1_ja: 踩上新地毯前，请先脱鞋。
example2_en: Governments should remove unnecessary barriers that prevent qualified workers from entering the labour market.
example2_ja: 政府应消除阻碍合格劳动者进入劳动力市场的不必要障碍。
collocations: remove stains｜去除污渍 ; remove barriers｜消除障碍 ; remove waste｜清除废弃物 ; remove someone from office｜免去某人职务
tip_ja: 常用 remove A from B，表示从B中移除A。
meanings_zh: v. 移走；取下；脱去 | v. 清除；消除 | v. 免职；撤职
example1_zh: 踩上新地毯前，请先脱鞋。
example2_zh: 政府应消除阻碍合格劳动者进入劳动力市场的不必要障碍。

meanings_ja: n. 主题；中心思想 | n. 主题曲；主旋律
definition_en: the main subject or idea in a work or discussion | a recognisable tune associated with a programme or musical work
example1_en: We chose a seaside theme for the birthday party.
example1_ja: 我们为生日聚会选了一个海滨主题。
example2_en: The relationship between economic growth and environmental protection is a central theme in contemporary public debate.
example2_ja: 经济增长与环境保护之间的关系是当代公共讨论的核心主题。
collocations: central theme｜核心主题 ; recurring theme｜反复出现的主题 ; theme music｜主题音乐 ; theme park｜主题公园
tip_ja: theme侧重贯穿作品的思想；topic多指讨论话题。
meanings_zh: n. 主题；中心思想 | n. 主题曲；主旋律
example1_zh: 我们为生日聚会选了一个海滨主题。
example2_zh: 经济增长与环境保护之间的关系是当代公共讨论的核心主题。

meanings_ja: v. 提及；指的是 | v. 查阅；参考 | v. 转介；移交
definition_en: mention someone or something, or have them as the meaning | look at a source to find information | send someone or something elsewhere for expert help or consideration
example1_en: Please refer to the map inside your guidebook.
example1_ja: 请查阅你的旅行指南里的地图。
example2_en: Doctors may refer patients to specialists when their symptoms require more detailed investigation or treatment.
example2_ja: 当患者的症状需要更详细的检查或治疗时，医生可能会将其转诊给专科医生。
collocations: refer to a report｜查阅或提及报告 ; refer to something as｜将某物称为 ; refer someone to a specialist｜将某人转诊给专科医生
tip_ja: 常接to；过去式referred，分词referring。
meanings_zh: v. 提及；指的是 | v. 查阅；参考 | v. 转介；移交
example1_zh: 请查阅你的旅行指南里的地图。
example2_zh: 当患者的症状需要更详细的检查或治疗时，医生可能会将其转诊给专科医生。

meanings_ja: adv. 分别地；分开地
definition_en: Apart from others, or individually rather than together.
example1_en: We paid separately, then walked home together after lunch.
example1_ja: 我们午饭后分别付了账，然后一起走回家。
example2_en: Households should collect food waste separately so that local authorities can process it into compost more efficiently.
example2_ja: 家庭应将厨余垃圾单独收集，以便地方政府更高效地将其制成堆肥。
collocations: sold separately｜单独出售 ; pay separately｜分别付款 ; separately from｜与……分开
tip_ja: 与某物分开用separately from，不用with。
meanings_zh: adv. 分别地；分开地
example1_zh: 我们午饭后分别付了账，然后一起走回家。
example2_zh: 家庭应将厨余垃圾单独收集，以便地方政府更高效地将其制成堆肥。

meanings_ja: adj. 暂时的；临时的
definition_en: Lasting for only a limited period of time.
example1_en: This temporary desk will do until the new one arrives.
example1_ja: 新书桌送来之前，先用这张临时桌子就行。
example2_en: Temporary accommodation provides essential shelter while families wait for suitable permanent housing to become available.
example2_ja: 在家庭等待合适的永久住房期间，临时住处提供了必要的栖身之所。
collocations: temporary accommodation｜临时住处 ; temporary job｜临时工作 ; temporary solution｜临时解决办法 ; temporary closure｜临时关闭
tip_ja: 强调持续时间有限，反义词为permanent。
meanings_zh: adj. 暂时的；临时的
example1_zh: 新书桌送来之前，先用这张临时桌子就行。
example2_zh: 在家庭等待合适的永久住房期间，临时住处提供了必要的栖身之所。

meanings_ja: adj. 犯罪的；刑事的 | n. 罪犯
definition_en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime | a person who has committed a crime
example1_en: The police found evidence of criminal activity in the warehouse.
example1_ja: 警方在仓库里发现了犯罪活动的证据。
example2_en: Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.
example2_ja: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。
collocations: criminal offence｜刑事犯罪 ; criminal record｜犯罪记录 ; criminal justice system｜刑事司法体系 ; criminal behaviour｜犯罪行为
tip_ja: criminal 可作形容词或名词；crime 是“罪行”。
meanings_zh: adj. 犯罪的；刑事的 | n. 罪犯
example1_zh: 警方在仓库里发现了犯罪活动的证据。
example2_zh: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。

meanings_ja: n. 恐龙 | n. 守旧者；过时事物
definition_en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils | a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_ja: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
example2_ja: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。
collocations: dinosaur fossils｜恐龙化石 ; dinosaur skeleton｜恐龙骨架 ; dinosaur extinction｜恐龙灭绝
tip_ja: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。
meanings_zh: n. 恐龙 | n. 守旧者；过时事物
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。

meanings_ja: v. 吸引；引起兴趣 | v. 吸引靠近
definition_en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something | Pull something closer through a physical force
example1_en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
example1_ja: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。
example2_en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
example2_ja: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。
collocations: attract attention｜吸引注意 ; attract tourists｜吸引游客 ; attract investment｜吸引投资 ; attract customers｜吸引顾客
tip_ja: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。
meanings_zh: v. 吸引；引起兴趣 | v. 吸引靠近
example1_zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

example2_zh: 持续不断的通知会在课堂上干扰学生，降低他们专注于复杂任务的能力。

meanings_ja: n. 战斗；战役 | n. 斗争；艰苦努力 | v. 奋力斗争；搏斗

meanings_zh: n. 战斗；战役 | n. 斗争；艰苦努力 | v. 奋力斗争；搏斗

meanings_ja: adj. 不必要的；多余的

example2_en: Clear instructions can prevent unnecessary delays and help public services operate more efficiently.
example2_ja: 清晰的指引可以避免不必要的延误，帮助公共服务更高效地运作。
collocations: unnecessary expense｜不必要的开支 ; unnecessary stress｜不必要的压力 ; avoid unnecessary delays｜避免不必要的延误

meanings_zh: adj. 不必要的；多余的

example2_zh: 清晰的指引可以避免不必要的延误，帮助公共服务更高效地运作。

meanings_ja: n. 益智游戏；拼图 | n. 谜；难以理解的事 | v. 使困惑
definition_en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills. | Something that is difficult to understand or explain. | To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

collocations: solve a puzzle｜解开谜题 ; a jigsaw puzzle｜拼图 ; puzzle over something｜苦思某事 ; a crossword puzzle｜填字游戏
tip_ja: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。
meanings_zh: n. 益智游戏；拼图 | n. 谜；难以理解的事 | v. 使困惑

example2_zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

meanings_ja: v. 破坏；糟蹋 | v. 溺爱；宠坏 | v. 变质；使变质

example1_en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.

collocations: spoil the surprise｜破坏惊喜 ; spoil a child｜宠坏孩子 ; spoil your appetite｜影响食欲
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。
meanings_zh: v. 破坏；糟蹋 | v. 溺爱；宠坏 | v. 变质；使变质

meanings_ja: v. 流血；出血

example1_en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
example1_ja: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。
example2_en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
example2_ja: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。
collocations: bleed heavily｜大量出血 ; bleed internally｜内出血 ; stop the bleeding｜止血
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。
meanings_zh: v. 流血；出血

example2_zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。

meanings_ja: n. 合唱团；唱诗班
definition_en: An organised group of people who sing together.

example1_ja: 我姐姐每周日都在唱诗班唱歌。
example2_en: Joining a community choir can reduce loneliness and strengthen social connections among older adults.

collocations: join a choir｜加入合唱团 ; church choir｜教堂唱诗班 ; choir practice｜合唱排练

meanings_zh: n. 合唱团；唱诗班

example2_zh: 加入社区合唱团可以减轻老年人的孤独感，并加强他们的社会联系。

meanings_ja: n. 要素；组成部分 | n. 化学元素 | n. 恶劣天气
definition_en: An important or basic part of something. | A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances. | Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.
example1_en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
example1_ja: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。
example2_en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.

collocations: a key element｜关键要素 ; a chemical element｜化学元素 ; exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中
tip_ja: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。
meanings_zh: n. 要素；组成部分 | n. 化学元素 | n. 恶劣天气
example1_zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。
example2_zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

meanings_ja: adj. 有创造力的；创新的
definition_en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.
example1_en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
example1_ja: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。
example2_en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
example2_ja: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。
collocations: creative thinking｜创造性思维 ; creative writing｜创意写作 ; a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip_ja: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。
meanings_zh: adj. 有创造力的；创新的

example2_zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

definition_en: Travel across water in a boat or ship. | A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.
example1_en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
example1_ja: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。
example2_en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
example2_ja: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。
collocations: set sail｜启航 ; sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋 ; raise the sails｜升帆

meanings_zh: v. 航行；驾驶帆船 | n. 帆

meanings_ja: n. 节礼日

example1_ja: 我们通常在节礼日一起吃剩下的火鸡肉。
example2_en: Boxing Day sales can boost retail revenue, but they also raise concerns about unnecessary consumption.

example1_ja: 我们看了一部讲述侦探调查谋杀案的电影。
example2_en: Accurate forensic evidence plays a crucial role in solving murder cases and preventing wrongful convictions.
example2_ja: 准确的法医证据对侦破谋杀案和防止误判起着关键作用。

example1_ja: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
example2_ja: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；行政区

meanings_ja: v. 不同；有区别 | v. 意见不合

example1_en: These jackets differ in price, but both look great.
example1_ja: 这两件夹克价格不同，但都很好看。
example2_en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
example2_ja: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。
collocations: differ from｜与……不同 ; differ in size｜大小不同 ; differ widely｜差异很大 ; differ with someone｜与某人意见不同

meanings_ja: adj. 普遍的；总体的 | adj. 大致的；非具体的 | n. 将军

example2_ja: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；总体的 | adj. 大致的；非具体的 | n. 将军

example1_ja: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。
example2_en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
example2_ja: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

meanings_zh: n. 雾 | v. 使蒙上雾气；变模糊

meanings_ja: v. 责怪；归咎于 | n. 责任；责备

example1_ja: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。
example2_en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
example2_ja: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。
collocations: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人 ; blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人 ; take the blame｜承担责任 ; be to blame｜应负责任
tip_ja: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。
meanings_zh: v. 责怪；归咎于 | n. 责任；责备
example1_zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。
example2_zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

meanings_ja: adv. 想必；总该 | adv. 必定；确实

example1_ja: 你总能抽出五分钟来帮忙吧？

meanings_zh: adv. 想必；总该 | adv. 必定；确实

meanings_ja: n. 纪念碑；纪念建筑 | n. 历史遗迹；古迹
definition_en: A structure built to honour a person or important event. | An old structure valued for its historical importance.
example1_en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
example1_ja: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。
example2_en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
example2_ja: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: a monument to｜纪念……的建筑 ; an ancient monument｜古迹 ; a historic monument｜历史遗迹 ; erect a monument｜树立纪念碑
tip_ja: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。
meanings_zh: n. 纪念碑；纪念建筑 | n. 历史遗迹；古迹
example1_zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。
example2_zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。

meanings_ja: v. 烤；炙烤 | n. 烤架；烧烤炉 | v. 严厉盘问；追问
definition_en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below. | A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat. | To question someone intensely, often for a long time.
example1_en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
example1_ja: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。
example2_en: Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.
example2_ja: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。
collocations: grilled fish｜烤鱼 ; a charcoal grill｜炭火烤炉 ; under the grill｜在烤架热源下 ; grill someone about something｜就某事盘问某人
tip_ja: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。
meanings_zh: v. 烤；炙烤 | n. 烤架；烧烤炉 | v. 严厉盘问；追问
example1_zh: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。
example2_zh: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。

meanings_ja: v. 毁坏；毁掉 | n. 废墟；遗迹 | n. 毁灭；破产
definition_en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value | the remains of a building that has been badly damaged | the complete loss of money, success, or good condition
example1_en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
example1_ja: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。
example2_en: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.
example2_ja: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。
collocations: ruin someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗迹 ; financial ruin｜经济上的破产 ; in ruins｜成为废墟
tip_ja: 表示建筑遗迹常用复数ruins，如ancient ruins。
meanings_zh: v. 毁坏；毁掉 | n. 废墟；遗迹 | n. 毁灭；破产
example1_zh: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。
example2_zh: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。

meanings_ja: n. 实践研讨会；工作坊 | n. 车间；作坊
definition_en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together. | A room or building where things are made or repaired.
example1_en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
example1_ja: 我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。
example2_en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
example2_ja: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。
collocations: attend a workshop｜参加工作坊 ; run a workshop｜举办工作坊 ; a training workshop｜培训研讨会 ; a repair workshop｜维修车间
tip_ja: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。
meanings_zh: n. 实践研讨会；工作坊 | n. 车间；作坊
example1_zh: 我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。
example2_zh: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。

meanings_ja: n. 朋友；伙伴 | n. 动物的配偶 | v. 交配；使交配
definition_en: A friend or someone you share an activity with | An animal's partner for breeding | To breed, or bring animals together to breed
example1_en: I'm meeting a mate for lunch near the station.
example1_ja: 我要在车站附近和一个朋友吃午饭。
example2_en: Some bird species stay with the same mate for years, sharing responsibility for raising their young.
example2_ja: 某些鸟类会与同一配偶相伴多年，共同承担养育幼鸟的责任。
collocations: a close mate｜亲密的朋友 ; find a mate｜寻找配偶 ; mate for life｜终生配对
tip_ja: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。
meanings_zh: n. 朋友；伙伴 | n. 动物的配偶 | v. 交配；使交配
example1_zh: 我要在车站附近和一个朋友吃午饭。
example2_zh: 某些鸟类会与同一配偶相伴多年，共同承担养育幼鸟的责任。

meanings_ja: n. 食品杂货 | n. 食品杂货店
definition_en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural. | A shop selling food and basic household supplies.
example1_en: I carried two bags of groceries into the kitchen.
example1_ja: 我把两袋食品杂货提进了厨房。
example2_en: Rising grocery prices place considerable pressure on households that already spend most of their income on essentials.
example2_ja: 食品杂货价格上涨给那些已将大部分收入用于必需品的家庭带来了巨大压力。
collocations: grocery shopping｜采购食品杂货 ; grocery store｜食品杂货店 ; grocery bill｜食品杂货开销
tip_ja: 食品杂货用复数groceries；作定语用grocery。
meanings_zh: n. 食品杂货 | n. 食品杂货店
example1_zh: 我把两袋食品杂货提进了厨房。
example2_zh: 食品杂货价格上涨给那些已将大部分收入用于必需品的家庭带来了巨大压力。

meanings_ja: v. 逗乐；使发笑 | v. 使消遣；使不无聊
definition_en: To make someone smile or laugh. | To keep someone pleasantly occupied.
example1_en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
example1_ja: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗乐了在厨房等候的每个人。
example2_en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
example2_ja: 博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: amuse an audience｜逗乐观众 ; amuse yourself｜自娱自乐 ; keep someone amused｜让某人不无聊
tip_ja: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。
meanings_zh: v. 逗乐；使发笑 | v. 使消遣；使不无聊
example1_zh: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗乐了在厨房等候的每个人。
example2_zh: 博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。

meanings_ja: n. 公民 | n. 市民；居民
definition_en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities. | A person who lives in a particular town or city.
example1_en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
example1_ja: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。
example2_en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
example2_ja: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。
collocations: become a citizen｜成为公民 ; a senior citizen｜老年人 ; a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip_ja: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。
meanings_zh: n. 公民 | n. 市民；居民
example1_zh: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。
example2_zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

meanings_ja: n. 食谱；烹饪方法 | n. 促成某结果的方法或因素
definition_en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish | a method or situation likely to produce a particular result
example1_en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
example1_ja: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。
example2_en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
example2_ja: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。
collocations: follow a recipe｜按照食谱做菜 ; a recipe for success｜成功之道 ; a recipe for disaster｜招致灾难的做法
tip_ja: recipe指做菜方法；menu是菜单，prescription是处方。
meanings_zh: n. 食谱；烹饪方法 | n. 促成某结果的方法或因素
example1_zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。
example2_zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。

meanings_ja: n. 饥饿；食物匮乏 | n. 渴望 | v. 渴望；渴求
definition_en: the need for food or suffering caused by its lack | a strong desire for something | to want something very strongly
example1_en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
example1_ja: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。
example2_en: Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.
example2_ja: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。
collocations: satisfy your hunger｜填饱肚子 ; combat hunger｜抗击饥饿 ; a hunger for knowledge｜求知欲 ; hunger for success｜渴望成功
tip_ja: 名词通常不可数；渴望某物用hunger for。
meanings_zh: n. 饥饿；食物匮乏 | n. 渴望 | v. 渴望；渴求
example1_zh: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。
example2_zh: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。

meanings_ja: n. 发烧；发热 | n. 狂热；极度兴奋
definition_en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness | intense excitement shared by a person or group
example1_en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
example1_ja: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。
example2_en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
example2_ja: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。
collocations: have a fever｜发烧 ; a high fever｜高烧 ; a mild fever｜低烧 ; football fever｜足球热
tip_ja: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。
meanings_zh: n. 发烧；发热 | n. 狂热；极度兴奋
example1_zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。
example2_zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

meanings_ja: n. 储物柜；带锁小柜
definition_en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure
example1_en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
example1_ja: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
example2_en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
example2_ja: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。
collocations: locker room｜更衣室 ; school locker｜学校储物柜 ; locker key｜储物柜钥匙
tip_ja: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。
meanings_zh: n. 储物柜；带锁小柜
example1_zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
example2_zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。

meanings_ja: adj. 全世界的 | adv. 遍及全球
definition_en: Existing or happening in all parts of the world. | In or to all parts of the world.
example1_en: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
example1_ja: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。
example2_en: Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.
example2_ja: 全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。
collocations: worldwide demand｜全球需求 ; worldwide recognition｜全球认可 ; available worldwide｜全球均可获取 ; worldwide distribution｜全球分销
tip_ja: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：sell worldwide。
meanings_zh: adj. 全世界的 | adv. 遍及全球
example1_zh: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。
example2_zh: 全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。

meanings_ja: adv. 最近；近来
definition_en: during the recent period up to the present
example1_en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
example1_ja: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？
example2_en: Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
example2_ja: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: have lately become｜近来已变得 ; until lately｜直到最近 ; more often lately｜最近更频繁
tip_ja: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。
meanings_zh: adv. 最近；近来
example1_zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？
example2_zh: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

meanings_ja: n. 夹子；回形针 | n. 电影或音频片段 | v. 夹住；剪短；修剪
definition_en: A small object that holds things together or in place. | A short section of a film or audio recording. | To fasten with a clip, or cut something shorter.
example1_en: She used a clip to hold her hair back.
example1_ja: 她用夹子把头发固定在后面。
example2_en: Teachers can use a short video clip to introduce complex scientific concepts before a classroom discussion.
example2_ja: 教师可以在课堂讨论前，用一段短视频引入复杂的科学概念。
collocations: paper clip｜回形针 ; video clip｜视频片段 ; clip your nails｜剪指甲 ; clip something onto｜把某物夹在……上
tip_ja: 夹在某物上用clip onto；短视频片段也叫clip。
meanings_zh: n. 夹子；回形针 | n. 电影或音频片段 | v. 夹住；剪短；修剪
example1_zh: 她用夹子把头发固定在后面。
example2_zh: 教师可以在课堂讨论前，用一段短视频引入复杂的科学概念。

meanings_ja: adj. 首要的；主要的 | adj. 小学的；初等教育的 | adj. 最初的；直接的
definition_en: more important than anything else | relating to the first stage of formal schooling | original or direct, rather than derived from something else
example1_en: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
example1_ja: 我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。
example2_en: Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.
example2_ja: 投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。
collocations: primary concern｜首要关切 ; primary school｜小学 ; primary source｜第一手资料 ; primary objective｜主要目标
tip_ja: primary school指小学；primarily是副词。
meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；主要的 | adj. 小学的；初等教育的 | adj. 最初的；直接的
example1_zh: 我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。
example2_zh: 投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。

meanings_ja: adj. 明显的；显而易见的
definition_en: Easy to notice or understand.
example1_en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
example1_ja: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。
example2_en: The environmental benefits of cycling are obvious, but safer routes are needed to encourage more people to cycle.
example2_ja: 骑自行车的环境效益显而易见，但还需更安全的路线来鼓励更多人骑行。
collocations: an obvious advantage｜明显的优势 ; for obvious reasons｜出于显而易见的原因 ; obvious to everyone｜人人都看得出来
tip_ja: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。
meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；显而易见的
example1_zh: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。
example2_zh: 骑自行车的环境效益显而易见，但还需更安全的路线来鼓励更多人骑行。

meanings_ja: n. 拖把 | v. 拖洗；擦去
definition_en: A long-handled tool for washing floors | To clean a surface or remove liquid with absorbent material
example1_en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
example1_ja: 我用拖把擦洗了沾满泥的厨房地板。
example2_en: Staff should mop shared floors regularly to maintain hygiene in schools and other public buildings.
example2_ja: 工作人员应定期拖洗公共区域的地面，以保持学校及其他公共建筑的卫生。
collocations: mop the floor｜拖地 ; mop up a spill｜擦净洒出的液体 ; a mop and bucket｜拖把和水桶
tip_ja: 动词过去式mopped，进行式mopping，均双写p。
meanings_zh: n. 拖把 | v. 拖洗；擦去
example1_zh: 我用拖把擦洗了沾满泥的厨房地板。
example2_zh: 工作人员应定期拖洗公共区域的地面，以保持学校及其他公共建筑的卫生。

meanings_ja: n. 临时保姆
definition_en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away
example1_en: The baby-sitter read our daughter a story before bed.
example1_ja: 临时保姆在睡前给我们女儿读了一个故事。
example2_en: Hiring a reliable baby-sitter can help parents balance occasional evening work with their family responsibilities.
example2_ja: 雇用可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间工作和家庭责任。
collocations: hire a baby-sitter｜雇临时保姆 ; reliable baby-sitter｜可靠的临时保姆 ; experienced baby-sitter｜有经验的临时保姆
tip_ja: 现代更常写babysitter；通常指临时照看孩子的人。
meanings_zh: n. 临时保姆
example1_zh: 临时保姆在睡前给我们女儿读了一个故事。
example2_zh: 雇用可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间工作和家庭责任。

meanings_ja: v. 批准；核准 | v. 赞成；认可
definition_en: To officially accept or allow something. | To think that someone or something is good or acceptable.
example1_en: My manager approved my request for a day off.
example1_ja: 经理批准了我请一天假的申请。
example2_en: Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
example2_ja: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。
collocations: approve a proposal｜批准提案 ; approve of something｜赞成某事 ; approve an application｜批准申请
tip_ja: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。
meanings_zh: v. 批准；核准 | v. 赞成；认可
example1_zh: 经理批准了我请一天假的申请。
example2_zh: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。

meanings_ja: n. 报告；演示 | n. 呈现方式；外观 | n. 颁发；赠送
definition_en: a talk that explains something to an audience | the way something is arranged, shown, or expressed | the formal act of giving something to someone
example1_en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
example1_ja: 我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。
example2_en: Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
example2_ja: 进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。
collocations: give a presentation｜作报告 ; oral presentation｜口头报告 ; food presentation｜菜品摆盘 ; award presentation｜颁奖
tip_ja: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。
meanings_zh: n. 报告；演示 | n. 呈现方式；外观 | n. 颁发；赠送
example1_zh: 我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。
example2_zh: 进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。

meanings_ja: n. 限度；限制 | v. 限制；限定
definition_en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible | to control how much something can increase or happen
example1_en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
example1_ja: 这个包能装的东西是有限的。

example2_zh: 自动照明系统能在房间无人时关闭灯光，从而降低能耗。

meanings_ja: adj. 热衷的；渴望的 | adj. 敏锐的 | adj. 激烈的；强烈的
definition_en: very interested in something or eager to do it | quick to notice or understand things | very strong or intense

example1_ja: 莱拉很想加入我们的周末徒步小组。
example2_en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
example2_ja: 热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。
collocations: keen to learn｜渴望学习 ; keen on sport｜热衷运动 ; a keen eye for detail｜敏锐的细节观察力 ; keen competition｜激烈的竞争
tip_ja: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。
meanings_zh: adj. 热衷的；渴望的 | adj. 敏锐的 | adj. 激烈的；强烈的

example2_zh: 热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。

meanings_ja: n. 壳；贝壳 | v. 剥壳；去壳 | n. 炮弹

example1_en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
example1_ja: 她在空贝壳里发现了一只小螃蟹。
example2_en: Rising ocean acidity can weaken the shells of marine animals, threatening their survival and wider ecosystems.
example2_ja: 海洋酸度上升会削弱海洋动物的外壳，威胁其生存以及更广泛的生态系统。
collocations: a hard shell｜坚硬的外壳 ; an empty shell｜空壳 ; shell peas｜剥豌豆
tip_ja: shell作动词可指剥壳；shell peas是剥豌豆。
meanings_zh: n. 壳；贝壳 | v. 剥壳；去壳 | n. 炮弹

example2_zh: 海洋酸度上升会削弱海洋动物的外壳，威胁其生存以及更广泛的生态系统。

meanings_ja: n. 墨水；油墨 | v. 给…上墨
definition_en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing | to apply ink to a surface
example1_en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
example1_ja: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
example2_ja: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。
collocations: in ink｜用墨水 ; ink cartridge｜墨盒 ; printing ink｜印刷油墨 ; run out of ink｜墨水用完
tip_ja: ink作名词通常不可数；“用墨水写”用in ink。
meanings_zh: n. 墨水；油墨 | v. 给…上墨

example2_zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。

meanings_ja: n. 表达；表示 | n. 表情；神色 | n. 词语；说法
definition_en: The act of showing thoughts or feelings through words or actions. | The look on someone's face that reveals feelings. | A word or phrase with a particular meaning.
example1_en: He sent flowers as an expression of his gratitude.
example1_ja: 他送了花来表达谢意。
example2_en: Schools should encourage creative expression by giving students regular opportunities to explore music, drama, and visual arts.
example2_ja: 学校应定期让学生接触音乐、戏剧和视觉艺术，以鼓励创造性表达。
collocations: freedom of expression｜表达自由 ; facial expression｜面部表情 ; an expression of gratitude｜感谢的表示 ; idiomatic expression｜惯用语
tip_ja: 表示“表情、说法”时可数；表示“表达”时常不可数。
meanings_zh: n. 表达；表示 | n. 表情；神色 | n. 词语；说法
example1_zh: 他送了花来表达谢意。
example2_zh: 学校应定期让学生接触音乐、戏剧和视觉艺术，以鼓励创造性表达。

meanings_ja: n. 细绳；线 | n. 琴弦 | n. 一串；一连串
definition_en: Thin cord used for tying or fastening things. | A stretched wire or thread that produces musical sounds. | A series of connected things or events.
example1_en: I tied the parcel with a piece of string.
example1_ja: 我用一根细绳把包裹绑好了。
example2_en: A string of successful conservation projects has demonstrated the value of involving local communities in environmental protection.
example2_ja: 一系列成功的自然保护项目证明了让当地社区参与环境保护的价值。
collocations: a piece of string｜一根细绳 ; guitar strings｜吉他弦 ; a string of successes｜一连串成功 ; tie with string｜用细绳捆绑
tip_ja: 绳线通常不可数；琴弦及a string of中的string可数。
meanings_zh: n. 细绳；线 | n. 琴弦 | n. 一串；一连串

meanings_ja: n. 利润；盈利 | v. 获利；受益
definition_en: Money earned after paying the costs of a business. | To gain money or an advantage from something.
example1_en: The bakery made a small profit this month.
example1_ja: 这家面包店这个月赚了一点钱。
example2_en: Companies should invest part of their profit in cleaner technology to reduce environmental damage.
example2_ja: 企业应将部分利润投入更清洁的技术，以减少环境损害。
collocations: make a profit｜盈利 ; net profit｜净利润 ; profit margin｜利润率 ; profit from｜从……中获益
tip_ja: profit是扣除成本后的利润，不等于收入revenue。
meanings_zh: n. 利润；盈利 | v. 获利；受益
example1_zh: 这家面包店这个月赚了一点钱。
example2_zh: 企业应将部分利润投入更清洁的技术，以减少环境损害。

meanings_ja: adj. 尴尬的；难为情的
definition_en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.
example1_en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
example1_ja: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。
example2_en: Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.
example2_ja: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。
collocations: feel embarrassed｜感到尴尬 ; embarrassed about｜因……而难为情 ; too embarrassed to ask｜难为情而不敢问
tip_ja: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事令人尴尬用embarrassing。
meanings_zh: adj. 尴尬的；难为情的
example1_zh: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。
example2_zh: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。

meanings_ja: v. 使兴奋；使激动 | v. 激起；引发
definition_en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager | to cause a particular feeling or reaction
example1_en: Trips to the seaside always excite my younger sister.
example1_ja: 去海边玩总能让我妹妹兴奋不已。
example2_en: Interactive science exhibitions can excite young visitors and encourage them to explore scientific ideas independently.
example2_ja: 互动式科学展览能让年轻参观者兴奋起来，并鼓励他们自主探索科学概念。
collocations: excite interest｜引起兴趣 ; excite curiosity｜激起好奇心 ; excite the imagination｜激发想象力
tip_ja: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。
meanings_zh: v. 使兴奋；使激动 | v. 激起；引发
example1_zh: 去海边玩总能让我妹妹兴奋不已。
example2_zh: 互动式科学展览能让年轻参观者兴奋起来，并鼓励他们自主探索科学概念。

meanings_ja: adj. 残忍的；刻薄的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；无情的
definition_en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings. | Causing great suffering or disappointment.
example1_en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
example1_ja: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。
example2_en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
example2_ja: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。
collocations: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物 ; a cruel remark｜刻薄的话 ; a cruel blow｜沉重的打击
tip_ja: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。
meanings_zh: adj. 残忍的；刻薄的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；无情的
example1_zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。
example2_zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。

meanings_ja: n. 地图册
definition_en: A book containing maps of the world or particular regions.
example1_en: We opened the atlas to find a mountain range.
example1_ja: 我们打开地图册，寻找一条山脉。
example2_en: Although digital maps are convenient, a printed atlas helps students compare geographical patterns across entire continents.
example2_ja: 虽然电子地图很方便，纸质地图册仍有助于学生比较整个大陆范围内的地理分布特征。
collocations: world atlas｜世界地图册 ; historical atlas｜历史地图集 ; road atlas｜公路地图册
tip_ja: atlas是成册的地图；复数为atlases。
meanings_zh: n. 地图册
example1_zh: 我们打开地图册，寻找一条山脉。
example2_zh: 虽然电子地图很方便，纸质地图册仍有助于学生比较整个大陆范围内的地理分布特征。

meanings_ja: n. 远足；徒步旅行 | v. 远足；徒步旅行 | n. 大幅上涨
definition_en: A long walk, usually through the countryside or mountains. | To walk a long distance, especially in natural surroundings. | A large increase in a price, cost, or rate.
example1_en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
example1_ja: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。
example2_en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
example2_ja: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。
collocations: go for a hike｜去远足 ; mountain hike｜山地徒步 ; price hike｜价格大幅上涨
tip_ja: hike通常指较长的户外步行，也可指价格猛涨。
meanings_zh: n. 远足；徒步旅行 | v. 远足；徒步旅行 | n. 大幅上涨
example1_zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。
example2_zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。

meanings_ja: n. 小鸡；雏鸟
definition_en: A baby bird, especially a young chicken.
example1_en: A yellow chick followed the hen across the yard.
example1_ja: 一只黄色小鸡跟着母鸡穿过院子。
example2_en: Conservation teams monitor each newly hatched chick to assess whether habitat restoration is improving breeding success.
example2_ja: 保护团队监测每只刚孵化的雏鸟，以评估栖息地修复是否提高了繁殖成功率。
collocations: newly hatched chick｜刚孵化的雏鸟 ; day-old chick｜一日龄雏鸡 ; rear chicks｜饲养雏鸟
tip_ja: 不只指小鸡，也可指其他鸟的幼鸟。
meanings_zh: n. 小鸡；雏鸟
example1_zh: 一只黄色小鸡跟着母鸡穿过院子。
example2_zh: 保护团队监测每只刚孵化的雏鸟，以评估栖息地修复是否提高了繁殖成功率。

meanings_ja: n. 库存；储备 | n. 股票；股份 | v. 备有；供应；储存
definition_en: Goods available for sale or supplies kept for future use. | Shares representing ownership in a company. | To keep goods available for sale or use.
example1_en: The shop has fresh stock arriving early tomorrow morning.
example1_ja: 这家店明天一早会有新货到店。
example2_en: Small retailers often struggle to maintain sufficient stock when transport disruptions delay deliveries from major suppliers.
example2_ja: 当运输中断导致主要供应商延迟交货时，小型零售商往往难以维持充足库存。
collocations: in stock｜有现货 ; out of stock｜缺货 ; the stock market｜股票市场 ; stock up on food｜囤积食物
tip_ja: 库存通常不可数；表示不同公司的股票时可用stocks。
meanings_zh: n. 库存；储备 | n. 股票；股份 | v. 备有；供应；储存
example1_zh: 这家店明天一早会有新货到店。
example2_zh: 当运输中断导致主要供应商延迟交货时，小型零售商往往难以维持充足库存。

meanings_ja: n. 陌生人 | n. 初到某地的人；外来者
definition_en: someone you do not know | someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community
example1_en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
example1_ja: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。
example2_en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
example2_ja: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。
collocations: complete stranger｜完全不认识的人 ; stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人 ; no stranger to｜对……并不陌生
tip_ja: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。
meanings_zh: n. 陌生人 | n. 初到某地的人；外来者
example1_zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。
example2_zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。

meanings_ja: n. 选举 | n. 当选
definition_en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives | the act of being chosen for a position by voting
example1_en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
example1_ja: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。
example2_en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
example2_ja: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。
collocations: hold an election｜举行选举 ; general election｜大选 ; election campaign｜竞选活动 ; win an election｜赢得选举
tip_ja: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。
meanings_zh: n. 选举 | n. 当选
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。
example2_zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。

meanings_ja: n. 影子；阴影 | v. 跟随观察；跟岗学习
definition_en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light. | To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.
example1_en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
example1_ja: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。
example2_en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
example2_ja: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。
collocations: cast a shadow｜投下影子 ; in the shadows｜在暗处 ; job shadowing｜跟岗学习
tip_ja: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。
meanings_zh: n. 影子；阴影 | v. 跟随观察；跟岗学习
example1_zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。
example2_zh: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。

meanings_ja: n. 药物 | n. 毒品 | v. 给…下药
definition_en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness. | A substance taken for its effects on mind or body. | To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.
example1_en: The doctor prescribed a drug to ease her pain.
example1_ja: 医生开了一种药来缓解她的疼痛。
example2_en: New drug development requires extensive testing to ensure that treatments are both safe and effective.
example2_ja: 新药研发需要进行大量测试，以确保治疗既安全又有效。
collocations: prescription drug｜处方药 ; drug development｜药物研发 ; drug abuse｜毒品滥用 ; drug resistance｜耐药性
tip_ja: 可指治病的药，也可指毒品，须看语境。
meanings_zh: n. 药物 | n. 毒品 | v. 给…下药
example1_zh: 医生开了一种药来缓解她的疼痛。
example2_zh: 新药研发需要进行大量测试，以确保治疗既安全又有效。

meanings_ja: adj. 含酒精的 | adj. 酒精依赖的；酒精引起的 | n. 酒精依赖者
definition_en: Containing alcohol. | Affected by alcohol dependence, or caused by alcohol. | A person who is dependent on alcohol.
example1_en: The waiter asked whether we wanted any alcoholic drinks.
example1_ja: 服务员问我们是否需要含酒精的饮品。
example2_en: Clear information about alcoholic beverages can help consumers understand health risks and make more informed choices.
example2_ja: 关于酒精饮品的清晰信息可以帮助消费者了解健康风险，并作出更明智的选择。
collocations: alcoholic drinks｜含酒精饮品 ; alcoholic beverages｜酒精饮料 ; alcoholic liver disease｜酒精性肝病
tip_ja: 指人时宜用person with alcohol dependence，更尊重。
meanings_zh: adj. 含酒精的 | adj. 酒精依赖的；酒精引起的 | n. 酒精依赖者
example1_zh: 服务员问我们是否需要含酒精的饮品。
example2_zh: 关于酒精饮品的清晰信息可以帮助消费者了解健康风险，并作出更明智的选择。

meanings_ja: n. 谷物；粮食 | n. 颗粒；细粒 | n. 木材纹理
definition_en: seeds of crops such as wheat, used as food | a very small hard piece of a substance | the natural pattern of lines in wood
example1_en: The farmer stored the grain in a dry barn.
example1_ja: 农民把粮食存放在干燥的谷仓里。
example2_en: Growing grain requires reliable water supplies, which are increasingly threatened by drought in many agricultural regions.
example2_ja: 种植谷物需要可靠的供水，而许多农业地区的供水正日益受到干旱的威胁。

tip_ja: grain指粮食通常不可数；指单颗谷粒或细粒可数。
meanings_zh: n. 谷物；粮食 | n. 颗粒；细粒 | n. 木材纹理
example1_zh: 农民把粮食存放在干燥的谷仓里。
example2_zh: 种植谷物需要可靠的供水，而许多农业地区的供水正日益受到干旱的威胁。

meanings_ja: adj. 不公平的；不公正的

example1_ja: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。
example2_en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.

collocations: unfair treatment｜不公平待遇 ; unfair advantage｜不公平的优势 ; unfair competition｜不公平竞争 ; unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip_ja: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。
meanings_zh: adj. 不公平的；不公正的
example1_zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。
example2_zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。

meanings_ja: adj. 粗心的；不小心的

example1_en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
example1_ja: 我一时粗心，把钥匙留在了门上。
example2_en: Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.
example2_ja: 随意丢弃生活垃圾会污染当地水道，并给野生动物带来严重风险。
collocations: a careless mistake｜粗心造成的错误 ; careless driving｜疏忽驾驶 ; careless with money｜花钱不谨慎
