meanings_zh: v. 撒；散布；撒满
example1_zh: 孩子们沿着花园小径撒花瓣。
example2_zh: 在海滩上乱扔垃圾的游客会威胁海洋野生动物，并增加海岸维护成本。

meanings_ja: v. 探究；深入查明 | v. 测量水深 | n. 铅锤
definition_en: examine something closely to understand it fully | measure how deep water is | a weight on a string used to check vertical alignment
example1_en: The documentary plumbs the mysteries of the deep ocean.
example1_ja: 这部纪录片深入探索深海的奥秘。
example2_en: Through detailed interviews, researchers sought to plumb the causes of declining public trust in local institutions.
example2_ja: 研究人员通过详尽访谈，力图深入查明公众对地方机构信任下降的原因。
collocations: plumb the depths of｜深入探究；达到低谷 ; plumb line｜铅垂线 ; plumb bob｜铅锤
tip_ja: 词尾 b 不发音；plumb the depths 常用于比喻。
meanings_zh: v. 探究；深入查明 | v. 测量水深 | n. 铅锤
example1_zh: 这部纪录片深入探索深海的奥秘。
example2_zh: 研究人员通过详尽访谈，力图深入查明公众对地方机构信任下降的原因。

meanings_ja: adj. 和平的；爱好和平的
definition_en: Peaceful in nature or intended to avoid conflict
example1_en: Her pacific manner helped calm the argument at dinner.
example1_ja: 她平和的态度帮助平息了晚餐时的争论。
example2_en: A pacific approach to international disputes prioritises negotiation and cooperation rather than threats or military action.
example2_ja: 以和平方式处理国际争端，重在谈判与合作，而非威胁或军事行动。
collocations: pacific approach｜和平的处理方式 ; pacific settlement｜和平解决 ; pacific intentions｜和平意图
tip_ja: 小写pacific是正式形容词；the Pacific指太平洋。
meanings_zh: adj. 和平的；爱好和平的
example1_zh: 她平和的态度帮助平息了晚餐时的争论。
example2_zh: 以和平方式处理国际争端，重在谈判与合作，而非威胁或军事行动。

meanings_ja: v. 波动；呈波浪状起伏
definition_en: Move or rise and fall in a smooth, wave-like pattern.
example1_en: Long strands of seaweed undulate gently beneath the water.
example1_ja: 长长的海藻在水下轻轻起伏。
example2_en: The grasslands undulate towards the distant mountains, providing varied habitats for a wide range of species.
example2_ja: 草原绵延起伏，伸向远山，为众多物种提供了多样的栖息地。
collocations: undulate gently｜轻轻起伏 ; undulating hills｜连绵起伏的丘陵 ; undulating terrain｜波状起伏的地形
tip_ja: 描述地形起伏时，常用形容词undulating。
meanings_zh: v. 波动；呈波浪状起伏
example1_zh: 长长的海藻在水下轻轻起伏。
example2_zh: 草原绵延起伏，伸向远山，为众多物种提供了多样的栖息地。

meanings_ja: adj. 美味的；可口的
definition_en: Extremely pleasant to taste or eat.
example1_en: The bakery sells delectable pastries filled with fresh fruit.
example1_ja: 这家面包店出售美味的鲜果馅酥点。
example2_en: Local markets attract visitors with delectable regional dishes, helping small food businesses benefit from tourism.
example2_ja: 当地市场以美味的地方菜肴吸引游客，帮助小型餐饮商家从旅游业中获益。
collocations: delectable dishes｜美味佳肴 ; a delectable dessert｜可口的甜点 ; delectable treats｜美味小食
tip_ja: 比delicious更正式或更具描写色彩，常形容食物。
meanings_zh: adj. 美味的；可口的
example1_zh: 这家面包店出售美味的鲜果馅酥点。
example2_zh: 当地市场以美味的地方菜肴吸引游客，帮助小型餐饮商家从旅游业中获益。

meanings_ja: n. 名声；声誉 | v. 认为；据说
definition_en: the general opinion people have of someone or something | to consider someone or something to have a particular quality
example1_en: The workshop hired a violin maker of considerable repute.
example1_ja: 这家工坊聘请了一位颇有声望的小提琴制作师。
example2_en: Research institutions of international repute often attract talented students and substantial investment from overseas.
example2_ja: 享有国际声誉的研究机构往往能吸引优秀学生和大量海外投资。
collocations: of international repute｜享有国际声誉的 ; of good repute｜声誉良好的 ; be reputed to be｜据说是
tip_ja: 动词多用被动式be reputed to be，意为“据说是”。
meanings_zh: n. 名声；声誉 | v. 认为；据说
example1_zh: 这家工坊聘请了一位颇有声望的小提琴制作师。
example2_zh: 享有国际声誉的研究机构往往能吸引优秀学生和大量海外投资。

meanings_ja: adj. 时髦的；流行的
definition_en: Following the styles that are currently fashionable.
example1_en: He arrived wearing a modish jacket and polished boots.
example1_ja: 他穿着时髦的夹克和擦得锃亮的靴子来了。
example2_en: Modish interiors may attract customers initially, but lasting success depends on reliable service and quality.
example2_ja: 时髦的室内装潢起初或许能吸引顾客，但长久的成功取决于可靠的服务和品质。
collocations: modish clothes｜时髦的服装 ; modish design｜时尚设计 ; modish interiors｜时髦的室内装潢
tip_ja: 较书面，有时暗含“追逐潮流”的意味。
meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；流行的
example1_zh: 他穿着时髦的夹克和擦得锃亮的靴子来了。
example2_zh: 时髦的室内装潢起初或许能吸引顾客，但长久的成功取决于可靠的服务和品质。

meanings_ja: adj. 戴眼镜的
definition_en: wearing glasses
example1_en: A bespectacled librarian helped me find the missing book.
example1_ja: 一位戴眼镜的图书管理员帮我找到了那本找不到的书。
example2_en: Films often portray scientists as bespectacled figures in laboratories, reinforcing a narrow image of scientific careers.
example2_ja: 电影常把科学家描绘成实验室里戴眼镜的人物，强化了人们对科研职业的单一印象。
collocations: a bespectacled man｜戴眼镜的男子 ; a bespectacled professor｜戴眼镜的教授
tip_ja: 偏书面描写；日常更常说wearing glasses。
meanings_zh: adj. 戴眼镜的
example1_zh: 一位戴眼镜的图书管理员帮我找到了那本找不到的书。
example2_zh: 电影常把科学家描绘成实验室里戴眼镜的人物，强化了人们对科研职业的单一印象。

meanings_ja: adj. 暴虐的；专横的
definition_en: Using power cruelly and unfairly to control others.
example1_en: The club members finally challenged their tyrannical leader.
example1_ja: 俱乐部成员终于对他们专横的领导提出了质疑。
example2_en: Independent courts can help prevent tyrannical rule by limiting government power and protecting basic rights.
example2_ja: 独立的法院可以通过限制政府权力和保护基本权利来帮助防止暴政。
collocations: a tyrannical ruler｜暴虐的统治者 ; tyrannical rule｜暴政 ; a tyrannical boss｜专横的老板
tip_ja: 不仅指政治暴政，也可形容老板等人的专横行为。
meanings_zh: adj. 暴虐的；专横的
example1_zh: 俱乐部成员终于对他们专横的领导提出了质疑。
example2_zh: 独立的法院可以通过限制政府权力和保护基本权利来帮助防止暴政。

meanings_ja: adj. 不肯通融的；不配合的
definition_en: Unwilling to help others or adjust to their needs.
example1_en: The unaccommodating host refused to provide an extra chair.
example1_ja: 那位不肯通融的主人拒绝再提供一把椅子。
example2_en: Unaccommodating employers may struggle to retain skilled workers who need flexible schedules to manage family responsibilities.
example2_ja: 不肯通融的雇主可能难以留住需要灵活时间安排来承担家庭责任的熟练员工。
collocations: an unaccommodating attitude｜不肯通融的态度 ; an unaccommodating employer｜不肯通融的雇主
tip_ja: 指不愿帮助或迁就他人，不表示没有住宿。
meanings_zh: adj. 不肯通融的；不配合的
example1_zh: 那位不肯通融的主人拒绝再提供一把椅子。
example2_zh: 不肯通融的雇主可能难以留住需要灵活时间安排来承担家庭责任的熟练员工。

meanings_ja: adv. 在本文中；在此
definition_en: In this document, statement, or situation.
example1_en: The rental rules herein apply to all tenants.
example1_ja: 本文件中的租赁规定适用于所有租户。
example2_en: The evidence presented herein suggests that affordable public transport can improve access to employment.
example2_ja: 本文所呈现的证据表明，价格可负担的公共交通能够改善就业机会的可及性。
collocations: contained herein｜包含于本文中 ; described herein｜在本文中描述的 ; herein lies the problem｜问题就在于此
tip_ja: 正式或法律用语，常指“在本文件中”。
meanings_zh: adv. 在本文中；在此
example1_zh: 本文件中的租赁规定适用于所有租户。
example2_zh: 本文所呈现的证据表明，价格可负担的公共交通能够改善就业机会的可及性。

meanings_ja: adj. 令人厌恶的
definition_en: Causing strong dislike or a feeling of sickness.
example1_en: A disgustful smell rose from the forgotten food.
example1_ja: 被遗忘的食物散发出令人作呕的气味。
example2_en: The disgustful condition of neglected public toilets can discourage residents from using otherwise attractive parks.
example2_ja: 公共厕所因疏于维护而变得令人厌恶，可能使居民不愿前往原本很有吸引力的公园。
collocations: disgustful smell｜令人作呕的气味 ; disgustful sight｜令人厌恶的景象
tip_ja: 此词罕见且偏旧；现代英语通常用disgusting。
meanings_zh: adj. 令人厌恶的
example1_zh: 被遗忘的食物散发出令人作呕的气味。
example2_zh: 公共厕所因疏于维护而变得令人厌恶，可能使居民不愿前往原本很有吸引力的公园。

meanings_ja: n. 雨衣
definition_en: A coat made from waterproof material.
example1_en: She pulled on her mackintosh before walking into the rain.
example1_ja: 她穿上雨衣，然后走进雨中。
example2_en: A durable mackintosh can encourage people to walk rather than drive in wet weather.
example2_ja: 一件耐用的雨衣能鼓励人们在雨天步行而不是开车。
collocations: wear a mackintosh｜穿雨衣 ; a waterproof mackintosh｜防水雨衣
tip_ja: 英式用词，略显老派；不指苹果电脑。
meanings_zh: n. 雨衣
example1_zh: 她穿上雨衣，然后走进雨中。
example2_zh: 一件耐用的雨衣能鼓励人们在雨天步行而不是开车。

meanings_ja: v. 刺激；激将；唆使 | n. 赶牲畜的刺棒 | n. 刺激因素；驱动力
definition_en: to provoke someone into acting through persistent pressure or annoyance | a pointed stick used to make animals move | something that strongly pushes a person to act
example1_en: His teasing goaded me into joining the race.
example1_ja: 他的取笑激得我参加了比赛。
example2_en: Competitive school environments may goad students into pursuing high grades at the expense of genuine understanding.
example2_ja: 竞争激烈的学校环境可能迫使学生追逐高分，而忽视真正理解知识。
collocations: goad someone into doing something｜激某人做某事 ; goad someone on｜不断刺激某人行动 ; a goad to action｜行动的驱动力
tip_ja: 常用goad sb into doing，通常含负面刺激。
meanings_zh: v. 刺激；激将；唆使 | n. 赶牲畜的刺棒 | n. 刺激因素；驱动力
example1_zh: 他的取笑激得我参加了比赛。
example2_zh: 竞争激烈的学校环境可能迫使学生追逐高分，而忽视真正理解知识。

meanings_ja: n. 西方；欧美国家
definition_en: the Western world, especially Europe and North America
example1_en: This old atlas describes the occident in great detail.
example1_ja: 这本旧地图集非常详细地描述了西方世界。
example2_en: Historical accounts often contrasted the occident with the orient, overlooking the considerable diversity within both regions.
example2_ja: 历史记述常把西方与东方对照，却忽视了两个地区各自内部的巨大差异。
collocations: the Occident｜西方世界 ; the Orient and the Occident｜东方与西方
tip_ja: 旧式用语，通常写作the Occident；现代多用the West。
meanings_zh: n. 西方；欧美国家
example1_zh: 这本旧地图集非常详细地描述了西方世界。
example2_zh: 历史记述常把西方与东方对照，却忽视了两个地区各自内部的巨大差异。

meanings_ja: adj. 依照的；依据的
definition_en: in accordance with a law, rule, or agreement
example1_en: Pursuant to our agreement, your deposit will be refunded.
example1_ja: 根据我们的协议，你的押金将予以退还。
example2_en: Pursuant to environmental regulations, factories must treat wastewater before releasing it into local rivers.
example2_ja: 根据环境法规，工厂必须先处理废水，才能将其排入当地河流。
collocations: pursuant to an agreement｜根据协议 ; pursuant to regulations｜依照法规
tip_ja: 几乎总用于pursuant to，常见于法律等正式文本。
meanings_zh: adj. 依照的；依据的
example1_zh: 根据我们的协议，你的押金将予以退还。
example2_zh: 根据环境法规，工厂必须先处理废水，才能将其排入当地河流。

meanings_ja: v. 使膨胀；胀大
definition_en: To swell or become larger because of pressure from inside.
example1_en: Too much gas can distend your stomach after meals.
example1_ja: 饭后过多的气体会使你的胃胀大。
example2_en: During digestion, excess gas may distend the abdomen, causing discomfort that can affect daily activities.
example2_ja: 消化过程中，多余气体可能使腹部胀大，造成影响日常活动的不适。
collocations: a distended abdomen｜胀大的腹部 ; a distended stomach｜胀大的胃 ; distended with gas｜因气体而膨胀
tip_ja: 多用于医学，强调内部压力导致胀大。
meanings_zh: v. 使膨胀；胀大
example1_zh: 饭后过多的气体会使你的胃胀大。
example2_zh: 消化过程中，多余气体可能使腹部胀大，造成影响日常活动的不适。

meanings_ja: adj. 多种多样的；多方面的 | n. 歧管；多支管
definition_en: Numerous and varied | A pipe system distributing or collecting gas or liquid
example1_en: The benefits of growing your own vegetables are manifold.
example1_ja: 自己种蔬菜的好处是多方面的。
example2_en: The manifold challenges of urban growth require cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents.
example2_ja: 城市发展面临多方面的挑战，需要地方政府、企业和居民共同合作。
collocations: manifold benefits｜多方面的好处 ; manifold challenges｜多方面的挑战 ; exhaust manifold｜排气歧管
tip_ja: 形容词用法较正式，常修饰benefits、problems等复数名词。
meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的；多方面的 | n. 歧管；多支管
example1_zh: 自己种蔬菜的好处是多方面的。
example2_zh: 城市发展面临多方面的挑战，需要地方政府、企业和居民共同合作。

meanings_ja: adj. 兴趣广泛的；兼收并蓄的 | adj. 天主教的 | n. 天主教徒
definition_en: Including or appreciating a wide variety of things. | Relating to the Christian church led by the Pope. | A member of the Christian church led by the Pope.
example1_en: Her catholic tastes include jazz, pottery, hiking, and opera.
example1_ja: 她的兴趣十分广泛，包括爵士乐、陶艺、徒步和歌剧。
example2_en: A catholic approach to reading exposes students to diverse perspectives across literature, science, and history.
example2_ja: 兼收并蓄的阅读方式能让学生接触文学、科学和历史领域的多元视角。
collocations: catholic tastes｜广泛的兴趣 ; Catholic Church｜天主教会 ; a practising Catholic｜践行信仰的天主教徒
tip_ja: 小写指广泛包容；指天主教或其信徒须大写Catholic。
meanings_zh: adj. 兴趣广泛的；兼收并蓄的 | adj. 天主教的 | n. 天主教徒
example1_zh: 她的兴趣十分广泛，包括爵士乐、陶艺、徒步和歌剧。
example2_zh: 兼收并蓄的阅读方式能让学生接触文学、科学和历史领域的多元视角。

meanings_ja: v. 误解；错误理解
definition_en: to understand something in the wrong way
example1_en: I misconceived her silence as a sign of agreement.
example1_ja: 我误把她的沉默理解为同意。
example2_en: Policymakers may misconceive local needs if they fail to consult residents before introducing changes.
example2_ja: 政策制定者若不在推行改革前征求居民意见，就可能误解当地需求。
collocations: misconceive someone's intentions｜误解某人的意图 ; misconceive the purpose｜误解目的
tip_ja: 较正式；日常表达“误解”更常用misunderstand。
meanings_zh: v. 误解；错误理解
example1_zh: 我误把她的沉默理解为同意。
example2_zh: 政策制定者若不在推行改革前征求居民意见，就可能误解当地需求。

meanings_ja: v. 杀死；杀害
definition_en: To kill someone or something, especially violently.
example1_en: In the old tale, a knight slays a dragon.
example1_ja: 在那个古老的故事里，一名骑士杀死了一条龙。
example2_en: Traditional legends often celebrate heroes who slay monsters to protect their communities from danger.
example2_ja: 传统传说常常颂扬那些杀死怪物、保护社区免受危险的英雄。
collocations: slay a dragon｜杀死恶龙 ; slay a monster｜杀死怪物
tip_ja: 过去式slew，过去分词slain；常见于文学或新闻。
meanings_zh: v. 杀死；杀害
example1_zh: 在那个古老的故事里，一名骑士杀死了一条龙。
example2_zh: 传统传说常常颂扬那些杀死怪物、保护社区免受危险的英雄。

meanings_ja: v. 悉心呵护；娇惯
definition_en: to give someone excessive care, comfort, and protection
example1_en: They cosset their elderly dog with blankets and treats.
example1_ja: 他们给年老的狗盖毯子、喂零食，把它照顾得无微不至。
example2_en: Parents who cosset their children may unintentionally limit opportunities for them to develop independence and cope with everyday challenges.
example2_ja: 过分呵护孩子的父母可能无意中限制孩子培养独立性及应对日常挑战的机会。
collocations: cosset a child｜娇惯孩子 ; a cosseted upbringing｜备受呵护的成长经历 ; cosseted guests｜受到悉心照料的客人
tip_ja: 及物动词，常暗示照顾过度；名词用法已罕见。
meanings_zh: v. 悉心呵护；娇惯
example1_zh: 他们给年老的狗盖毯子、喂零食，把它照顾得无微不至。
example2_zh: 过分呵护孩子的父母可能无意中限制孩子培养独立性及应对日常挑战的机会。

meanings_ja: n. 自由意志主义者 | adj. 自由意志主义的
definition_en: Someone favouring individual freedom and minimal government control | Favouring individual freedom and minimal government control
example1_en: My neighbour is a libertarian who values personal choice.
example1_ja: 我的邻居是一位重视个人选择的自由意志主义者。
example2_en: A libertarian approach to economic policy generally favours reducing government intervention and expanding individual choice.
example2_ja: 自由意志主义的经济政策取向通常主张减少政府干预，扩大个人选择空间。
collocations: libertarian views｜自由意志主义观点 ; libertarian principles｜自由意志主义原则 ; a libertarian approach｜自由意志主义的做法
tip_ja: 强调个人自由和有限政府，不等同于liberal。
meanings_zh: n. 自由意志主义者 | adj. 自由意志主义的
example1_zh: 我的邻居是一位重视个人选择的自由意志主义者。
example2_zh: 自由意志主义的经济政策取向通常主张减少政府干预，扩大个人选择空间。

meanings_ja: adj. 感染的；脓毒性的
definition_en: infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to such infection
example1_en: The nurse cleaned the septic wound and changed its dressing.
example1_ja: 护士清洁了感染的伤口，并更换了敷料。
example2_en: Prompt treatment of bacterial infections can reduce the risk of septic shock and improve patient outcomes.
example2_ja: 及时治疗细菌感染可以降低脓毒性休克的风险，改善患者的治疗结果。
collocations: a septic wound｜感染的伤口 ; septic shock｜脓毒性休克 ; a septic tank｜化粪池
tip_ja: septic tank 指化粪池；septic 不作“腐烂物”名词。
meanings_zh: adj. 感染的；脓毒性的
example1_zh: 护士清洁了感染的伤口，并更换了敷料。
example2_zh: 及时治疗细菌感染可以降低脓毒性休克的风险，改善患者的治疗结果。

meanings_ja: n. 补偿；报酬 | v. 补偿；酬谢
definition_en: Payment or a reward for work, loss, or inconvenience. | To pay or reward someone for work, loss, or inconvenience.
example1_en: The shop offered a refund as recompense for the inconvenience.
example1_ja: 商店提出退款，以补偿给顾客造成的不便。
example2_en: Employees should receive fair recompense for additional duties rather than being expected to work extra hours without payment.
example2_ja: 员工承担额外职责应获得公平报酬，而不应被要求无偿加班。
collocations: fair recompense｜公平的报酬 ; recompense for｜对……的补偿 ; recompense someone for something｜因某事补偿某人
tip_ja: 较正式；动词用recompense sb for sth。
meanings_zh: n. 补偿；报酬 | v. 补偿；酬谢
example1_zh: 商店提出退款，以补偿给顾客造成的不便。
example2_zh: 员工承担额外职责应获得公平报酬，而不应被要求无偿加班。

meanings_ja: n. 个人特有的习惯；特性
definition_en: an unusual habit or feature particular to someone or something
example1_en: One of his idiosyncrasies is sorting socks by colour.
example1_ja: 他的一个独特习惯是按颜色整理袜子。
example2_en: Effective teachers recognise individual idiosyncrasies and adapt their methods without discouraging students from expressing their personalities.
example2_ja: 优秀教师会认识到个体特有的习惯并调整教学方法，而不打击学生表达个性的积极性。
collocations: personal idiosyncrasies｜个人特有的习惯 ; individual idiosyncrasies｜个体特性 ; linguistic idiosyncrasies｜语言上的独特之处
tip_ja: 可数名词，复数为idiosyncrasies，常指独特习惯。
meanings_zh: n. 个人特有的习惯；特性
example1_zh: 他的一个独特习惯是按颜色整理袜子。
example2_zh: 优秀教师会认识到个体特有的习惯并调整教学方法，而不打击学生表达个性的积极性。

meanings_ja: adj. 热忱的；积极投入的
definition_en: Showing great enthusiasm and commitment to a cause or activity.
example1_en: A zealous volunteer cleaned the entire beach before lunch.
example1_ja: 一位热忱的志愿者午饭前就清理了整片海滩。
example2_en: Zealous campaigners can raise public awareness, but lasting environmental progress also requires effective government policies.
example2_ja: 热心的倡导者能够提高公众意识，但持久的环境改善还需要有效的政府政策。
collocations: a zealous supporter｜热忱的支持者 ; zealous in their efforts｜努力而热忱 ; overly zealous｜过分热心的
tip_ja: 语气比enthusiastic强，有时暗示热心得过头。
meanings_zh: adj. 热忱的；积极投入的
example1_zh: 一位热忱的志愿者午饭前就清理了整片海滩。
example2_zh: 热心的倡导者能够提高公众意识，但持久的环境改善还需要有效的政府政策。

meanings_ja: v. 低声说；喃喃道 | n. 低语声；轻柔持续的声音 | n. 低声抱怨
definition_en: To speak in a quiet, gentle voice. | A quiet, continuous sound or softly spoken words. | A quiet expression of dissatisfaction or disagreement.
example1_en: She murmured a quiet thank you and smiled.
example1_ja: 她轻声道了谢，露出微笑。
example2_en: A murmur of concern spread through the audience as the proposed library closures were announced.
example2_ja: 拟议的图书馆关闭计划公布时，听众中传出一阵担忧的低语。
collocations: murmur softly｜轻声说 ; a murmur of approval｜低声赞同 ; without a murmur｜毫无怨言
tip_ja: 强调轻柔低声；mutter常带不满或含糊的意味。
meanings_zh: v. 低声说；喃喃道 | n. 低语声；轻柔持续的声音 | n. 低声抱怨
example1_zh: 她轻声道了谢，露出微笑。
example2_zh: 拟议的图书馆关闭计划公布时，听众中传出一阵担忧的低语。

meanings_ja: n. 纠正；修正 | n. 整流
definition_en: The process of correcting an error or putting something right | The process of converting alternating electric current into direct current
example1_en: The builder promised prompt rectification of the faulty wiring.
example1_ja: 建筑工人承诺及时修复有问题的线路。
example2_en: Independent inspections allow the early identification and rectification of structural defects before buildings are opened to the public.
example2_ja: 独立检查有助于在建筑向公众开放前，及早发现并修正结构缺陷。
collocations: rectification of errors｜错误的纠正 ; rectification work｜整改工作 ; half-wave rectification｜半波整流
tip_ja: 正式名词；日常说“纠正”常用correction。
meanings_zh: n. 纠正；修正 | n. 整流
example1_zh: 建筑工人承诺及时修复有问题的线路。
example2_zh: 独立检查有助于在建筑向公众开放前，及早发现并修正结构缺陷。

meanings_ja: adv. 随同；与此一起 | adv. 随即；于是
definition_en: with that thing or together with it | immediately after that
example1_en: She handed him the parcel and a ribbon therewith.
example1_ja: 她把包裹连同一条丝带递给了他。
example2_en: Applicants must submit the completed form and all supporting documents therewith before the committee considers their request.
example2_ja: 申请人必须提交填好的表格及随附的全部证明文件，委员会才会审议其申请。
collocations: documents submitted therewith｜随同提交的文件 ; costs associated therewith｜与此相关的费用
tip_ja: 古旧或法律用语；日常用with it或along with it。
meanings_zh: adv. 随同；与此一起 | adv. 随即；于是
example1_zh: 她把包裹连同一条丝带递给了他。
example2_zh: 申请人必须提交填好的表格及随附的全部证明文件，委员会才会审议其申请。

meanings_ja: v. 拖着脚缓慢行走 | n. 拖沓的步态
definition_en: To walk slowly and awkwardly, dragging your feet | A slow, awkward walk with dragging feet
example1_en: Still half asleep, he shambled into the kitchen.
example1_ja: 他还半睡半醒，拖着脚走进了厨房。
example2_en: After hours of physical work, exhausted labourers may shamble home rather than walk briskly.
example2_ja: 经过数小时的体力劳动，筋疲力尽的工人回家时可能脚步拖沓，而非步履轻快。
collocations: shamble along｜拖着脚缓慢前行 ; shamble into｜拖着脚走进 ; shamble across｜拖着脚穿过
tip_ja: 强调脚步拖沓、不利落，不一定是失去平衡。
meanings_zh: v. 拖着脚缓慢行走 | n. 拖沓的步态
example1_zh: 他还半睡半醒，拖着脚走进了厨房。
example2_zh: 经过数小时的体力劳动，筋疲力尽的工人回家时可能脚步拖沓，而非步履轻快。

meanings_ja: n. 牛轭 | n. 束缚；压迫 | v. 给…套轭；使强行结合
definition_en: A wooden frame joining two animals to pull a load. | A condition of being controlled or oppressed. | Join animals with a frame, or force things together.
example1_en: The farmer placed a wooden yoke across the oxen's necks.
example1_ja: 农夫把木轭架在两头牛的脖子上。
example2_en: Many communities struggled for generations to free themselves from the yoke of colonial rule.
example2_ja: 许多群体为摆脱殖民统治的枷锁，进行了数代人的抗争。
collocations: a wooden yoke｜木轭 ; the yoke of oppression｜压迫的枷锁 ; yoke together｜套轭连在一起
tip_ja: 与 yolk（蛋黄）同音；比喻义常指压迫的枷锁。
meanings_zh: n. 牛轭 | n. 束缚；压迫 | v. 给…套轭；使强行结合
example1_zh: 农夫把木轭架在两头牛的脖子上。
example2_zh: 许多群体为摆脱殖民统治的枷锁，进行了数代人的抗争。

meanings_ja: v. 坚决否认；拒绝接受 | v. 拒绝履行；拒付
definition_en: To firmly reject a claim, belief, or association. | To refuse to honour an agreement or pay a debt.
example1_en: She firmly repudiated the rumour that she had cheated.
example1_ja: 她坚决否认了关于她作弊的传言。
example2_en: Professional associations should repudiate misleading claims that undermine public confidence in established medical treatments.
example2_ja: 专业协会应明确驳斥那些削弱公众对成熟医疗方法信心的误导性说法。
collocations: repudiate an allegation｜坚决否认指控 ; repudiate a claim｜驳斥某种说法 ; repudiate a contract｜拒绝履行合同 ; repudiate a debt｜拒付债务
tip_ja: 是正式动词，不是名词；名词为repudiation。
meanings_zh: v. 坚决否认；拒绝接受 | v. 拒绝履行；拒付
example1_zh: 她坚决否认了关于她作弊的传言。
example2_zh: 专业协会应明确驳斥那些削弱公众对成熟医疗方法信心的误导性说法。

meanings_ja: n. 偶然事件；偶然性
definition_en: An event happening by chance, or chance itself.
example1_en: By sheer fortuity, we booked seats beside each other.
example1_ja: 纯属巧合，我们订的座位竟然挨在一起。
example2_en: Scientific breakthroughs sometimes involve fortuity, although careful observation remains essential for recognising the value of unexpected results.
example2_ja: 科学突破有时涉及偶然因素，但要认识到意外结果的价值，细致观察仍然至关重要。
collocations: by sheer fortuity｜纯属偶然 ; an element of fortuity｜偶然因素
tip_ja: 较罕见的正式词；日常表达多用chance或coincidence。
meanings_zh: n. 偶然事件；偶然性
example1_zh: 纯属巧合，我们订的座位竟然挨在一起。
example2_zh: 科学突破有时涉及偶然因素，但要认识到意外结果的价值，细致观察仍然至关重要。

meanings_ja: n. 冲突；纷争
definition_en: serious disagreement or conflict between people or groups
example1_en: Arguments over money caused constant strife in the family.
example1_ja: 关于钱的争吵让这家人纷争不断。
example2_en: Economic inequality can fuel social strife when communities feel excluded from opportunities for a better life.
example2_ja: 当一些群体觉得自己被排除在改善生活的机会之外时，经济不平等可能加剧社会冲突。
collocations: social strife｜社会冲突 ; civil strife｜内乱 ; industrial strife｜劳资纠纷
tip_ja: 不可数名词，语气正式，比一般争论更严重。
meanings_zh: n. 冲突；纷争
example1_zh: 关于钱的争吵让这家人纷争不断。
example2_zh: 当一些群体觉得自己被排除在改善生活的机会之外时，经济不平等可能加剧社会冲突。

meanings_ja: n. 小规模战斗；短暂冲突 | n. 小争执；短暂争论 | v. 发生小规模冲突
definition_en: A brief fight between small groups of opposing forces. | A brief argument, often within a larger disagreement. | Fight or argue briefly without a major confrontation.
example1_en: Their skirmish over the remote ended with a compromise.
example1_ja: 他们为遥控器起的小争执最终以妥协告终。
example2_en: A brief border skirmish can undermine diplomatic progress and discourage investment in nearby communities.
example2_ja: 短暂的边境冲突可能破坏外交进展，并削弱投资者对附近社区的投资意愿。
collocations: border skirmish｜边境小规模冲突 ; minor skirmish｜小冲突 ; skirmish over something｜围绕某事的争执
tip_ja: 强调规模小、时间短；也可比喻口头争执。
meanings_zh: n. 小规模战斗；短暂冲突 | n. 小争执；短暂争论 | v. 发生小规模冲突
example1_zh: 他们为遥控器起的小争执最终以妥协告终。
example2_zh: 短暂的边境冲突可能破坏外交进展，并削弱投资者对附近社区的投资意愿。

meanings_ja: n. 浮渣；浮垢 | n. 人渣（侮辱语）
definition_en: An unpleasant layer of waste or bubbles on a liquid. | An insulting word for people considered extremely unpleasant or immoral.
example1_en: He skimmed the scum off the simmering soup.
example1_ja: 他撇去了炖煮中的汤表面的浮沫。
example2_en: A thick layer of scum on a pond may indicate excessive nutrient levels caused by agricultural runoff.
example2_ja: 池塘表面厚厚的浮垢可能表明农业径流导致了水体营养物质过量。
collocations: skim off the scum｜撇去浮渣 ; a layer of scum｜一层浮垢 ; soap scum｜皂垢
tip_ja: 通常不可数；用来指人时侮辱性很强，应避免。
meanings_zh: n. 浮渣；浮垢 | n. 人渣（侮辱语）
example1_zh: 他撇去了炖煮中的汤表面的浮沫。
example2_zh: 池塘表面厚厚的浮垢可能表明农业径流导致了水体营养物质过量。

meanings_ja: adj. 滑溜的；蜿蜒滑行的
definition_en: slippery or moving smoothly with a twisting motion
example1_en: A slithery eel wriggled out of the fishing net.
example1_ja: 一条滑溜溜的鳗鱼扭动着钻出了渔网。
example2_en: Children can overcome their fear of slithery animals through supervised observation and lessons about local wildlife.
example2_ja: 通过有人指导的观察和有关当地野生动物的课程，孩子们可以克服对滑溜动物的恐惧。
collocations: a slithery snake｜蜿蜒滑行的蛇 ; a slithery eel｜滑溜溜的鳗鱼
tip_ja: 常形容蛇、鳗鱼等滑溜或扭动滑行的动物。
meanings_zh: adj. 滑溜的；蜿蜒滑行的
example1_zh: 一条滑溜溜的鳗鱼扭动着钻出了渔网。
example2_zh: 通过有人指导的观察和有关当地野生动物的课程，孩子们可以克服对滑溜动物的恐惧。

meanings_ja: adj. 小巧精致的 | adj. 文雅的；小心翼翼的
definition_en: small, delicate, and attractive | showing delicate or careful movements and manners
example1_en: She served the tea in dainty porcelain cups.
example1_ja: 她用小巧精致的瓷杯端上了茶。
example2_en: The exhibition features dainty ornaments that demonstrate the remarkable precision achieved by traditional craft workers.
example2_ja: 展览展出了小巧精美的饰品，体现出传统手工艺人令人赞叹的精湛技艺。
collocations: dainty jewellery｜小巧精致的首饰 ; dainty cups｜精巧的杯子 ; dainty bites｜小口进食
tip_ja: 常形容杯具、首饰等小而精致，不泛指高档。
meanings_zh: adj. 小巧精致的 | adj. 文雅的；小心翼翼的
example1_zh: 她用小巧精致的瓷杯端上了茶。
example2_zh: 展览展出了小巧精美的饰品，体现出传统手工艺人令人赞叹的精湛技艺。

meanings_ja: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的
definition_en: showing that you consider someone or something unworthy of respect
example1_en: She gave my muddy shoes a contemptuous glance.
example1_ja: 她轻蔑地瞥了一眼我沾满泥的鞋子。
example2_en: Leaders who are contemptuous of public concerns risk damaging trust in the institutions they represent.
example2_ja: 轻视公众关切的领导者可能损害公众对其所代表机构的信任。
collocations: contemptuous of｜鄙视……的 ; a contemptuous glance｜轻蔑的一瞥 ; a contemptuous tone｜轻蔑的语气
tip_ja: contemptuous是鄙视人的；contemptible是可鄙的。
meanings_zh: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的
example1_zh: 她轻蔑地瞥了一眼我沾满泥的鞋子。
example2_zh: 轻视公众关切的领导者可能损害公众对其所代表机构的信任。

meanings_ja: adj. 照相复制的
definition_en: Relating to copies of documents made by a photographic process.
example1_en: The archive kept a photostatic copy of her certificate.
example1_ja: 档案馆保存着她证书的一份照相复制件。
example2_en: Before digital scanning became widespread, photostatic reproduction allowed libraries to share rare documents without transporting the originals.
example2_ja: 在数字扫描普及之前，照相复制使图书馆能够共享珍贵文献，而无需运输原件。
collocations: a photostatic copy｜照相复制件 ; photostatic reproduction｜照相复制
tip_ja: 旧式技术用语，指照相复制，并非静电复印。
meanings_zh: adj. 照相复制的
example1_zh: 档案馆保存着她证书的一份照相复制件。
example2_zh: 在数字扫描普及之前，照相复制使图书馆能够共享珍贵文献，而无需运输原件。

meanings_ja: adj. 不可撤销的；无法改变的
definition_en: Impossible to change, cancel, or take back.
example1_en: Once you sign, your decision becomes legally irrevocable.
example1_ja: 一旦签字，你的决定在法律上就不可撤销了。
example2_en: Governments should consult local communities before making irrevocable decisions about the destruction of historic buildings.
example2_ja: 政府在作出拆除历史建筑的不可撤销决定之前，应征求当地社区的意见。
collocations: an irrevocable decision｜不可撤销的决定 ; irrevocable consent｜不可撤销的同意 ; an irrevocable commitment｜不可撤回的承诺
tip_ja: 常修饰决定、同意或承诺，强调无法撤回。
meanings_zh: adj. 不可撤销的；无法改变的
example1_zh: 一旦签字，你的决定在法律上就不可撤销了。
example2_zh: 政府在作出拆除历史建筑的不可撤销决定之前，应征求当地社区的意见。

meanings_ja: adv. 一般地；中等地
definition_en: To an ordinary degree, rather than exceptionally well or badly.
example1_en: The team played averagely but still won the match.
example1_ja: 这支球队表现一般，但还是赢了比赛。
example2_en: Students who perform averagely in examinations may still demonstrate considerable creativity through practical classroom projects.
example2_ja: 考试表现一般的学生，仍可能通过课堂实践项目展现出很强的创造力。
collocations: perform averagely｜表现一般 ; averagely talented｜天赋普通的
tip_ja: 此词较少见；表示“平均而言”通常用on average。
meanings_zh: adv. 一般地；中等地
example1_zh: 这支球队表现一般，但还是赢了比赛。
example2_zh: 考试表现一般的学生，仍可能通过课堂实践项目展现出很强的创造力。

meanings_ja: n. 属（生物分类单位）
definition_en: a biological group containing closely related species
example1_en: These two garden plants belong to the same genus.
example1_ja: 这两种园艺植物属于同一个属。
example2_en: Scientists classified the newly discovered frog within an existing genus after comparing its genetic characteristics with related species.
example2_ja: 科学家将新发现的青蛙与近缘物种的遗传特征进行比较后，把它归入了一个已有的属。
collocations: belong to a genus｜属于某个属 ; the same genus｜同一个属 ; a new genus｜一个新属
tip_ja: 复数为genera；属低于科、高于种。
meanings_zh: n. 属（生物分类单位）
example1_zh: 这两种园艺植物属于同一个属。
example2_zh: 科学家将新发现的青蛙与近缘物种的遗传特征进行比较后，把它归入了一个已有的属。

meanings_ja: v. 售货时缺斤少两
definition_en: Give a customer less weight of goods than paid for
example1_en: The shopkeeper short-weighted my rice by using faulty scales.

example2_en: Invading armies often plunder historic sites, causing permanent damage to the cultural heritage of affected communities.
example2_ja: 入侵军队常常劫掠历史遗址，对当地社区的文化遗产造成永久损害。

example2_en: During meiosis, each tetrad allows genetic material to be exchanged between paired chromosomes, contributing to biological diversity.

example2_en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.

meanings_ja: v. 投降；屈服；让步
definition_en: to stop resisting and accept another person's demands
example1_en: After hours of arguing, we capitulated and ordered pizza.
example1_ja: 争论了几个小时后，我们终于让步，点了披萨。
example2_en: Governments should not capitulate to commercial pressure when public health and environmental protection are at stake.
example2_ja: 当公共健康和环境保护受到威胁时，政府不应向商业压力屈服。
collocations: capitulate to pressure｜屈服于压力 ; capitulate to demands｜接受要求而让步
tip_ja: 不及物动词；向某人或压力屈服用capitulate to。
meanings_zh: v. 投降；屈服；让步

example2_zh: 当公共健康和环境保护受到威胁时，政府不应向商业压力屈服。

meanings_ja: v. 同意；应允 | v. 就任；即位

example1_en: The landlord finally acceded to our request for repairs.
example1_ja: 房东终于答应了我们提出的维修要求。
example2_en: Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
example2_ja: 当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。
collocations: accede to a request｜答应请求 ; accede to demands｜同意要求 ; accede to the throne｜即位
tip_ja: 正式用语，通常接to；勿与exceed（超过）混淆。
meanings_zh: v. 同意；应允 | v. 就任；即位

example2_zh: 当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。

meanings_ja: n. 漫长而多波折的旅程
definition_en: a long journey involving many difficult or exciting experiences

example1_ja: 他们漫长的骑行历程带他们穿越了沙漠和群山。
example2_en: The documentary follows one family's odyssey across several continents, exploring how migration reshapes identity and belonging.
example2_ja: 这部纪录片跟随一个家庭跨越数大洲的漫长旅程，探讨迁移如何重塑身份认同与归属感。
collocations: epic odyssey｜壮阔的漫长旅程 ; personal odyssey｜个人的探索历程 ; spiritual odyssey｜心灵探索之旅
tip_ja: 文学色彩较强，也可比喻人生探索；复数odysseys。
meanings_zh: n. 漫长而多波折的旅程

collocations: lack thereof｜其缺乏 ; parts thereof｜其中的部分 ; any portion thereof｜其中的任何部分

meanings_zh: adv. 其中的；有关它的

meanings_ja: adj. 与死亡有关而恐怖的
definition_en: Disturbing or frightening because of a connection with death.
example1_en: The old theatre displayed a macabre painting of dancing skeletons.
example1_ja: 那座老剧院陈列着一幅骷髅起舞的恐怖画作。
example2_en: Macabre imagery in literature can encourage readers to reflect on mortality rather than merely provoke fear.
example2_ja: 文学中与死亡有关的恐怖意象可以促使读者思考生命的终结，而不只是引发恐惧。
collocations: macabre humour｜死亡主题的黑色幽默 ; macabre imagery｜死亡主题的恐怖意象 ; macabre tale｜恐怖故事
tip_ja: 不泛指吓人，通常涉及死亡或令人不安的细节。
meanings_zh: adj. 与死亡有关而恐怖的

example2_zh: 文学中与死亡有关的恐怖意象可以促使读者思考生命的终结，而不只是引发恐惧。

meanings_ja: n. 硬化；硬化症
definition_en: Abnormal hardening of tissue within the body.

collocations: multiple sclerosis｜多发性硬化症 ; tissue sclerosis｜组织硬化

meanings_zh: n. 硬化；硬化症

example2_zh: 多发性硬化症影响中枢神经系统，其症状可能因人而异。

meanings_ja: v. 束缚；限制 | n. 桎梏；束缚；脚镣
definition_en: To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act. | Something limiting freedom, or a chain securing someone's ankles.
example1_en: Don't let fear fetter your plans to travel alone.
example1_ja: 别让恐惧束缚你独自旅行的计划。

meanings_zh: v. 束缚；限制 | n. 桎梏；束缚；脚镣

meanings_ja: v. 为家具装软垫及面料
definition_en: To cover furniture with padding and fabric or leather.

example1_ja: 他们给那把旧椅子加了软垫，并包上柔软的蓝色天鹅绒。

meanings_ja: n. 大比目鱼；其鱼肉
definition_en: A large flat sea fish, also eaten as food

meanings_zh: n. 大比目鱼；其鱼肉

meanings_ja: adj. 气动的；充气的

example2_zh: 气动系统广泛用于制造业，因为压缩空气能安全高效地驱动工具。

meanings_ja: n. 谵妄；急性精神错乱 | n. 极度兴奋；狂喜

example1_ja: 发烧期间，他陷入谵妄状态，说话语无伦次。

meanings_zh: n. 谵妄；急性精神错乱 | n. 极度兴奋；狂喜

meanings_ja: adj. 积习难改的；成癖的

meanings_zh: adj. 积习难改的；成癖的

meanings_zh: adj. 站得住脚的；可维持的

meanings_zh: v. 告知；通知
example1_zh: 如有任何变化，请在周五前告知我。
example2_zh: 学校在推行影响孩子的新规定之前，应告知家长重大的政策变化。

meanings_ja: adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: To a very great degree, especially in a positive way.
example1_en: Your spare room looks eminently suitable for a study.
example1_ja: 你那间空房看起来非常适合用作书房。
example2_en: Improving insulation is an eminently sensible way to reduce household energy consumption and heating costs.
example2_ja: 改善隔热保温是降低家庭能耗和取暖费用的非常明智的方法。
collocations: eminently suitable｜非常合适 ; eminently sensible｜极为明智 ; eminently reasonable｜十分合理 ; eminently qualified｜完全胜任
tip_ja: 常修饰褒义形容词；勿与imminently（即将）混淆。
meanings_zh: adv. 极其；非常
example1_zh: 你那间空房看起来非常适合用作书房。
example2_zh: 改善隔热保温是降低家庭能耗和取暖费用的非常明智的方法。

meanings_ja: n. 炼金术 | n. 神奇的转变力量
definition_en: An ancient practice seeking to turn ordinary metals into gold | A mysterious process that transforms ordinary things into something special
example1_en: The exhibition explored alchemy through old jars and furnaces.
example1_ja: 展览通过古老的罐子和熔炉来介绍炼金术。
example2_en: Although alchemy lacked a modern scientific framework, its experimental techniques contributed to the development of chemistry.
example2_ja: 虽然炼金术缺乏现代科学框架，但其实验技术推动了化学的发展。
collocations: medieval alchemy｜中世纪炼金术 ; practise alchemy｜从事炼金术 ; the alchemy of creativity｜创造力的神奇转化作用
tip_ja: 通常不可数；比喻义强调神奇转化，并非泛指魔法。
meanings_zh: n. 炼金术 | n. 神奇的转变力量
example1_zh: 展览通过古老的罐子和熔炉来介绍炼金术。
example2_zh: 虽然炼金术缺乏现代科学框架，但其实验技术推动了化学的发展。

meanings_ja: n. 崇敬；敬畏
definition_en: Deep respect and admiration for someone or something.
example1_en: She handled her grandmother's old violin with quiet reverence.
example1_ja: 她怀着深深的敬意，轻轻拿起祖母的旧小提琴。
example2_en: Reverence for traditional craftsmanship can encourage communities to preserve skills that might otherwise disappear.
example2_ja: 对传统工艺的崇敬能促使社区保留那些可能失传的技艺。
collocations: reverence for｜对……的崇敬 ; deep reverence｜深深的敬意 ; treat with reverence｜恭敬对待
tip_ja: 通常不可数；对某人的崇敬用reverence for。
meanings_zh: n. 崇敬；敬畏
example1_zh: 她怀着深深的敬意，轻轻拿起祖母的旧小提琴。
example2_zh: 对传统工艺的崇敬能促使社区保留那些可能失传的技艺。

meanings_ja: n. 流行性腮腺炎
definition_en: A viral illness causing painful swelling near the jaw
example1_en: The doctor checked her swollen cheeks for signs of mumps.
example1_ja: 医生检查了她肿胀的脸颊，判断是否有腮腺炎的迹象。
example2_en: Routine vaccination helps prevent mumps and reduces the likelihood of outbreaks in schools and other crowded settings.
example2_ja: 常规接种疫苗有助于预防腮腺炎，并降低学校及其他人员密集场所暴发疫情的可能性。
collocations: catch mumps｜感染腮腺炎 ; mumps vaccine｜腮腺炎疫苗 ; mumps outbreak｜腮腺炎疫情暴发
tip_ja: 虽以s结尾，但作疾病名称用单数：mumps is。
meanings_zh: n. 流行性腮腺炎
example1_zh: 医生检查了她肿胀的脸颊，判断是否有腮腺炎的迹象。
example2_zh: 常规接种疫苗有助于预防腮腺炎，并降低学校及其他人员密集场所暴发疫情的可能性。

meanings_ja: adj. 温文尔雅的；善于应酬的
definition_en: Polite, confident, and comfortable in social situations.
example1_en: Our urbane host welcomed everyone with a warm smile.
example1_ja: 我们温文尔雅的主人面带温暖的微笑欢迎每一位客人。
example2_en: An urbane manner can help diplomats build trust, although successful negotiations also require substantial expertise.
example2_ja: 温文尔雅的举止能帮助外交官建立信任，不过成功的谈判也需要扎实的专业知识。
collocations: urbane manner｜温文尔雅的举止 ; urbane charm｜儒雅的魅力 ; urbane host｜善于应酬的主人
tip_ja: urbane指人文雅善交际；urban指城市的。
meanings_zh: adj. 温文尔雅的；善于应酬的
example1_zh: 我们温文尔雅的主人面带温暖的微笑欢迎每一位客人。
example2_zh: 温文尔雅的举止能帮助外交官建立信任，不过成功的谈判也需要扎实的专业知识。

meanings_ja: adj. 表面上的；声称的
definition_en: Stated or appearing to be true, but possibly not genuine
example1_en: His ostensible reason for visiting was to return my umbrella.
example1_ja: 他来访的表面理由是归还我的雨伞。
example2_en: The ostensible purpose of the policy was environmental protection, although it also benefited domestic manufacturers.
example2_ja: 这项政策声称旨在保护环境，但它也使国内制造商受益。
collocations: ostensible reason｜表面上的理由 ; ostensible purpose｜声称的目的 ; ostensible aim｜表面上的目标
tip_ja: 暗示表象可能不是真相，但不等于已证实虚假。
meanings_zh: adj. 表面上的；声称的
example1_zh: 他来访的表面理由是归还我的雨伞。
example2_zh: 这项政策声称旨在保护环境，但它也使国内制造商受益。

meanings_ja: n. 困境；难以摆脱的局面 | n. 泥沼；泥泞地
definition_en: A complicated, unpleasant situation that is difficult to escape. | An area of soft wet ground that can trap you.
example1_en: Our simple kitchen renovation became a quagmire of unexpected expenses.
example1_ja: 我们原本简单的厨房翻修变成了意外开支不断的困局。
example2_en: Without clear regulations, major infrastructure projects can become trapped in a quagmire of legal disputes and financial uncertainty.
example2_ja: 缺乏明确法规，大型基础设施项目可能陷入法律纠纷与财务不确定性交织的困境。
collocations: a legal quagmire｜法律困境 ; a political quagmire｜政治泥潭 ; be mired in a quagmire｜深陷泥潭
tip_ja: 常比喻复杂且难脱身的困境，不泛指普通困难。
meanings_zh: n. 困境；难以摆脱的局面 | n. 泥沼；泥泞地
example1_zh: 我们原本简单的厨房翻修变成了意外开支不断的困局。
example2_zh: 缺乏明确法规，大型基础设施项目可能陷入法律纠纷与财务不确定性交织的困境。

meanings_ja: adj. 全体出席的 | n. 全体会议 | adj. 完全的；不受限制的
definition_en: Involving all members of a group or meeting. | A meeting attended by all participants in a larger event. | Complete or unrestricted, especially concerning official power.
example1_en: All workshop groups joined the plenary session after lunch.
example1_ja: 午饭后，所有研讨小组都参加了全体会议。
example2_en: During the plenary debate, delegates discussed how international cooperation could improve access to clean drinking water.
example2_ja: 在全体辩论中，代表们讨论了国际合作如何改善清洁饮用水的获取条件。
collocations: plenary session｜全体会议 ; plenary debate｜全体辩论 ; plenary powers｜全权
tip_ja: 会议语境指全体参加；plenary powers指全权。
meanings_zh: adj. 全体出席的 | n. 全体会议 | adj. 完全的；不受限制的
example1_zh: 午饭后，所有研讨小组都参加了全体会议。
example2_zh: 在全体辩论中，代表们讨论了国际合作如何改善清洁饮用水的获取条件。

meanings_ja: v. 使重伤致残
definition_en: To injure someone severely, causing lasting damage to their body.
example1_en: This machine could maim someone without its safety guard.
example1_ja: 这台机器若没有安全防护装置，可能会使人重伤致残。
example2_en: Strict workplace inspections are essential because unguarded machinery can maim workers and leave them with lifelong disabilities.
example2_ja: 严格的工作场所检查至关重要，因为缺乏防护的机器可能使工人重伤，并造成终身残疾。
collocations: maim workers｜使工人重伤致残 ; maimed in an accident｜在事故中重伤致残
tip_ja: 比injure严重，强调造成永久性身体损伤。
meanings_zh: v. 使重伤致残
example1_zh: 这台机器若没有安全防护装置，可能会使人重伤致残。
example2_zh: 严格的工作场所检查至关重要，因为缺乏防护的机器可能使工人重伤，并造成终身残疾。

meanings_ja: n. 系数
definition_en: A numerical factor multiplying a variable or measuring a property.
example1_en: Our teacher explained how the coefficient changes the curve.
example1_ja: 老师解释了系数如何改变曲线的形状。
example2_en: A high correlation coefficient indicates a strong statistical relationship, but it does not necessarily establish causation.
example2_ja: 较高的相关系数表明存在较强的统计关联，但不一定能证明因果关系。
collocations: correlation coefficient｜相关系数 ; coefficient of friction｜摩擦系数 ; thermal expansion coefficient｜热膨胀系数
tip_ja: 数学中指系数；相关系数高不代表存在因果关系。
meanings_zh: n. 系数
example1_zh: 老师解释了系数如何改变曲线的形状。
example2_zh: 较高的相关系数表明存在较强的统计关联，但不一定能证明因果关系。

meanings_ja: n. 女男爵；男爵夫人
definition_en: A woman holding a baron's rank, or a baron's wife.
example1_en: The baroness welcomed visitors into her family's old castle.
example1_ja: 女男爵欢迎游客来到她家族的古堡。
example2_en: The portrait of the baroness illustrates how clothing once communicated social rank and wealth.
example2_ja: 这幅女男爵肖像展示了服饰过去如何传达社会地位和财富。
collocations: a life baroness｜终身女男爵 ; the title of baroness｜女男爵头衔
tip_ja: 可指本人拥有爵位的女性，也可指男爵之妻。
meanings_zh: n. 女男爵；男爵夫人
example1_zh: 女男爵欢迎游客来到她家族的古堡。
example2_zh: 这幅女男爵肖像展示了服饰过去如何传达社会地位和财富。

meanings_ja: n. 倒影；反射 | n. 深思；反省
definition_en: an image in a shiny surface, or light bouncing back | careful thought about an experience or idea
example1_en: She caught her reflexion in the still pond.
example1_ja: 她在平静的池塘里看到了自己的倒影。
example2_en: Regular reflexion on classroom experiences can help teachers identify more effective ways to support individual learners.
example2_ja: 定期反思课堂经历可以帮助教师找到更有效的方法，为不同学习者提供支持。
collocations: reflexion of light｜光的反射 ; on reflexion｜仔细考虑后 ; careful reflexion｜认真思考
tip_ja: reflexion 是少用变体；考试写作宜用 reflection。
meanings_zh: n. 倒影；反射 | n. 深思；反省
example1_zh: 她在平静的池塘里看到了自己的倒影。
example2_zh: 定期反思课堂经历可以帮助教师找到更有效的方法，为不同学习者提供支持。

meanings_ja: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
definition_en: A viral disease that can damage nerves and cause paralysis.
example1_en: The nurse explained how vaccination protects children against poliomyelitis.
example1_ja: 护士解释了接种疫苗如何保护儿童免患脊髓灰质炎。
example2_en: International vaccination programmes have greatly reduced poliomyelitis, although continued monitoring remains essential to prevent further outbreaks.
example2_ja: 国际疫苗接种计划大幅减少了脊髓灰质炎病例，但持续监测对于防止再次暴发仍至关重要。
collocations: vaccination against poliomyelitis｜预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗接种 ; eradicate poliomyelitis｜根除脊髓灰质炎 ; poliomyelitis outbreak｜脊髓灰质炎暴发
tip_ja: 日常多用polio；虽俗称小儿麻痹症，成人也可感染。
meanings_zh: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
example1_zh: 护士解释了接种疫苗如何保护儿童免患脊髓灰质炎。
example2_zh: 国际疫苗接种计划大幅减少了脊髓灰质炎病例，但持续监测对于防止再次暴发仍至关重要。

meanings_ja: v. 崇敬；敬仰
definition_en: To regard someone or something with deep respect.
example1_en: People here venerate the elder who founded this school.
example1_ja: 这里的人们十分敬仰创办这所学校的长者。
example2_en: Many societies venerate historic buildings because they represent shared cultural achievements and a connection with the past.
example2_ja: 许多社会十分尊崇历史建筑，因为它们代表着共同的文化成就以及与过去的联系。
collocations: venerate ancestors｜敬奉祖先 ; venerate as a hero｜尊为英雄 ; widely venerated｜广受崇敬的
tip_ja: 正式用词，比respect语气强；后面直接接宾语。
meanings_zh: v. 崇敬；敬仰
example1_zh: 这里的人们十分敬仰创办这所学校的长者。
example2_zh: 许多社会十分尊崇历史建筑，因为它们代表着共同的文化成就以及与过去的联系。

meanings_ja: adj. 需极大力量或努力的
definition_en: Requiring an exceptionally large amount of strength or effort.
example1_en: Moving that enormous sofa upstairs was a herculean task.
example1_ja: 把那张巨大的沙发搬上楼真是一项艰巨的任务。
example2_en: Restoring transport networks after widespread flooding requires a herculean effort from engineers, local authorities and volunteers.
example2_ja: 大范围洪灾后恢复交通网络，需要工程师、地方政府和志愿者付出极大的努力。
collocations: a herculean task｜艰巨的任务 ; a herculean effort｜巨大的努力
tip_ja: 源于大力神Hercules；也常写作Herculean。
meanings_zh: adj. 需极大力量或努力的
example1_zh: 把那张巨大的沙发搬上楼真是一项艰巨的任务。
example2_zh: 大范围洪灾后恢复交通网络，需要工程师、地方政府和志愿者付出极大的努力。

meanings_ja: n. 摆动；振荡 | n. 波动；摇摆
definition_en: Repeated movement backwards and forwards around a central position. | Repeated change between different values, states, or opinions.
example1_en: We watched the slow oscillation of the clock's pendulum.
example1_ja: 我们看着钟摆缓缓地来回摆动。
example2_en: Regular oscillations in ocean temperatures can influence rainfall patterns and agricultural productivity across large regions.
example2_ja: 海洋温度的周期性波动会影响广大地区的降雨规律和农业生产力。
collocations: pendulum oscillation｜钟摆摆动 ; frequency of oscillation｜振荡频率 ; temperature oscillations｜温度波动
tip_ja: 既指物体往复运动，也指数值或观点的反复变化。
meanings_zh: n. 摆动；振荡 | n. 波动；摇摆
example1_zh: 我们看着钟摆缓缓地来回摆动。
example2_zh: 海洋温度的周期性波动会影响广大地区的降雨规律和农业生产力。

meanings_ja: n. 面容；神情 | v. 赞同；容许
definition_en: A person's face or facial expression. | To accept or approve of something.
example1_en: Her calm countenance reassured the children during the storm.
example1_ja: 暴风雨期间，她镇定的神情让孩子们安心。
example2_en: Governments should not countenance discriminatory practices that prevent qualified candidates from accessing employment opportunities.
example2_ja: 政府不应容许妨碍合格求职者获得就业机会的歧视性做法。
collocations: a calm countenance｜镇定的神情 ; a stern countenance｜严肃的面容 ; refuse to countenance｜拒绝接受
tip_ja: 名词较文学化；动词常用于否定句，意为容许。
meanings_zh: n. 面容；神情 | v. 赞同；容许
example1_zh: 暴风雨期间，她镇定的神情让孩子们安心。
example2_zh: 政府不应容许妨碍合格求职者获得就业机会的歧视性做法。

meanings_ja: n. 专有权利；特权
definition_en: a special right belonging to a particular person or group
example1_en: Choosing the final design is the team leader's prerogative.
example1_ja: 选定最终设计方案是组长的专有权利。
example2_en: Decisions about public spending should not be the exclusive prerogative of a small group of officials.
example2_ja: 公共支出的决策不应成为少数官员独享的特权。
collocations: royal prerogative｜王室特权 ; exclusive prerogative｜专有特权 ; exercise a prerogative｜行使特权
tip_ja: 指特定身份享有的权利，不是人人都有的普通权利。
meanings_zh: n. 专有权利；特权
example1_zh: 选定最终设计方案是组长的专有权利。
example2_zh: 公共支出的决策不应成为少数官员独享的特权。

meanings_ja: n. 炉渣；矿渣
definition_en: Waste material separated from metal during smelting
example1_en: Dark heaps of slag stood beside the old factory.
example1_ja: 旧工厂旁堆着一堆堆黑色的炉渣。
example2_en: Reusing slag in road construction can reduce industrial waste and demand for newly quarried materials.
example2_ja: 在道路建设中重新利用矿渣，可以减少工业废料及对新开采材料的需求。
collocations: blast furnace slag｜高炉矿渣 ; slag heap｜矿渣堆 ; steel slag｜钢渣
tip_ja: 工业义通常不可数；另有侮辱女性的英式俚语义，勿用。
meanings_zh: n. 炉渣；矿渣
example1_zh: 旧工厂旁堆着一堆堆黑色的炉渣。
example2_zh: 在道路建设中重新利用矿渣，可以减少工业废料及对新开采材料的需求。

meanings_ja: n. 水闸；闸控水道 | v. 用水冲洗 | v. 奔流；涌出
definition_en: A water channel with a gate that controls flow. | To wash something with a strong flow of water. | To flow quickly and in large amounts.
example1_en: We sluiced the mud off our boots outside.
example1_ja: 我们在外面用水冲掉了靴子上的泥。
example2_en: Engineers opened the sluice to release excess water and reduce pressure on the reservoir walls.
example2_ja: 工程师打开水闸排出多余的水，以减轻水库坝壁承受的压力。
collocations: sluice gate｜水闸闸门 ; open the sluice｜打开水闸 ; sluice down the floor｜用水冲洗地面
tip_ja: 作动词可指冲洗；sluice gate指控制水流的闸门。
meanings_zh: n. 水闸；闸控水道 | v. 用水冲洗 | v. 奔流；涌出
example1_zh: 我们在外面用水冲掉了靴子上的泥。
example2_zh: 工程师打开水闸排出多余的水，以减轻水库坝壁承受的压力。

meanings_ja: n. 神经症
definition_en: An older term for psychological difficulties involving anxiety or distress.
example1_en: The old psychology book devoted a chapter to neurosis.
example1_ja: 那本旧心理学书用一章的篇幅介绍神经症。
example2_en: Although neurosis appears frequently in older research, modern clinicians generally use more specific diagnostic terms.
example2_ja: 尽管神经症一词常见于早期研究，现代临床医生通常采用更具体的诊断术语。
collocations: anxiety neurosis｜焦虑性神经症 ; obsessional neurosis｜强迫性神经症
tip_ja: 旧心理学术语，不等于神经衰弱；复数为neuroses。
meanings_zh: n. 神经症
example1_zh: 那本旧心理学书用一章的篇幅介绍神经症。
example2_zh: 尽管神经症一词常见于早期研究，现代临床医生通常采用更具体的诊断术语。

meanings_ja: v. 梳理头发；做发型
definition_en: Arrange or style hair.
example1_en: She learned to hairdress by practising on a mannequin.
example1_ja: 她通过在人头模型上练习学会了做发型。
example2_en: People who learn to hairdress professionally may develop practical skills that support employment in local service industries.
example2_ja: 学习专业美发的人可以培养实用技能，从而在当地服务行业就业。
collocations: hairdress professionally｜专业从事美发 ; learn to hairdress｜学习美发
tip_ja: 日常说做发型用 style hair；美发行业用 hairdressing。
meanings_zh: v. 梳理头发；做发型
example1_zh: 她通过在人头模型上练习学会了做发型。
example2_zh: 学习专业美发的人可以培养实用技能，从而在当地服务行业就业。

meanings_ja: adj. 不可剥夺或转让的
definition_en: impossible to take away or transfer to someone else
example1_en: Our teacher explained why everyone has certain inalienable rights.
example1_ja: 老师解释了为什么每个人都享有某些不可剥夺的权利。
example2_en: Access to basic education should be recognised as an inalienable right, regardless of a child's background.
example2_ja: 无论儿童的背景如何，接受基础教育都应被承认为不可剥夺的权利。
collocations: inalienable rights｜不可剥夺的权利 ; an inalienable right to freedom｜不可剥夺的自由权
tip_ja: 正式用语，主要修饰rights，强调不能剥夺或转让。
meanings_zh: adj. 不可剥夺或转让的
example1_zh: 老师解释了为什么每个人都享有某些不可剥夺的权利。
example2_zh: 无论儿童的背景如何，接受基础教育都应被承认为不可剥夺的权利。

meanings_ja: n. 皮重；容器自重 | v. 去皮称量；将秤归零
definition_en: the weight of packaging or a container without its contents | adjust a scale to exclude the weight of a container
example1_en: Tare the scale before adding flour to the bowl.
example1_ja: 往碗里加面粉前，先把秤去皮归零。
example2_en: Accurate tare measurements allow food producers to calculate product weight without including the packaging.
example2_ja: 准确测量皮重，能让食品生产商计算不含包装的产品重量。
collocations: tare weight｜皮重 ; tare the scale｜将秤去皮归零 ; deduct the tare｜扣除皮重
tip_ja: 皮重是容器重量；净重等于毛重减去皮重。
meanings_zh: n. 皮重；容器自重 | v. 去皮称量；将秤归零
example1_zh: 往碗里加面粉前，先把秤去皮归零。
example2_zh: 准确测量皮重，能让食品生产商计算不含包装的产品重量。

meanings_ja: n. 金属锭
definition_en: A solid block of metal cast for storage or processing.
example1_en: The worker lifted a shiny ingot with heavy tongs.
example1_ja: 工人用沉重的钳子夹起了一块闪亮的金属锭。
example2_en: Recycled aluminium can be cast into ingots before being processed into components for vehicles and buildings.
example2_ja: 回收铝可以先铸成锭，再加工成车辆和建筑所需的部件。
collocations: a gold ingot｜金锭 ; an aluminium ingot｜铝锭 ; cast into ingots｜铸成金属锭
tip_ja: 指铸成块的金属，不专指铁或纯铁。
meanings_zh: n. 金属锭
example1_zh: 工人用沉重的钳子夹起了一块闪亮的金属锭。
example2_zh: 回收铝可以先铸成锭，再加工成车辆和建筑所需的部件。

meanings_ja: adj. 承诺的；约定支付的
definition_en: containing a promise, especially a written promise to pay
example1_en: She signed a promissory note before borrowing the money.
example1_ja: 她借钱前签署了一张本票。
example2_en: A promissory note provides written evidence of debt, helping lenders establish their legal right to repayment.
example2_ja: 本票提供书面的债务凭证，帮助出借人确立依法获得偿还的权利。
collocations: promissory note｜本票；期票 ; promissory obligation｜承诺义务
tip_ja: 主要用于法律金融语境，常见搭配为promissory note。
meanings_zh: adj. 承诺的；约定支付的
example1_zh: 她借钱前签署了一张本票。
example2_zh: 本票提供书面的债务凭证，帮助出借人确立依法获得偿还的权利。

meanings_ja: adj. 唯利是图的 | n. 雇佣兵
definition_en: Caring mainly about money rather than other considerations | A soldier paid to fight for a foreign army or group
example1_en: His mercenary attitude spoiled our plans for the charity.
example1_ja: 他唯利是图的态度破坏了我们的慈善计划。
example2_en: A purely mercenary approach to healthcare risks placing financial returns above the needs of patients.
example2_ja: 对医疗服务采取纯粹逐利的做法，可能会使经济回报凌驾于患者需求之上。
collocations: mercenary motives｜唯利是图的动机 ; mercenary attitude｜唯利是图的态度 ; mercenary soldiers｜雇佣兵
tip_ja: 形容词带贬义，强调只看重金钱；作名词指雇佣兵。
meanings_zh: adj. 唯利是图的 | n. 雇佣兵
example1_zh: 他唯利是图的态度破坏了我们的慈善计划。
example2_zh: 对医疗服务采取纯粹逐利的做法，可能会使经济回报凌驾于患者需求之上。

meanings_ja: adj. 傲慢的；目中无人的
definition_en: Acting as though you are better than other people.
example1_en: The customer gave the waiter a haughty look.
example1_ja: 那位顾客傲慢地看了服务员一眼。
example2_en: A haughty attitude among senior managers can discourage employees from sharing ideas and reporting problems openly.
example2_ja: 高层管理者的傲慢态度会使员工不愿分享想法或公开反映问题。
collocations: haughty expression｜傲慢的神情 ; haughty attitude｜傲慢的态度 ; haughty tone｜傲慢的语气
tip_ja: 含贬义，强调自视高人一等，不等于自信。
meanings_zh: adj. 傲慢的；目中无人的
example1_zh: 那位顾客傲慢地看了服务员一眼。
example2_zh: 高层管理者的傲慢态度会使员工不愿分享想法或公开反映问题。

meanings_ja: v. 懒洋洋地躺或倚靠 | v. 无力地下垂；耷拉
definition_en: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way. | To hang loosely, especially the head or tongue.
example1_en: We lolled on the sofa after our long walk.
example1_ja: 长途散步后，我们懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。
example2_en: Comfortable public seating encourages visitors to loll in the shade rather than leave parks during hot weather.
example2_ja: 舒适的公共座椅让游客在炎热天气里愿意懒散地靠坐在树荫下，而不是离开公园。
collocations: loll about｜懒散地闲躺着 ; loll on the sofa｜懒洋洋地躺在沙发上 ; tongue lolling out｜舌头耷拉在外
tip_ja: 常接about或around，强调姿势松散、懒洋洋。
meanings_zh: v. 懒洋洋地躺或倚靠 | v. 无力地下垂；耷拉
example1_zh: 长途散步后，我们懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。
example2_zh: 舒适的公共座椅让游客在炎热天气里愿意懒散地靠坐在树荫下，而不是离开公园。

meanings_ja: n. 措辞；用词风格 | n. 吐字；发音方式
definition_en: The choice and style of words in speech or writing. | The way someone pronounces words, especially how clearly.
example1_en: Her formal diction sounded strange at our relaxed picnic.
example1_ja: 在我们轻松的野餐聚会上，她正式的措辞听起来很不协调。
example2_en: Writers often adapt their diction to make complex scientific ideas accessible to a wider audience.
example2_ja: 作者常会调整措辞，让更广泛的读者能够理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: formal diction｜正式措辞 ; poetic diction｜诗歌用语 ; clear diction｜清晰的吐字
tip_ja: 既可指用词风格，也可指吐字是否清晰。
meanings_zh: n. 措辞；用词风格 | n. 吐字；发音方式
example1_zh: 在我们轻松的野餐聚会上，她正式的措辞听起来很不协调。
example2_zh: 作者常会调整措辞，让更广泛的读者能够理解复杂的科学概念。

meanings_ja: n. 狂喜；欣喜若狂
definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of joy and delight.
example1_en: The children watched the dancing dolphins in rapture.
example1_ja: 孩子们欣喜万分地看着海豚跃动。
example2_en: The rapture experienced during live performances helps explain why audiences continue to value shared cultural events.
example2_ja: 现场演出带来的强烈喜悦，有助于解释观众为何依然珍视共同参与的文化活动。
collocations: in rapture｜欣喜若狂地 ; go into raptures over｜对……欣喜若狂 ; sheer rapture｜无比的喜悦
tip_ja: 语气强于happiness，常带文学色彩。
meanings_zh: n. 狂喜；欣喜若狂
example1_zh: 孩子们欣喜万分地看着海豚跃动。
example2_zh: 现场演出带来的强烈喜悦，有助于解释观众为何依然珍视共同参与的文化活动。

meanings_ja: adj. 使人产生错觉的
definition_en: Making something false seem true or something unreal seem real.
example1_en: The mirror created a delusive impression of extra space.
example1_ja: 这面镜子造成了空间更大的错觉。
example2_en: Early economic gains may create a delusive sense of security if governments ignore underlying weaknesses in public finances.
example2_ja: 如果政府忽视公共财政的潜在弱点，早期经济收益可能造成虚假的安全感。
collocations: delusive hopes｜虚妄的希望 ; delusive appearance｜迷惑人的表象 ; delusive sense of security｜虚假的安全感
tip_ja: 较正式且少见；日常多用misleading或deceptive。
meanings_zh: adj. 使人产生错觉的
example1_zh: 这面镜子造成了空间更大的错觉。
example2_zh: 如果政府忽视公共财政的潜在弱点，早期经济收益可能造成虚假的安全感。

meanings_ja: adj. 肌肉松弛的 | adj. 软弱无力的；松散的
definition_en: having soft, loose flesh rather than firm muscles | lacking strength, effectiveness, or clear structure
example1_en: He felt his muscles had grown flabby during recovery.
example1_ja: 他觉得自己的肌肉在康复期间变得松弛了。
example2_en: An essay with flabby arguments may fail to persuade readers, even when its topic is important.
example2_ja: 即使主题重要，论证松散无力的文章也可能无法说服读者。
collocations: flabby muscles｜松弛的肌肉 ; flabby arms｜肌肉松弛的手臂 ; flabby prose｜松散拖沓的文字
tip_ja: 多指肌肉松弛；形容文章时指松散无力，语气贬义。
meanings_zh: adj. 肌肉松弛的 | adj. 软弱无力的；松散的
example1_zh: 他觉得自己的肌肉在康复期间变得松弛了。
example2_zh: 即使主题重要，论证松散无力的文章也可能无法说服读者。

meanings_ja: n. 车辆里程表
definition_en: a device measuring the total distance a vehicle has travelled
example1_en: The odometer showed how far we had driven.
example1_ja: 里程表显示了我们已经行驶的距离。
example2_en: When purchasing a used vehicle, consumers should check its odometer reading alongside its maintenance records.
example2_ja: 购买二手车时，消费者应将里程表读数与保养记录一并核查。
collocations: odometer reading｜里程表读数 ; check the odometer｜查看里程表
tip_ja: 记录累计里程；speedometer显示即时车速。
meanings_zh: n. 车辆里程表
example1_zh: 里程表显示了我们已经行驶的距离。
example2_zh: 购买二手车时，消费者应将里程表读数与保养记录一并核查。

meanings_ja: v. 力劝；敦促
definition_en: To strongly urge someone to do something.
example1_en: Our coach exhorted us to keep trying until the end.
example1_ja: 教练力劝我们坚持努力到最后。
example2_en: Public health campaigns exhort citizens to exercise regularly, but affordable facilities are also needed to support lasting change.
example2_ja: 公共卫生宣传敦促市民经常锻炼，但要支持持久的改变，也需要价格亲民的设施。
collocations: exhort someone to act｜敦促某人行动 ; exhort citizens to vote｜敦促公民投票
tip_ja: 正式用词：exhort sb to do，不只是提出忠告。
meanings_zh: v. 力劝；敦促
example1_zh: 教练力劝我们坚持努力到最后。
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传敦促市民经常锻炼，但要支持持久的改变，也需要价格亲民的设施。

meanings_ja: n. 词典编纂；词典学
definition_en: The practice or study of writing and editing dictionaries.
example1_en: My aunt works in lexicography and loves discussing words.
example1_ja: 我姑姑从事词典编纂工作，很喜欢讨论词语。
example2_en: Digital lexicography allows dictionary editors to track changes in language through large collections of authentic examples.
example2_ja: 数字词典编纂使编辑能够通过大量真实用例追踪语言变化。
collocations: digital lexicography｜数字词典编纂 ; practical lexicography｜词典编纂实践 ; a career in lexicography｜词典编纂职业
tip_ja: 指词典编纂或其研究，通常作不可数名词。
meanings_zh: n. 词典编纂；词典学
example1_zh: 我姑姑从事词典编纂工作，很喜欢讨论词语。
example2_zh: 数字词典编纂使编辑能够通过大量真实用例追踪语言变化。

meanings_ja: adj. 虚幻的；迷惑人的
definition_en: appearing real but based on illusion
example1_en: The desert shimmered with illusive pools of water.
example1_ja: 沙漠中闪现着虚幻的水洼。
example2_en: Advertising may create an illusive sense of happiness by linking personal fulfilment exclusively to material possessions.
example2_ja: 广告可能将个人满足感完全与物质财富挂钩，从而营造出虚幻的幸福感。
collocations: illusive appearance｜虚幻的外表 ; illusive happiness｜虚幻的幸福
tip_ja: 较少用，常用illusory；elusive意为难以捉摸的。
meanings_zh: adj. 虚幻的；迷惑人的
example1_zh: 沙漠中闪现着虚幻的水洼。
example2_zh: 广告可能将个人满足感完全与物质财富挂钩，从而营造出虚幻的幸福感。

meanings_ja: n. 子序列
definition_en: A sequence formed by selecting elements without changing their original order.
example1_en: We selected alternate beads to create a subsequence.
example1_ja: 我们隔一颗选一颗珠子，组成了一个子序列。
example2_en: Researchers can analyse a subsequence of genetic data to identify patterns associated with inherited diseases.
example2_ja: 研究人员可以分析遗传数据的子序列，以识别与遗传病有关的模式。
collocations: common subsequence｜公共子序列 ; convergent subsequence｜收敛子序列 ; increasing subsequence｜递增子序列
tip_ja: 主要是数学、计算机术语；“后果”用consequence。
meanings_zh: n. 子序列
example1_zh: 我们隔一颗选一颗珠子，组成了一个子序列。
example2_zh: 研究人员可以分析遗传数据的子序列，以识别与遗传病有关的模式。

meanings_ja: v. 幼儿蹒跚学步 | v. 悠闲地走
definition_en: To walk with short, unsteady steps, especially as a young child. | To walk somewhere casually and without hurrying.
example1_en: The baby toddled across the rug towards her father.
example1_ja: 宝宝摇摇晃晃地走过地毯，朝爸爸走去。
example2_en: As children begin to toddle, safe spaces allow them to develop balance and explore their surroundings independently.
example2_ja: 孩子开始蹒跚学步时，安全的空间能让他们练习平衡，并独立探索周围环境。
collocations: toddle across the room｜蹒跚着穿过房间 ; toddle towards someone｜蹒跚走向某人 ; toddle off｜慢悠悠地离开
tip_ja: 主要作不及物动词；学步幼儿叫toddler。
meanings_zh: v. 幼儿蹒跚学步 | v. 悠闲地走
example1_zh: 宝宝摇摇晃晃地走过地毯，朝爸爸走去。
example2_zh: 孩子开始蹒跚学步时，安全的空间能让他们练习平衡，并独立探索周围环境。

meanings_ja: v. 悔过；忏悔
definition_en: To regret wrongdoing deeply and intend to behave better.
example1_en: He came to repent of lying to his closest friend.
example1_ja: 他后来为向自己最亲密的朋友撒谎而深感懊悔。
example2_en: Some argue that justice should allow offenders to repent and rebuild their lives through education and community service.
example2_ja: 有人认为，司法应让违法者有机会悔过，并通过教育和社区服务重建生活。
collocations: repent of wrongdoing｜为过错忏悔 ; sincerely repent｜真诚悔过
tip_ja: 常用repent of sth；比regret更强调悔过。
meanings_zh: v. 悔过；忏悔
example1_zh: 他后来为向自己最亲密的朋友撒谎而深感懊悔。
example2_zh: 有人认为，司法应让违法者有机会悔过，并通过教育和社区服务重建生活。

meanings_ja: n. 甘油；丙三醇
definition_en: a thick clear liquid used in medicines, foods, and skincare products
example1_en: This hand cream contains glycerin to keep skin soft.
example1_ja: 这款护手霜含有甘油，能让皮肤保持柔软。
example2_en: Manufacturers often add glycerin to skincare products because it helps retain moisture and prevent dryness.
example2_ja: 制造商常在护肤品中加入甘油，因为它有助于保持水分并防止干燥。
collocations: vegetable glycerin｜植物甘油 ; pure glycerin｜纯甘油 ; glycerin soap｜甘油皂
tip_ja: 不可数名词；也拼作glycerine，化学名为glycerol。
meanings_zh: n. 甘油；丙三醇
example1_zh: 这款护手霜含有甘油，能让皮肤保持柔软。
example2_zh: 制造商常在护肤品中加入甘油，因为它有助于保持水分并防止干燥。

meanings_ja: v. 打瞌睡；半睡半醒 | n. 瞌睡；半睡状态
definition_en: To sleep lightly or be almost asleep. | A state of being partly asleep.
example1_en: Grandfather drowsed in his chair beside the sunny window.
example1_ja: 爷爷坐在阳光照进的窗边，在椅子上打瞌睡。
example2_en: Passengers may drowse during long journeys, making comfortable seating an important consideration for transport providers.
example2_ja: 乘客在长途旅行中可能会打瞌睡，因此舒适的座椅是交通服务商的重要考量。
collocations: drowse in a chair｜坐在椅子上打瞌睡 ; drowse off｜迷迷糊糊睡着 ; in a drowse｜处于半睡状态
tip_ja: 较书面；日常说打瞌睡更常用doze。
meanings_zh: v. 打瞌睡；半睡半醒 | n. 瞌睡；半睡状态
example1_zh: 爷爷坐在阳光照进的窗边，在椅子上打瞌睡。
example2_zh: 乘客在长途旅行中可能会打瞌睡，因此舒适的座椅是交通服务商的重要考量。

meanings_ja: conj. 以免；唯恐
definition_en: To prevent something unwanted, or because of fearing it
example1_en: She whispered lest she wake the sleeping baby.
example1_ja: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。
example2_en: Policymakers should assess new technologies carefully lest short-term economic gains create lasting environmental problems.
example2_ja: 政策制定者应仔细评估新技术，以免短期经济收益造成长期环境问题。
collocations: lest we forget｜以免我们忘记 ; lest someone should｜唯恐某人会
tip_ja: 较正式；从句常用动词原形或should加原形。
meanings_zh: conj. 以免；唯恐
example1_zh: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。
example2_zh: 政策制定者应仔细评估新技术，以免短期经济收益造成长期环境问题。

meanings_ja: v. 拧；绞；榨出
definition_en: To twist and squeeze something, especially to remove liquid.
example1_en: Wring out the wet towel before hanging it up.
example1_ja: 把湿毛巾拧干后再挂起来。
example2_en: Where washing machines are unavailable, residents must wring out heavy clothes by hand after washing.
example2_ja: 在没有洗衣机的地方，居民洗完厚重衣物后必须用手拧干。
collocations: wring out a towel｜拧干毛巾 ; wring your hands｜焦虑地绞着双手 ; wring water from clothes｜拧出衣服里的水
tip_ja: 过去式和过去分词均为wrung；拧干常用wring out。
meanings_zh: v. 拧；绞；榨出
example1_zh: 把湿毛巾拧干后再挂起来。
example2_zh: 在没有洗衣机的地方，居民洗完厚重衣物后必须用手拧干。

meanings_ja: v. 挪用；侵吞
definition_en: To dishonestly take entrusted money or property for your own use.
example1_en: The treasurer misappropriated club funds to pay personal bills.
example1_ja: 财务主管挪用了俱乐部的资金来支付个人账单。
example2_en: Independent audits help prevent officials from misappropriating public funds intended for essential services such as healthcare and education.
example2_ja: 独立审计有助于防止官员挪用本应用于医疗、教育等基本服务的公共资金。
collocations: misappropriate funds｜挪用资金 ; misappropriate public money｜挪用公款 ; misappropriate assets｜侵吞资产
tip_ja: 正式用语，常搭配funds，强调擅自挪作私用。
meanings_zh: v. 挪用；侵吞
example1_zh: 财务主管挪用了俱乐部的资金来支付个人账单。
example2_zh: 独立审计有助于防止官员挪用本应用于医疗、教育等基本服务的公共资金。

meanings_ja: adj. 笨拙的；姿态不雅的
definition_en: Awkward in movement, shape or appearance.
example1_en: The young camel rose slowly on its ungainly legs.
example1_ja: 小骆驼用它那笨拙的长腿慢慢站了起来。
example2_en: Although early electric vehicles appeared ungainly, improvements in design have made them more attractive to consumers.
example2_ja: 虽然早期电动汽车外形笨拙，但设计上的改进使它们更能吸引消费者。
collocations: an ungainly movement｜笨拙的动作 ; an ungainly figure｜笨拙的身形 ; an ungainly shape｜不协调的外形
tip_ja: 虽以-ly结尾，现代常用词性是形容词。
meanings_zh: adj. 笨拙的；姿态不雅的
example1_zh: 小骆驼用它那笨拙的长腿慢慢站了起来。
example2_zh: 虽然早期电动汽车外形笨拙，但设计上的改进使它们更能吸引消费者。

meanings_ja: n. 冶金学；冶金技术
definition_en: The science of extracting metals and studying their properties.
example1_en: My cousin studies metallurgy and tests metals in a laboratory.
example1_ja: 我的表姐学习冶金学，在实验室检测金属。
example2_en: Advances in metallurgy have enabled manufacturers to develop lighter materials for more fuel-efficient vehicles.
example2_ja: 冶金技术的进步使制造商能够开发更轻的材料，用于制造更节能的车辆。
collocations: physical metallurgy｜物理冶金学 ; powder metallurgy｜粉末冶金 ; advances in metallurgy｜冶金技术的进步
tip_ja: 不可数名词；从业专家称metallurgist。
meanings_zh: n. 冶金学；冶金技术
example1_zh: 我的表姐学习冶金学，在实验室检测金属。
example2_zh: 冶金技术的进步使制造商能够开发更轻的材料，用于制造更节能的车辆。

meanings_ja: v. 彻底毁灭；抹去
definition_en: Destroy or remove something completely, leaving little or no trace.
example1_en: Heavy snowfall had obliterated every footprint on the garden path.
example1_ja: 大雪已将花园小路上的所有脚印彻底覆盖。
example2_en: Rapid urban development can obliterate historic neighbourhoods unless effective conservation measures are introduced early in the planning process.
example2_ja: 快速的城市开发可能彻底毁掉历史街区，除非在规划初期就引入有效的保护措施。
collocations: obliterate all traces｜抹去所有痕迹 ; completely obliterate｜彻底摧毁 ; obliterate evidence｜销毁证据
tip_ja: 是动词，强调彻底消除，比普通 remove 语气更强。
meanings_zh: v. 彻底毁灭；抹去
example1_zh: 大雪已将花园小路上的所有脚印彻底覆盖。
example2_zh: 快速的城市开发可能彻底毁掉历史街区，除非在规划初期就引入有效的保护措施。

meanings_ja: v. 证明无辜；证明正确
definition_en: To prove someone innocent or show that something was justified.
example1_en: The security footage vindicated the cleaner accused of stealing.
example1_ja: 监控录像证明了那位被指控偷窃的清洁工是无辜的。
example2_en: The significant decline in road accidents appears to vindicate the council's decision to introduce lower speed limits.
example2_ja: 交通事故显著减少，似乎证明市政委员会降低限速的决定是正确的。
collocations: vindicate a decision｜证明决定正确 ; vindicate an approach｜证明方法正确 ; feel vindicated｜感到自己得到证明
tip_ja: 强调证据或结果证明正确，不只是口头辩护。
meanings_zh: v. 证明无辜；证明正确
example1_zh: 监控录像证明了那位被指控偷窃的清洁工是无辜的。
example2_zh: 交通事故显著减少，似乎证明市政委员会降低限速的决定是正确的。

meanings_ja: n. 苯
definition_en: A toxic, flammable liquid hydrocarbon used in chemical manufacturing.
example1_en: The technician tested the water for traces of benzene.
example1_ja: 技术人员检测了水中是否有微量苯。
example2_en: Strict controls on industrial emissions can reduce workers' exposure to benzene and other harmful chemicals.
example2_ja: 严格控制工业排放可以减少工人接触苯及其他有害化学物质的机会。
collocations: benzene exposure｜苯暴露 ; benzene emissions｜苯排放 ; benzene ring｜苯环
tip_ja: 苯是有毒化合物；勿与汽油的英式说法petrol混淆。
meanings_zh: n. 苯
example1_zh: 技术人员检测了水中是否有微量苯。
example2_zh: 严格控制工业排放可以减少工人接触苯及其他有害化学物质的机会。

meanings_ja: v. 高度赞扬；颂扬 | v. 提升地位
definition_en: To praise someone or something very highly. | To raise someone to a higher rank or position.
example1_en: Her songs exalt the beauty of ordinary life.
example1_ja: 她的歌曲颂扬平凡生活中的美。
example2_en: Public monuments often exalt national heroes while overlooking the contributions of ordinary citizens.
example2_ja: 公共纪念碑往往颂扬民族英雄，却忽视普通公民的贡献。
collocations: exalt the virtues of｜盛赞……的美德 ; exalt someone to a position｜将某人提升至某职位
tip_ja: 正式用词；指高度颂扬，不是普通的表扬。
meanings_zh: v. 高度赞扬；颂扬 | v. 提升地位
example1_zh: 她的歌曲颂扬平凡生活中的美。
example2_zh: 公共纪念碑往往颂扬民族英雄，却忽视普通公民的贡献。

meanings_ja: n. 胸部；怀抱 | adj. 亲密的；知心的
definition_en: The chest, especially a woman's, or the embrace it provides. | Very close and trusted, used mainly before friend.
example1_en: The grandmother held the sleepy child to her bosom.
example1_ja: 祖母把困倦的孩子搂在怀里。
example2_en: Traditional paintings often depict a parent holding a child to their bosom, symbolising protection and affection.
example2_ja: 传统绘画常描绘父母将孩子搂在怀中的情景，象征着保护与关爱。
collocations: hold someone to one's bosom｜将某人搂在怀里 ; bosom friend｜知心朋友 ; in the bosom of the family｜在家庭的温暖怀抱中
tip_ja: 较文学化或旧式；bosom friend指知心朋友。
meanings_zh: n. 胸部；怀抱 | adj. 亲密的；知心的
example1_zh: 祖母把困倦的孩子搂在怀里。
example2_zh: 传统绘画常描绘父母将孩子搂在怀中的情景，象征着保护与关爱。

meanings_ja: adv. 欢快地 | adv. 色彩鲜艳地
definition_en: In a cheerful and lively way. | With bright, cheerful colours.
example1_en: The children laughed gaily as they chased bubbles outside.
example1_ja: 孩子们在外面追逐泡泡，欢快地笑着。
example2_en: Gaily decorated streets can attract visitors during local festivals and encourage spending in nearby shops.
example2_ja: 当地节庆期间，装饰鲜艳的街道能够吸引游客，促进周边商店的消费。
collocations: laugh gaily｜欢快地笑 ; gaily decorated｜装饰鲜艳的 ; gaily coloured｜色彩鲜艳的
tip_ja: 略带文学色彩；也可形容装饰色彩鲜艳。
meanings_zh: adv. 欢快地 | adv. 色彩鲜艳地
example1_zh: 孩子们在外面追逐泡泡，欢快地笑着。
example2_zh: 当地节庆期间，装饰鲜艳的街道能够吸引游客，促进周边商店的消费。

meanings_ja: n. 大菱鲆；大菱鲆鱼肉
definition_en: a broad, flat sea fish, or its edible flesh
example1_en: We shared grilled turbot with potatoes by the harbour.
example1_ja: 我们在港口边一起吃了烤大菱鲆配土豆。
example2_en: Farming turbot can supply seafood markets, but producers must carefully manage water quality and waste.
example2_ja: 养殖大菱鲆能为海鲜市场提供货源，但生产者必须谨慎管理水质和废弃物。
collocations: grilled turbot｜烤大菱鲆 ; farmed turbot｜养殖大菱鲆 ; turbot fillets｜大菱鲆鱼柳
tip_ja: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为turbot。
meanings_zh: n. 大菱鲆；大菱鲆鱼肉
example1_zh: 我们在港口边一起吃了烤大菱鲆配土豆。
example2_zh: 养殖大菱鲆能为海鲜市场提供货源，但生产者必须谨慎管理水质和废弃物。

meanings_ja: adj. 博学的；学术性的
definition_en: having or showing knowledge gained through extensive study
example1_en: Our learned neighbour can explain almost any historical mystery.
example1_ja: 我们那位博学的邻居几乎能解释任何历史谜团。
example2_en: Learned societies play an important role in sharing research findings and encouraging debate across academic disciplines.
example2_ja: 学术团体在分享研究成果、促进跨学科学术讨论方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: a learned scholar｜博学的学者 ; a learned society｜学术团体 ; a learned journal｜学术期刊
tip_ja: 意为“博学的”读两音节；作 learn 过去式读一音节。
meanings_zh: adj. 博学的；学术性的
example1_zh: 我们那位博学的邻居几乎能解释任何历史谜团。
example2_zh: 学术团体在分享研究成果、促进跨学科学术讨论方面发挥着重要作用。

meanings_ja: n. 年金；年金保险
definition_en: An investment providing regular payments, often throughout retirement.
example1_en: My grandfather receives an annuity to cover his living costs.
example1_ja: 我祖父领取年金来支付生活开销。
example2_en: An annuity can provide retirees with a predictable income, although inflation may reduce its purchasing power.
example2_ja: 年金可以为退休者提供可预期的收入，但通货膨胀可能降低其购买力。
collocations: buy an annuity｜购买年金保险 ; annuity payments｜年金给付 ; a lifetime annuity｜终身年金
tip_ja: 年金可按月等定期支付，并非只能一年领一次。
meanings_zh: n. 年金；年金保险
example1_zh: 我祖父领取年金来支付生活开销。
example2_zh: 年金可以为退休者提供可预期的收入，但通货膨胀可能降低其购买力。

meanings_ja: n. 运送；运输 | n. 运输工具 | n. 产权转让
definition_en: the act of transporting people or goods | a vehicle used for carrying people or goods | the legal transfer of property from one owner to another
example1_en: The hotel arranged conveyance of our luggage by boat.
example1_ja: 酒店安排用船运送我们的行李。
example2_en: Efficient conveyance of agricultural goods depends on reliable roads, suitable vehicles, and accessible regional markets.
example2_ja: 农产品的高效运输依赖可靠的道路、合适的车辆以及便利的区域市场。
collocations: conveyance of goods｜货物运输 ; means of conveyance｜交通工具 ; conveyance of property｜产权转让
tip_ja: 正式用词；日常运输多用transport，法律中可指产权转让。
meanings_zh: n. 运送；运输 | n. 运输工具 | n. 产权转让
example1_zh: 酒店安排用船运送我们的行李。
example2_zh: 农产品的高效运输依赖可靠的道路、合适的车辆以及便利的区域市场。

meanings_ja: n. 林边；树林边缘
definition_en: The edge of a wood or the land beside it.
example1_en: We rested at the woodside, just beyond the meadow.
example1_ja: 我们穿过草地后，在林边休息。
example2_en: Preserving vegetation along the woodside can provide shelter for wildlife moving between forests and open farmland.
example2_ja: 保留林边植被可以为在森林与开阔农田之间活动的野生动物提供庇护。
collocations: at the woodside｜在林边 ; along the woodside｜沿着树林边缘
tip_ja: 罕见词；日常更常说the edge of the woods。
meanings_zh: n. 林边；树林边缘
example1_zh: 我们穿过草地后，在林边休息。
example2_zh: 保留林边植被可以为在森林与开阔农田之间活动的野生动物提供庇护。

meanings_ja: n. 霉；霉菌；霉病 | v. 发霉；使发霉
definition_en: A thin fungal growth on damp surfaces or plants. | Develop mildew, or cause something to develop mildew.
example1_en: We found mildew on the bathroom ceiling after our holiday.
example1_ja: 度假回来后，我们发现浴室天花板发霉了。
example2_en: Improved ventilation in poorly maintained housing can limit mildew growth and create healthier living conditions for residents.
example2_ja: 改善维护不善的住房中的通风状况，可以抑制霉菌生长，为居民创造更健康的居住环境。
collocations: powdery mildew｜白粉病 ; mildew growth｜霉菌生长 ; prevent mildew｜防霉
tip_ja: 作名词通常不可数，常指潮湿表面的霉或植物霉病。
meanings_zh: n. 霉；霉菌；霉病 | v. 发霉；使发霉
example1_zh: 度假回来后，我们发现浴室天花板发霉了。
example2_zh: 改善维护不善的住房中的通风状况，可以抑制霉菌生长，为居民创造更健康的居住环境。

meanings_ja: adj. 不可阻挡的；无法改变的
definition_en: impossible to stop or prevent
example1_en: We watched the inexorable tide creep towards our sandcastle.
example1_ja: 我们看着无法阻挡的潮水逐渐逼近沙堡。
example2_en: The inexorable rise in demand for electricity highlights the need for investment in renewable energy.
example2_ja: 电力需求不可阻挡的增长凸显了投资可再生能源的必要性。
collocations: inexorable rise｜不可阻挡的增长 ; inexorable decline｜无法遏制的衰退 ; inexorable march of time｜时间不可阻挡的流逝
tip_ja: 侧重趋势或进程无法阻止，不只是“无情”。
meanings_zh: adj. 不可阻挡的；无法改变的
example1_zh: 我们看着无法阻挡的潮水逐渐逼近沙堡。
example2_zh: 电力需求不可阻挡的增长凸显了投资可再生能源的必要性。

meanings_ja: adj. 构成性的；构成要素的
definition_en: Helping to form something or define its essential nature.
example1_en: For our club, cooperation is constitutive of its identity.
example1_ja: 对我们俱乐部而言，合作精神是其身份认同的根本组成部分。
example2_en: Shared customs are constitutive of cultural identity, rather than merely optional features of community life.
example2_ja: 共同习俗是文化认同的根本组成部分，而非社区生活中可有可无的特征。
collocations: constitutive of｜构成……的 ; constitutive elements｜构成要素 ; constitutive role｜构成性作用
tip_ja: 指构成事物本质的；“宪法的”用constitutional。
meanings_zh: adj. 构成性的；构成要素的
example1_zh: 对我们俱乐部而言，合作精神是其身份认同的根本组成部分。
example2_zh: 共同习俗是文化认同的根本组成部分，而非社区生活中可有可无的特征。

meanings_ja: n. 犁沟 | n. 深皱纹；沟痕 | v. 皱起眉头；使起沟纹
definition_en: A long narrow channel cut into soil by a plough | A deep line in skin or another surface | Make deep lines in something, especially the forehead
example1_en: The farmer dropped seeds into a freshly ploughed furrow.
example1_ja: 农民把种子撒进刚犁好的沟里。
example2_en: Planting along furrows that follow the contours of hills can help farmers reduce soil erosion.
example2_ja: 沿着顺应山坡等高线的犁沟种植，有助于农民减少土壤侵蚀。
collocations: plough a furrow｜犁出一道沟 ; a deep furrow｜深沟；深皱纹 ; furrow your brow｜皱眉
tip_ja: furrow your brow是常用搭配，意为皱眉。
meanings_zh: n. 犁沟 | n. 深皱纹；沟痕 | v. 皱起眉头；使起沟纹
example1_zh: 农民把种子撒进刚犁好的沟里。
example2_zh: 沿着顺应山坡等高线的犁沟种植，有助于农民减少土壤侵蚀。

meanings_ja: n. 长篇激烈的训话 | v. 长篇训斥
definition_en: A long, forceful speech expressing anger or strong criticism. | To speak angrily and at length to someone.
example1_en: His harangue about dirty dishes spoiled our quiet breakfast.
example1_ja: 他为没洗的碗碟训斥个没完，破坏了我们早餐时的宁静。
example2_en: A lengthy harangue is unlikely to persuade citizens who expect constructive debate about public spending.
example2_ja: 对于期待就公共支出展开建设性讨论的公民，冗长激烈的训话很难有说服力。
collocations: a lengthy harangue｜冗长的训话 ; launch into a harangue｜开始长篇训斥 ; harangue someone about something｜为某事长篇训斥某人
tip_ja: 含贬义，强调冗长且激烈，不只是普通演讲。
meanings_zh: n. 长篇激烈的训话 | v. 长篇训斥
example1_zh: 他为没洗的碗碟训斥个没完，破坏了我们早餐时的宁静。
example2_zh: 对于期待就公共支出展开建设性讨论的公民，冗长激烈的训话很难有说服力。

meanings_ja: v. 撤销命令；取消指令
definition_en: to officially cancel an earlier order
example1_en: The manager countermanded the order to close the shop.
example1_ja: 经理撤销了关闭商店的命令。
example2_en: Local officials may countermand evacuation orders only when reliable evidence shows that the danger has passed.
example2_ja: 地方官员只有在可靠证据表明危险已经解除时，才可撤销疏散命令。
collocations: countermand an order｜撤销命令 ; countermand an instruction｜取消指令
tip_ja: 正式用语，宾语通常是order或instruction。
meanings_zh: v. 撤销命令；取消指令
example1_zh: 经理撤销了关闭商店的命令。
example2_zh: 地方官员只有在可靠证据表明危险已经解除时，才可撤销疏散命令。

meanings_ja: adj. 故意作对的；悖理的 | adj. 事与愿违的；适得其反的
definition_en: Deliberately contrary to what is reasonable, expected, or wanted. | Producing effects opposite to those intended or considered desirable.
example1_en: He took perverse pleasure in disagreeing with every suggestion.
example1_ja: 他以反对每一个建议为乐，这种乐趣令人费解。
example2_en: Poorly designed subsidies can create perverse incentives, encouraging companies to increase pollution rather than invest in cleaner production.
example2_ja: 设计不当的补贴可能产生反向激励，鼓励企业增加污染，而不是投资更清洁的生产方式。
collocations: perverse pleasure｜反常的乐趣 ; perverse incentives｜反向激励 ; perverse effect｜适得其反的效果
tip_ja: 不泛指不正当；常指故意作对或结果适得其反。
meanings_zh: adj. 故意作对的；悖理的 | adj. 事与愿违的；适得其反的
example1_zh: 他以反对每一个建议为乐，这种乐趣令人费解。
example2_zh: 设计不当的补贴可能产生反向激励，鼓励企业增加污染，而不是投资更清洁的生产方式。

meanings_ja: adj. 冲积的
definition_en: formed from soil or sand deposited by flowing water
example1_en: Our vegetables grow well in the rich alluvial soil.
example1_ja: 我们的蔬菜在肥沃的冲积土中长势良好。
example2_en: Alluvial plains often support intensive agriculture because rivers deposit fertile sediment across these lowland areas.
example2_ja: 冲积平原通常有利于集约农业，因为河流会在这些低地沉积肥沃的泥沙。

meanings_zh: adj. 冲积的
